班.meaning: class; squad; work shift (measure word for scheduled runs of transport: 一班飞机 a flight)

examples.hanzi: 我每天坐早上七点的班去上班。
examples.pinyin: wǒ měitiān zuò zǎoshang qī diǎn de bān qù shàngbān.
examples.english: I take the 7 a.m. shift to go to work every day.

near_synonyms.difference: 笔 is the general word for pens/writing implements; 铅笔 is specifically a pencil

笔.meaning: pen; writing implement (brush pen 毛笔, ballpoint 圆珠笔); measure word for sums of money — 一笔钱 a sum of money

examples.hanzi: 我用这支笔写汉字。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yòng zhè zhī bǐ xiě Hànzì.
examples.english: I use this pen to write Chinese characters.

near_synonyms.difference: 跟 and 和 both join nouns, but 和 cannot mean "from (a source)" or work as a verb "to follow"; 跟 also covers 跟他学 "learn from him"

跟.meaning: with; and (connecting nouns); from (a source of information: 跟他学 learn from him)

examples.hanzi: 我想跟你一起去超市。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ yīqǐ qù chāoshì.
examples.english: I want to go to the supermarket with you.

跟.meaning: to follow (跟上去 catch up); heel of foot (脚跟)

examples.hanzi: 请跟我来，办公室在这边。
examples.pinyin: qǐng gēn wǒ lái, bàngōngshì zài zhèbiān.
examples.english: Please follow me; the office is over here.

面1.meaning: face; surface; side; aspect (正面 front side; 河面 river surface; 一面墙 one wall(side))

examples.hanzi: 湖面上有一只小船。
examples.pinyin: húmiàn shàng yǒu yī zhī xiǎochuán.
examples.english: There is a small boat on the surface of the lake.

面1.meaning: measure word for flat surfaces and mirrors/flags — 一面镜子 a mirror, 一面旗 a flag

examples.hanzi: 墙上挂着一面镜子。
examples.pinyin: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī miàn jìngzi.
examples.english: A mirror hangs on the wall.

examples.hanzi: 中午我想吃一碗面。
examples.pinyin: zhōngwǔ wǒ xiǎng chī yī wǎn miàn.
examples.english: At noon I want to eat a bowl of noodles.

near_synonyms.meaning: measure word for long thin rigid things
near_synonyms.difference: 条 is for long thin flexible things (rivers, pants, news); 根 is for rigid items like sticks, ropes of medium length

条.meaning: measure word for long thin things, items, and news — 一条河 a river, 一条消息 a piece of news; strip; item ( 条件 condition, 面条 noodles)

examples.hanzi: 他买了一条新裤子。
examples.pinyin: tā mǎi le yī tiáo xīn kùzi.
examples.english: He bought a new pair of pants.

头.meaning: head (头痛 headache); top; end (桥头 bridge end); first (头一次 the first time); leading (头两行 the first two lines)

examples.hanzi: 我今天头有点儿疼。
examples.pinyin: wǒ jīntiān tóu yǒu yīdiǎnr téng.
examples.english: My head hurts a little today.

头.meaning: measure word for livestock — 一头牛 an ox

examples.hanzi: 农场里有一头牛。
examples.pinyin: nóngchǎng lǐ yǒu yī tóu niú.
examples.english: There is an ox on the farm.

头.meaning: noun suffix marking the thing characterized by the root, often abstract (木头 wood, 甜头 sweet benefit, 馒头 steamed bun) — neutral tone

examples.hanzi: 这块木头很重。
examples.pinyin: zhè kuài mùtou hěn zhòng.
examples.english: This piece of wood is very heavy.

正.meaning: upright; straight; principal (正门 main entrance); exactly; precisely (正十二点 exactly noon); positive (正数 positive number); correct (改正 correct)

examples.hanzi: 请从正门进入。
examples.pinyin: qǐng cóng zhèngmén jìnrù.
examples.english: Please enter through the main entrance.

near_synonyms.difference: 正 emphasizes the action happening at this very moment, often 正…呢; 在 is the plain progressive marker

正.meaning: indicating an action in progress right at this moment — 我正忙着 I'm right in the middle of being busy; often 正在/正…呢

examples.hanzi: 妈妈正忙着做饭呢。
examples.pinyin: māma zhèng máng zhe zuò fàn ne.
examples.english: Mom is right in the middle of cooking.

冰.meaning: ice; to freeze; to put on ice (冰啤酒 to chill beer); 冰箱 refrigerator

examples.hanzi: 冬天湖上都结了冰。
examples.pinyin: dōngtiān hú shàng dōu jié le bīng.
examples.english: In winter the lake freezes over.

near_synonyms.difference: 拿 means to hold or carry in the hand; 带 means to bring or take along, carrying however you like

带.meaning: to bring; to take along; to carry (带伞 bring an umbrella); to lead; to head (带队 lead a team); to bear; to have on one (带钱 carry money)

examples.hanzi: 明天出门记得带伞。
examples.pinyin: míngtiān chūmén jìde dài sǎn.
examples.english: Remember to bring an umbrella when you go out tomorrow.

带.meaning: belt; band; strip; zone (皮带 leather belt; 磁带 magnetic tape; 热带 the tropics)

examples.hanzi: 我买了一条新皮带。
examples.pinyin: wǒ mǎi le yī tiáo xīn pídài.
examples.english: I bought a new leather belt.

电.meaning: electricity (停电 power cut); electric(al); abbreviated in compounds — 电话 telephone, 电脑 computer, 电视 TV

examples.hanzi: 昨天晚上小区停电了。
examples.pinyin: zuótiān wǎnshàng xiǎoqū tíngdiàn le.
examples.english: The neighborhood had a power cut last night.

根据.meaning: according to; based on (根据他的说法 according to him); basis; grounds (有根据 well-founded)

examples.hanzi: 根据天气预报，明天会下雨。
examples.pinyin: gēnjù tiānqì yùbào, míngtiān huì xià yǔ.
examples.english: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.

near_synonyms.difference: 关 is everyday "close/shut/turn off"; 闭 is formal/literary and never means "turn off" a device

关.meaning: to close; to shut (关门 close the door); to turn off (关灯 turn off the light); to close down (公司关了 the firm shut)

examples.hanzi: 出门的时候请关灯。
examples.pinyin: chūmén de shíhou qǐng guān dēng.
examples.english: Please turn off the lights when you leave.

关.meaning: pass; barrier; critical juncture (难关 difficulty; 海关 customs); concern — used only in compounds 关系 relation, 关于 about, 关心 care for

examples.hanzi: 他过了海关才想起护照。
examples.pinyin: tā guò le hǎiguān cái xiǎngqǐ hùzhào.
examples.english: Only after passing through customs did he remember his passport.

刻.meaning: to carve; to engrave (刻字 carve characters); quarter of an hour (三点一刻 3:15); moment (此刻 this moment)

examples.hanzi: 现在三点一刻，我们休息一下吧。
examples.pinyin: xiànzài sān diǎn yī kè, wǒmen xiūxi yīxià ba.
examples.english: It's a quarter past three now; let's take a break.

可.meaning: can; may (可信 believable); used for emphasis — 可好了 really good, 可别 forget not to; in 可惜 a pity

examples.hanzi: 这个消息可信吗？
examples.pinyin: zhège xiāoxi kěxìn ma?
examples.english: Is this information believable?

毛.meaning: hair; feather; wool (毛笔 writing brush); half a jiao — 0.1 yuan colloquially (一块毛 money talk)

examples.hanzi: 这件毛衣是羊毛的。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn máoyī shì yángmáo de.
examples.english: This sweater is made of wool.

牛.meaning: cattle; ox; cow (牛奶 milk; 牛肉 beef)

examples.hanzi: 农民在田里放牛。
examples.pinyin: nóngmín zài tián lǐ fàng niú.
examples.english: The farmer is herding cattle in the field.

牛.meaning: awesome; impressive — slang (他真牛 he's really something)

examples.hanzi: 他的球打得真牛！
examples.pinyin: tā de qiú dǎ de zhēn niú!
examples.english: He plays ball amazingly well!

起.meaning: to rise; to get up (起床 get up); to start (起风了 the wind has picked up); to rise from (起身 stand up); measure word for events/cases — 一起盗窃案 a theft case

examples.hanzi: 我每天六点起床。
examples.pinyin: wǒ měitiān liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.english: I get up at six every day.

near_synonyms.difference: 总是 is the full adverb; 总 alone is more formal/literary in tone and also has the "overall/chief" adjective senses 总是 never has

总.meaning: always; invariably (总是 always; 总迟到 always late)

examples.hanzi: 他上课总是迟到。
examples.pinyin: tā shàngkè zǒngshì chídào.
examples.english: He is always late for class.

总.meaning: general; chief; overall (总结 summarize; 总公司 head office; 总统 president)

examples.hanzi: 这是我们公司的总经理。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒmen gōngsī de zǒngjīnglǐ.
examples.english: This is our company's general manager.

棒.meaning: stick; club (木棒 wooden stick); great; excellent (真棒 great!)

examples.hanzi: 你的汉语说得真棒！
examples.pinyin: nǐ de Hànyǔ shuō de zhēn bàng!
examples.english: Your Chinese is really excellent!

near_synonyms.difference: 不过 is softer and more conversational; 但是 is more formal writing style and stronger contrast

不过.meaning: but; however; only; merely (不过如此 merely so-so)

examples.hanzi: 这道菜很好吃，不过有点儿贵。
examples.pinyin: zhè dào cài hěn hǎochī, bùguò yǒu yīdiǎnr guì.
examples.english: This dish is delicious, but a bit expensive.

near_synonyms.difference: 沉 is "heavy to lift/lower" describing feel; 重 is the standard word and also covers "important/serious" senses

重.meaning: heavy; weight (这本书很重 this book is heavy); important; major (重任 heavy responsibility); serious (病重 seriously ill)

examples.hanzi: 这个箱子太重了，我搬不动。
examples.pinyin: zhège xiāngzi tài zhòng le, wǒ bān bu dòng.
examples.english: This box is too heavy; I can't move it.

重.meaning: again; once more (重来 do it again; 重复 repeat); re-; layer (双重视角 double perspective)

examples.hanzi: 请你再重说一遍。
examples.pinyin: qǐng nǐ zài chóng shuō yī biàn.
examples.english: Please say it again.

near_synonyms.difference: 出口 is the way out, 入口 is the way in — learners often mix the direction

出口.meaning: exit; way out (安全出口 emergency exit); export (出口商品 export goods; 出口量 export volume)

examples.hanzi: 请从安全出口离开大楼。
examples.pinyin: qǐng cóng ānquán chūkǒu líkāi dàlóu.
examples.english: Please leave the building through the emergency exit.

near_synonyms.difference: 等 is the everyday word; 等候 is formal, used in announcements and writing

等2.meaning: to wait (等一下 wait a moment); class; rank; equal (平等 equal; 一等奖 first prize); and so on — 等等/等 after an enumeration (苹果、香蕉等 apples, bananas, etc.)

examples.hanzi: 我在门口等你十分钟了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài ménkǒu děng nǐ shí fēnzhōng le.
examples.english: I have been waiting for you at the door for ten minutes.

队.meaning: team; line; queue (排队 queue up; 球队 ball team; 大队 large group)

examples.hanzi: 买票的人排了很长的队。
examples.pinyin: mǎi piào de rén pái le hěn cháng de duì.
examples.english: The ticket buyers formed a very long line.

near_synonyms.difference: 做 is neutral "do/make"; 干 is colloquial, often for jobs and physical work (干活), and can sound blunt

干.meaning: to do; to work (干活 work; 你干得不错 you did a good job); to deal with (干掉了 it got done in)

examples.hanzi: 他每天都努力干活。
examples.pinyin: tā měitiān dōu nǔlì gànhuó.
examples.english: He works hard every day.

干.meaning: dry (衣服干了 the clothes are dry); dried (葡萄干 raisins); dry and empty (干货 dry goods)

examples.hanzi: 衣服晒了一天就干了。
examples.pinyin: yīfu shài le yī tiān jiù gān le.
examples.english: The clothes dried after a day in the sun.

管.meaning: to be in charge of; to manage (管事 manage affairs); to mind; to bother about (别管我 don't mind me); no matter (不管 no matter)

examples.hanzi: 别管我，我自己能行。
examples.pinyin: bié guǎn wǒ, wǒ zìjǐ néng xíng.
examples.english: Don't fuss over me; I can manage on my own.

管.meaning: tube; pipe (水管 water pipe); measure word for tube-shaped items — 一管牙膏 a tube of toothpaste

examples.hanzi: 厨房的水管坏了。
examples.pinyin: chúfáng de shuǐguǎn huài le.
examples.english: The water pipe in the kitchen broke.

奖.meaning: prize; award; reward (得奖 win a prize; 奖学金 scholarship; 大奖 grand prize)

examples.hanzi: 他努力学习，得了奖学金。
examples.pinyin: tā nǔlì xuéxí, dé le jiǎngxuéjīn.
examples.english: He studied hard and won a scholarship.

经济.meaning: economy (国家经济 the national economy; 经济学 economics); economical; cost-effective (很经济 very economical)

examples.hanzi: 这几年国家经济发展得很快。
examples.pinyin: zhè jǐ nián guójiā jīngjì fāzhǎn de hěn kuài.
examples.english: The national economy has developed quickly these years.

near_synonyms.difference: 到底 and 究竟 both intensify questions, but 究竟 is formal/written and rarely used in yes-no questions; 到底 is colloquial and broader

究竟.meaning: exactly; actually — used in questions for emphasis (究竟去不去 are you going or not?); the whys and wherefores; outcome (学生们的究竟 the students' actual situation)

examples.hanzi: 你究竟想说什么？
examples.pinyin: nǐ jiūjìng xiǎng shuō shénme?
examples.english: What on earth are you trying to say?

空.meaning: empty; vacant (空房间 an empty room; 肚子空了 the stomach is empty); in vain (空忙 busy for nothing); to empty; to vacate (把碗倒空 empty the bowl)

examples.hanzi: 教室里空空的，一个人也没有。
examples.pinyin: jiàoshì lǐ kōngkōng de, yī gè rén yě méiyǒu.
examples.english: The classroom is completely empty; not a single person.

空.meaning: free time; unoccupied time (有空 have free time; 空儿 spare moment); gap; vacant space (填空 fill in the blank)

examples.hanzi: 你周末有空吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ zhōumò yǒu kòng ma?
examples.english: Do you have free time this weekend?

near_synonyms.difference: 累 is general fatigue; 困 specifically means sleepy, wanting to sleep

困.meaning: sleepy (困了 sleepy); tired (又困又累 sleepy and tired); to surround; to trap (被围困 surrounded)

examples.hanzi: 昨晚没睡好，现在很困。
examples.pinyin: zuó wǎn méi shuì hǎo, xiànzài hěn kùn.
examples.english: I didn't sleep well last night; I'm very sleepy now.

连.meaning: even (连他都去了 even he went — 连…都/也 structure); in a row; in succession (连输三局 lose three games in a row); to link; to connect (连接 connect)

examples.hanzi: 这个问题连老师都不会。
examples.pinyin: zhège wèntí lián lǎoshī dōu bù huì.
examples.english: Even the teacher can't answer this question.

深.meaning: deep (水深 the water is deep); profound; advanced (学问深 profound learning); dark in color (颜色很深 a dark color); (of relationships) close; long-standing (交情很深 a deep friendship)

examples.hanzi: 这个湖的水很深，不能游泳。
examples.pinyin: zhège hú de shuǐ hěn shēn, bùnéng yóuyǒng.
examples.english: The water in this lake is deep; you can't swim here.

死.meaning: to die; dead (死鱼 a dead fish); extremely; to death — intensifier (累死了 exhausted to death); inflexible (死记 memorize mechanically); doomed (死路一条 a dead end)

examples.hanzi: 这条鱼已经死了。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo yú yǐjīng sǐ le.
examples.english: This fish is already dead.

near_synonyms.difference: 所有 modifies nouns with 的 and emphasizes every item; 全部 views things as one whole quantity, often after the noun (钱全部花了)

所有.meaning: all; every (所有人 everyone; 所有东西 everything)

examples.hanzi: 所有的学生都通过了考试。
examples.pinyin: suǒyǒu de xuéshēng dōu tōngguò le kǎoshì.
examples.english: All the students passed the exam.

台.meaning: platform; stage; stand (舞台 stage; 电台 broadcasting station; 台风 typhoon); measure word for machines and devices — 一台电脑 a computer, 一台戏 a performance

examples.hanzi: 他站在台上唱歌。
examples.pinyin: tā zhàn zài tái shàng chàng gē.
examples.english: He stands on the stage singing.

准.meaning: accurate; exact (准确 accurate; 不准 inaccurate); to allow; to permit (不准停车 no parking allowed); definitely; certainly (准能成功 will surely succeed)

examples.hanzi: 他的发音很准。
examples.pinyin: tā de fāyīn hěn zhǔn.
examples.english: His pronunciation is very accurate.

组.meaning: group; set; to organize (小组 small group; 组词 form phrases); measure word for sets — 一组沙发 a sofa set

examples.hanzi: 我们班分成了三个小组。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen bān fēn chéng le sān gè xiǎozǔ.
examples.english: Our class was divided into three small groups.

唉.meaning: interjection expressing sighing resignation, sympathy, or weariness — 唉，又失败了 (sigh) failed again; tone varies: āi sigh, ài regret

examples.hanzi: 唉，又堵车了，上班要迟到了。
examples.pinyin: āi, yòu dǔchē le, shàngbān yào chídào le.
examples.english: (Sigh) traffic jam again; I'll be late for work.

哎.meaning: hey; ah — interjection to draw attention or express sudden realization (哎，你看！ hey, look!)

examples.hanzi: 哎，你看，那是不是小王？
examples.pinyin: āi, nǐ kàn, nà shì bu shì Xiǎo Wáng?
examples.english: Hey, look — isn't that Xiao Wang?

near_synonyms.difference: 保护 is neutral "protect from harm"; 爱护 adds cherishing and careful treatment, used for public property, plants, the young

爱护.meaning: to cherish; to take good care of; to treasure (爱护公物 take care of public property; 爱护环境 protect the environment)

examples.hanzi: 我们要爱护公共环境。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen yào àihù gōnggòng huánjìng.
examples.english: We should take care of the public environment.

哎呀.meaning: ah; oh no; oh dear — interjection of surprise, dismay, or exasperation (哎呀，我忘了！ oh no, I forgot!)

examples.hanzi: 哎呀，我忘带钥匙了！
examples.pinyin: āiyā, wǒ wàng dài yàoshi le!
examples.english: Oh no, I forgot to bring my keys!

near_synonyms.difference: 黑 is dark because there is no light; 暗 is dim, shaded, or hidden — 天黑了 it got dark (nightfall) vs 屋里很暗 the room is dim

暗.meaning: dark; dim (天暗了 it got dark); hidden; secret (暗号 secret signal; 暗恋 secret crush)

examples.hanzi: 房间太暗了，请开灯。
examples.pinyin: fángjiān tài àn le, qǐng kāi dēng.
examples.english: The room is too dark; please turn on the light.

安.meaning: to install; to place (安装 install; 安家 settle down); peaceful; calm (安静 quiet; 心安 at ease)

examples.hanzi: 他们在新城市安了家。
examples.pinyin: tāmen zài xīn chéngshì ān le jiā.
examples.english: They settled down in a new city.

安全带.meaning: seat belt; safety belt (系安全带 fasten your seat belt)

examples.hanzi: 开车前要先系好安全带。
examples.pinyin: kāi chē qián yào xiān jì hǎo ānquándài.
examples.english: Fasten your seat belt before driving.

安慰.meaning: to comfort; to console (安慰她 comfort her); consolation (一句安慰的话 a word of comfort)

examples.hanzi: 朋友很难过，我去安慰了她。
examples.pinyin: péngyou hěn nánguò, wǒ qù ānwèi le tā.
examples.english: My friend was sad, and I went to comfort her.

安装.meaning: to install; to set up (安装软件 install software)

examples.hanzi: 技术员正在安装新空调。
examples.pinyin: jìshùyuán zhèngzài ānzhuāng xīn kōngtiáo.
examples.english: The technician is installing the new air conditioner.

熬夜.meaning: to stay up late; to burn the midnight oil (熬夜工作 work late into the night)

examples.hanzi: 他经常熬夜打游戏。
examples.pinyin: tā jīngcháng áoyè dǎ yóuxì.
examples.english: He often stays up late playing games.

near_synonyms.difference: 白白 is the colloquial reduplicated form meaning only "in vain"; 白 also means the color white and plain (白开水)

白.meaning: white (白纸 white paper); plain (白开水 plain boiled water); in vain; for nothing (白跑了一趟 made a trip for nothing); free of charge (白吃 eat for free)

examples.hanzi: 我白跑了一趟，他根本不在家。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bái pǎo le yī tàng, tā gēnběn bù zài jiā.
examples.english: I made the trip for nothing; he wasn't home at all.

傍晚.meaning: dusk; early evening (傍晚时分 around dusk)

examples.hanzi: 傍晚的时候，我们常去江边散步。
examples.pinyin: bàngwān de shíhou, wǒmen cháng qù jiāng biān sànbù.
examples.english: In the early evening we often go for a walk along the river.

半夜.meaning: midnight; middle of the night (半夜醒来 wake up in the middle of the night)

examples.hanzi: 他半夜才回到家。
examples.pinyin: tā bànyè cái huí dào jiā.
examples.english: He didn't get home until the middle of the night.

薄.meaning: thin (in thickness) (薄纸 thin paper; 这本书很薄 this book is thin)

examples.hanzi: 这本杂志很薄，一天就看完了。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn zázhì hěn báo, yī tiān jiù kàn wán le.
examples.english: This magazine is thin; I finished it in a day.

薄.meaning: thin; meagre; weak — in formal/literary compounds (薄礼 a modest gift; 单薄 flimsy; 淡薄 thin, faint)

examples.hanzi: 这是我的一点儿薄礼，请收下。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ de yīdiǎnr bólǐ, qǐng shōuxià.
examples.english: This is a small gift of mine; please accept it.

宝.meaning: treasure (国宝 national treasure); precious (宝贝 treasure, darling); 瓷器 porcelain — original sense now rare

examples.english: It's just a small scrape; it's nothing.

不足.meaning: insufficient; inadequate (睡眠不足 lack of sleep; 理由不足 the reasons are insufficient)

examples.hanzi: 他因为睡眠不足，上课总打瞌睡。
examples.pinyin: tā yīnwèi shuìmián bùzú, shàngkè zǒng dǎ kēshuì.
examples.english: Because of lack of sleep he always dozes off in class.

才2.meaning: not until; only then (他十二点才来 he didn't come until twelve); only; merely (才几个人 only a few people); emphasis that the amount is small or the wait was long; also talent (天才 genius; 才华 talent) in compounds

examples.hanzi: 他晚上十二点才回家。
examples.pinyin: tā wǎnshang shí'èr diǎn cái huí jiā.
examples.english: He didn't get home until twelve at night.

采访.meaning: to interview (a journalist's news interview) (采访明星 interview a star; 新闻采访 news interview)

examples.hanzi: 记者采访了这位科学家。
examples.pinyin: jìzhě cǎifǎng le zhè wèi kēxuéjiā.
examples.english: The journalist interviewed this scientist.

裁判.meaning: referee; judge (足球裁判 a football referee); to referee; to adjudicate

examples.hanzi: 裁判判这个球有效。
examples.pinyin: cáipàn pàn zhège qiú yǒuxiào.
examples.english: The referee ruled the goal valid.

near_synonyms.difference: 采取 pairs with measures/methods (采取措施); 采用 selects and puts to use a concrete technique or material (采用新技术)

采取.meaning: to adopt; to take (measures) (采取措施 take measures)

examples.hanzi: 政府采取了新的措施控制房价。
examples.pinyin: zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ le xīn de cuòshī kòngzhì fángjià.
examples.english: The government took new measures to control housing prices.

彩色.meaning: color (as opposed to black-and-white); multicolored (彩色照片 a color photo)

examples.hanzi: 这张彩色照片是三十年前拍的。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng cǎisè zhàopiàn shì sānshí nián qián pāi de.
examples.english: This color photo was taken thirty years ago.

采用.meaning: to adopt; to employ (a method or technology) (采用新技术 adopt new technology)

examples.hanzi: 这家工厂采用了新的生产技术。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā gōngchǎng cǎiyòng le xīn de shēngchǎn jìshù.
examples.english: This factory adopted new production technology.

藏.meaning: to hide; to conceal (把钱藏在抽屉里 hide money in a drawer); to store up (藏书 book collection)

examples.hanzi: 他把钱藏在抽屉里。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ qián cáng zài chōuti lǐ.
examples.english: He hid the money in a drawer.

藏.meaning: Tibet (西藏); Tibetan (藏语 the Tibetan language); a storehouse (宝藏 treasure trove; 大藏经 the Buddhist canon)

examples.hanzi: 他从小在西藏长大，会说藏语。
examples.pinyin: tā cóngxiǎo zài Xīzàng zhǎngdà, huì shuō Zàngyǔ.
examples.english: He grew up in Tibet and speaks Tibetan.

参考.meaning: to refer to; to consult (参考资料 reference material; 仅供参考 for reference only)

examples.hanzi: 写论文时他参考了十几本书。
examples.pinyin: xiě lùnwén shí tā cānkǎo le shí jǐ běn shū.
examples.english: He consulted a dozen books while writing his thesis.

餐饮.meaning: catering; food and drink (餐饮业 the catering industry; 餐饮服务 food and beverage service)

examples.hanzi: 这条街上有很多餐饮店。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo jiē shàng yǒu hěn duō cānyǐn diàn.
examples.english: There are many food-and-drink establishments on this street.

参与.meaning: to participate in; to take part in (参与讨论 take part in a discussion)

examples.hanzi: 我们鼓励学生参与课外活动。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen gǔlì xuéshēng cānyù kèwài huódòng.
examples.english: We encourage students to take part in extracurricular activities.

操作.meaning: to operate; to run (a machine or system) (操作机器 operate a machine; 手术操作 surgical procedure)

examples.hanzi: 这台机器操作很简单。
examples.pinyin: zhè tái jīqì cāozuò hěn jiǎndān.
examples.english: This machine is very simple to operate.

册.meaning: book; volume (画册 an album; 纪念册 commemorative album); measure word for books — 一册书 a volume

examples.hanzi: 这套丛书共有十册。
examples.pinyin: zhè tào cóngshū gòng yǒu shí cè.
examples.english: This series has ten volumes in all.

测.meaning: to measure; to test; to survey (测试 test; 测量 measure; 预测 predict)

examples.hanzi: 医生给他测了体温。
examples.pinyin: yīshēng gěi tā cè le tǐwēn.
examples.english: The doctor took his temperature.

曾.meaning: once; formerly — used before the verb with 过/了 (他曾在北京工作 he once worked in Beijing); literary; spoken prefers 曾经

examples.hanzi: 他曾在中国留学三年。
examples.pinyin: tā céng zài Zhōngguó liúxué sān nián.
examples.english: He once studied in China for three years.

near_synonyms.difference: 曾经 looks back on a past experience that may be over (曾经住过); 已经 says an expected action is now complete (已经住了两年, still going)

曾经.meaning: once; previously (我曾经住在上海 I used to live in Shanghai; 曾经的朋友 a former friend)

examples.hanzi: 我曾经在乡下住过两年。
examples.pinyin: wǒ céngjīng zài xiāngxià zhù guò liǎng nián.
examples.english: I once lived in the countryside for two years.

测试.meaning: to test (测试软件 test software); a test (心理测试 a personality test)

examples.hanzi: 老师每周都测试我们的听力。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī měi zhōu dōu cèshì wǒmen de tīnglì.
examples.english: The teacher tests our listening every week.

插.meaning: to insert; to stick in (把钥匙插进锁里 insert the key into the lock; 插嘴 interrupt, cut in); to interpose (插花 flower arranging)

examples.hanzi: 他把钥匙插进锁里，打开了门。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ yàoshi chā jìn suǒ lǐ, dǎkāi le mén.
examples.english: He inserted the key into the lock and opened the door.

near_synonyms.difference: 差别 is a noun for a gap in degree; 区别 is both noun and verb, emphasizing classification rather than degree

差别.meaning: difference; disparity (城乡差别 the urban-rural gap; 两者没有多大差别 the two don't differ much)

examples.hanzi: 这两个词的意思没有多大差别。
examples.pinyin: zhè liǎng gè cí de yìsi méiyǒu duō dà chābié.
examples.english: These two words don't differ much in meaning.

拆.meaning: to tear open; to dismantle; to demolish (拆信 open a letter; 拆房子 demolish a house; 拆快递 open a package)

examples.hanzi: 工人正在拆旧房子。
examples.pinyin: gōngrén zhèngzài chāi jiù fángzi.
examples.english: The workers are demolishing the old houses.

差距.meaning: gap; disparity (贫富差距 the wealth gap; 差距很大 the gap is huge)

examples.hanzi: 两队之间的实力差距很大。
examples.pinyin: liǎng duì zhī jiān de shílì chājù hěn dà.
examples.english: The gap in strength between the two teams is huge.

产.meaning: to give birth to; to produce (产生 produce, give rise to); product; production — mostly in compounds 产品 product, 生产 produce, 产量 output

examples.hanzi: 这家工厂每月产一千辆汽车。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā gōngchǎng měi yuè chǎn yī qiān liàng qìchē.
examples.english: This factory produces a thousand cars a month.

长处.meaning: strong point; strength (发挥自己的长处 play to one's strengths)

examples.hanzi: 每个人都有自己的长处和短处。
examples.pinyin: měi gè rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de chángchù hé duǎnchù.
examples.english: Everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses.

长度.meaning: length (河流的长度 the river's length)

examples.hanzi: 这条河的长度是五千公里。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo hé de chángdù shì wǔ qiān gōnglǐ.
examples.english: The length of this river is five thousand kilometers.

长久.meaning: long-lasting; enduring (长久的友谊 a lasting friendship)

examples.hanzi: 我希望我们保持长久的友谊。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xīwàng wǒmen bǎochí chángjiǔ de yǒuyì.
examples.english: I hope we keep a long-lasting friendship.

长期.meaning: long-term; over a long period (长期合作 long-term cooperation; 长期以来 for a long time)

examples.hanzi: 他在国外长期工作了很多年。
examples.pinyin: tā zài guówài chángqī gōngzuò le hěn duō nián.
examples.english: He worked abroad for many years.

常识.meaning: common knowledge; common sense (生活常识 everyday common sense; 缺乏常识 lack common sense)

examples.hanzi: 多喝水有益健康，这是基本的常识。
examples.pinyin: duō hē shuǐ yǒuyì jiànkāng, zhè shì jīběn de chángshí.
examples.english: Drinking more water is good for you — that's basic common sense.

尝试.meaning: to attempt; to try (尝试新方法 try a new approach; 一次大胆的尝试 a bold attempt)

examples.hanzi: 我们应该尝试新的方法。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen yīnggāi chángshì xīn de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: We should try new methods.

场所.meaning: place; venue (公共场所 public places; 娱乐场所 places of entertainment)

examples.hanzi: 图书馆是学习的公共场所。
examples.pinyin: túshūguǎn shì xuéxí de gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: The library is a public place for studying.

长途.meaning: long-distance (长途电话 a long-distance call; 长途旅行 a long journey)

examples.hanzi: 打长途电话现在便宜多了。
examples.pinyin: dǎ chángtú diànhuà xiànzài piányi duō le.
examples.english: Long-distance calls are much cheaper now.

长远.meaning: long-term; far-reaching (长远利益 long-term interests; 从长远来看 in the long run)

examples.hanzi: 从长远来看，教育投资是值得的。
examples.pinyin: cóng chángyuǎn lái kàn, jiàoyù tóuzī shì zhídé de.
examples.english: In the long run, investing in education is worthwhile.

产量.meaning: output; yield (粮食产量 grain output; 提高产量 raise output)

examples.hanzi: 今年粮食产量比去年高。
examples.pinyin: jīnnián liángshi chǎnliàng bǐ qùnián gāo.
examples.english: This year's grain output is higher than last year's.

产品.meaning: product (电子产品 electronic products; 农产品 agricultural products)

examples.hanzi: 这家公司的产品质量很好。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā gōngsī de chǎnpǐn zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This company's products are very good quality.

产业.meaning: industry (文化产业 the culture industry; 第三产业 the tertiary industry)

examples.hanzi: 旅游业是当地的重要产业。
examples.pinyin: lǚyóuyè shì dāngdì de zhòngyào chǎnyè.
examples.english: Tourism is an important local industry.

朝.meaning: toward; facing (朝东走 walk eastward; 朝他笑 smile at him); dynasty (唐朝 the Tang dynasty); the imperial court; to face (朝着目标努力 strive toward the goal)

examples.hanzi: 窗户朝南，采光很好。
examples.pinyin: chuānghu cháo nán, cǎiguāng hěn hǎo.
examples.english: The window faces south, so the lighting is good.

朝.meaning: morning — only in compounds 朝阳 the morning sun, 朝夕 day and night

examples.hanzi: 朝阳升起来的时候，我们就出发。
examples.pinyin: zhāoyáng shēng qǐlái de shíhou, wǒmen jiù chūfā.
examples.english: We set off when the morning sun rises.

吵.meaning: to quarrel; to make noise (别吵了 stop arguing; 吵架 quarrel); noisy (太吵了 too noisy)

examples.hanzi: 隔壁太吵了，我睡不着。
examples.pinyin: gébì tài chǎo le, wǒ shuì bu zháo.
examples.english: Next door is too noisy; I can't sleep.

炒.meaning: to stir-fry (炒饭 fried rice; 炒菜 stir-fry vegetables); to speculate in (stocks); to fire someone — slang (被炒了 got fired)

examples.hanzi: 妈妈在厨房炒菜。
examples.pinyin: māma zài chúfáng chǎo cài.
examples.english: Mom is stir-frying vegetables in the kitchen.

超.meaning: to exceed; to surpass (超过 exceed); super-; ultra- (超市 supermarket; 超人 superman); ultra (超高清 ultra-HD)

examples.hanzi: 这次考试他的分数超过了我。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì kǎoshì tā de fēnshù chāoguò le wǒ.
examples.english: His score surpassed mine on this exam.

超出.meaning: to go beyond; to exceed (超出范围 exceed the scope; 超出预期 beyond expectations)

examples.hanzi: 这个问题超出了我的能力范围。
examples.pinyin: zhège wèntí chāochū le wǒ de nénglì fànwéi.
examples.english: This question goes beyond my ability.

超级.meaning: super; extremely (超级市场 supermarket; 超级好吃 super delicious)

examples.hanzi: 这家超市的东西超级便宜。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā chāoshì de dōngxi chāojí piányi.
examples.english: Things at this supermarket are super cheap.

超速.meaning: to speed; to drive over the limit (超速行驶 drive over the speed limit; 超速罚款 a speeding fine)

examples.hanzi: 他在高速公路上超速被罚了款。
examples.pinyin: tā zài gāosù gōnglù shàng chāosù bèi fá le kuǎn.
examples.english: He was fined for speeding on the highway.

叉子.meaning: fork (table utensil) (用叉子吃沙拉 eat salad with a fork)

examples.hanzi: 西方人用叉子吃沙拉。
examples.pinyin: Xīfāng rén yòng chāzi chī shālā.
examples.english: Westerners eat salad with a fork.

彻底.meaning: thorough; complete; utterly (彻底改变 change completely; 彻底解决 solve once and for all)

examples.hanzi: 他下决心彻底改掉坏习惯。
examples.pinyin: tā xià juéxīn chèdǐ gǎi diào huài xíguàn.
examples.english: He resolved to completely get rid of his bad habits.

车祸.meaning: traffic accident (发生车祸 have a traffic accident)

examples.hanzi: 昨天路口发生了一起车祸。
examples.pinyin: zuótiān lùkǒu fāshēng le yī qǐ chēhuò.
examples.english: A traffic accident occurred at the intersection yesterday.

车库.meaning: garage (把车开进车库 drive the car into the garage)

examples.hanzi: 他把车开进了车库。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ chē kāi jìn le chēkù.
examples.english: He drove the car into the garage.

车辆.meaning: vehicles (collectively) (车辆来往 vehicles coming and going; 禁止车辆通行 vehicles prohibited)

examples.hanzi: 高峰时段这座桥上车辆很多。
examples.pinyin: gāofēng shíduàn zhè zuò qiáo shàng chēliàng hěn duō.
examples.english: At rush hour there are many vehicles on this bridge.

沉.meaning: to sink (船沉了 the boat sank); heavy (箱子很沉 the box is heavy); deep (睡得很沉 in a deep sleep); to keep down one's feelings (沉默 silent; 沉住气 stay calm)

examples.hanzi: 石头掉进河里，很快就沉下去了。
examples.pinyin: shítou diào jìn hé lǐ, hěn kuài jiù chén xiàqu le.
examples.english: The stone fell into the river and quickly sank.

称1.meaning: to weigh (称重量 weigh out; 称一称 weigh it); to state; to call oneself (称呼 form of address; 简称 abbreviation; 名称 a name)

examples.hanzi: 请帮我称一下这些苹果多重。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bāng wǒ chēng yīxià zhèxiē píngguǒ duō zhòng.
examples.english: Please weigh these apples for me.

称2.meaning: to fit; to suit (称心 as one wishes; 对称 symmetrical; 匀称 well-proportioned)

examples.hanzi: 这份工作做得很称心。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn gōngzuò zuò de hěn chènxīn.
examples.english: This job is done entirely to my satisfaction.

成本.meaning: cost (生产成本 production costs; 降低成本 cut costs)

examples.hanzi: 公司想办法降低生产成本。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī xiǎng bànfǎ jiàngdī shēngchǎn chéngběn.
examples.english: The company is looking for ways to cut production costs.

承担.meaning: to bear; to undertake (responsibility, costs) (承担责任 take on responsibility; 承担费用 bear the costs)

examples.hanzi: 出了问题要勇于承担责任。
examples.pinyin: chū le wèntí yào yǒngyú chéngdān zérèn.
examples.english: When problems arise, one must dare to take responsibility.

程度.meaning: degree; level; extent (到某种程度 to a certain degree; 熟练程度 level of proficiency)

examples.hanzi: 他的汉语达到了流利的程度。
examples.pinyin: tā de Hànyǔ dádào le liúlì de chéngdù.
examples.english: His Chinese has reached the level of fluency.

成分.meaning: component; ingredient (化学成分 chemical composition); element; one's class background or social element

examples.hanzi: 标签上写着这种药的化学成分。
examples.pinyin: biāoqiān shàng xiě zhe zhè zhǒng yào de huàxué chéngfèn.
examples.english: The label lists the chemical ingredients of this medicine.

成果.meaning: achievement; result; fruit (of work) (研究成果 research results; 取得成果 achieve results)

examples.hanzi: 这项研究取得了重要的成果。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng yánjiū qǔdé le zhòngyào de chéngguǒ.
examples.english: This research achieved important results.

成就.meaning: achievement; accomplishment (很大的成就 a great accomplishment); to achieve (成就了一番事业 achieved a career)

examples.hanzi: 他一生取得了很大的成就。
examples.pinyin: tā yīshēng qǔdé le hěn dà de chéngjiù.
examples.english: He achieved a great deal in his life.

成立.meaning: to establish; to found (公司成立于1990年 the company was founded in 1990); to hold true (条件成立 the condition holds)

examples.hanzi: 这家公司成立于二零一零年。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā gōngsī chénglì yú èr líng yī líng nián.
examples.english: This company was founded in 2010.

成年1.meaning: adulthood; adult (成年人的责任 an adult's responsibilities; 未成年 a minor)

examples.hanzi: 成年以后要对自己的行为负责。
examples.pinyin: chéngnián yǐhòu yào duì zìjǐ de xíngwéi fùzé.
examples.english: After reaching adulthood you must answer for your own behavior.

城区.meaning: city district; urban area (老城区 the old town; 城区人口 the urban population)

examples.hanzi: 老城区的街道又窄又热闹。
examples.pinyin: lǎo chéngqū de jiēdào yòu zhǎi yòu rènao.
examples.english: The old town's streets are narrow and lively.

成人.meaning: adult (成人教育 adult education; 成人票 an adult ticket)

examples.hanzi: 这张票成人两百元，儿童半价。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng piào chéngrén liǎng bǎi yuán, értóng bànjià.
examples.english: This ticket is two hundred yuan for adults, half price for children.

承认.meaning: to admit; to acknowledge; to recognize (承认错误 admit a mistake; 承认新政府 recognize the new government)

examples.hanzi: 他承认了自己的错误。
examples.pinyin: tā chéngrèn le zìjǐ de cuòwù.
examples.english: He admitted his mistake.

承受.meaning: to bear; to endure (承受压力 bear pressure; 承受能力强 can endure a lot)

examples.hanzi: 这份工作要承受很大的压力。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn gōngzuò yào chéngshòu hěn dà de yālì.
examples.english: This job requires bearing a lot of pressure.

成熟.meaning: ripe (果子成熟了 the fruit is ripe); mature (成熟的态度 a mature attitude; 技术成熟 the technology is mature)

examples.hanzi: 秋天院子里的果子成熟了。
examples.pinyin: qiūtiān yuànzi lǐ de guǒzi chéngshú le.
examples.english: The fruit in the courtyard ripened in autumn.

称为.meaning: to be called; to call; to term (被称为… be known as …; 把这种做法称为绿色农业 call this practice green agriculture)

examples.hanzi: 北京被称为中国的政治文化中心。
examples.pinyin: Běijīng bèi chēngwéi Zhōngguó de zhèngzhì wénhuà zhōngxīn.
examples.english: Beijing is called China's political and cultural center.

乘务员.meaning: crew member (on a train, plane, or bus) (列车乘务员 a train attendant)

examples.hanzi: 列车乘务员帮旅客找到了座位。
examples.pinyin: lièchē chéngwùyuán bāng lǚkè zhǎodào le zuòwèi.
examples.english: The train attendant helped the passengers find their seats.

程序.meaning: program (software) (手机程序 a phone app; 编写程序 write a program); procedure; sequence (会议程序 the meeting agenda)

examples.hanzi: 工程师正在测试新程序。
examples.pinyin: gōngchéngshī zhèngzài cèshì xīn chéngxù.
examples.english: The engineer is testing the new program.

成员.meaning: member (家庭成员 family members; 团队成员 team members)

examples.hanzi: 他是这个团队中最年轻的成员。
examples.pinyin: tā shì zhège tuánduì zhōng zuì niánqīng de chéngyuán.
examples.english: He is the youngest member of this team.

称赞.meaning: to praise; to commend (受到称赞 receive praise; 称赞他的勇气 praise his courage)

examples.hanzi: 老师称赞了她的进步。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī chēngzàn le tā de jìnbù.
examples.english: The teacher praised her progress.

成长.meaning: to grow up; to grow (of a person or business) (孩子的成长 a child's growth; 在实践中成长 grow through practice)

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在阳光下健康成长。
examples.pinyin: háizimen zài yángguāng xià jiànkāng chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The children are growing up healthily in the sunshine.

examples.hanzi: 这个橙子又甜又多汁。
examples.pinyin: zhège chéngzi yòu tián yòu duōzhī.
examples.english: This orange is sweet and juicy.

沉默.meaning: silent; taciturn (保持沉默 remain silent; 沉默寡言 of few words)

examples.hanzi: 整个会议期间他都保持沉默。
examples.pinyin: zhěnggè huìyì qījiān tā dōu bǎochí chénmò.
examples.english: He remained silent throughout the whole meeting.

车厢.meaning: railway carriage; train car (第一节车厢 the first carriage)

examples.hanzi: 我的座位在第二节车厢。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de zuòwèi zài dì èr jié chēxiāng.
examples.english: My seat is in the second carriage.

车主.meaning: car owner (车主的责任 the car owner's responsibility)

examples.hanzi: 车主在停车场等警察来。
examples.pinyin: chēzhǔ zài tíngchēchǎng děng jǐngchá lái.
examples.english: The car owner waited for the police in the parking lot.

池.meaning: pool; pond (游泳池 swimming pool; 鱼池 fish pond); measure-word-like use 一池荷花 a pond of lotus)

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在游泳池里玩水。
examples.pinyin: háizimen zài yóuyǒngchí lǐ wán shuǐ.
examples.english: The children are playing in the water in the swimming pool.

翅膀.meaning: wing (鸡翅膀 chicken wings; 鸟的翅膀 a bird's wings)

examples.hanzi: 小鸟展开翅膀飞走了。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo niǎo zhǎnkāi chìbǎng fēi zǒu le.
examples.english: The little bird spread its wings and flew away.

持续.meaning: to continue; to last; sustained (雨持续了三天 the rain lasted three days; 持续发展 sustained development)

examples.hanzi: 这场雨持续下了三天。
examples.pinyin: zhè cháng yǔ chíxù xià le sān tiān.
examples.english: This rain lasted three days.

尺子.meaning: ruler (用尺子量 measure with a ruler)

examples.hanzi: 他用尺子量了桌子的长度。
examples.pinyin: tā yòng chǐzi liáng le zhuōzi de chángdù.
examples.english: He measured the length of the desk with a ruler.

冲.meaning: to rush; to dash (冲出去 dash out; 冲进教室 rush into the classroom); to rinse; to flush (冲马桶 flush the toilet; 冲洗 rinse); to brew (冲咖啡 brew coffee)

examples.hanzi: 他一听到铃声就冲出了教室。
examples.pinyin: tā yī tīng dào língshēng jiù chōng chū le jiàoshì.
examples.english: He rushed out of the classroom as soon as the bell rang.

冲.meaning: (of smell) strong; pungent (味儿太冲 the smell is too strong); facing (冲南 facing south)

examples.hanzi: 这屋子的窗户冲着大街，很吵。
examples.pinyin: zhè wūzi de chuānghu chòng zhe dàjiē, hěn chǎo.
examples.english: This room's windows face the street, so it's noisy.

充电.meaning: to charge (a battery or device) (给手机充电 charge the phone); to recharge oneself — refresh one's knowledge (去培训充电 go get retrained)

examples.hanzi: 睡觉前别忘了给手机充电。
examples.pinyin: shuì jiào qián bié wàng le gěi shǒujī chōngdiàn.
examples.english: Don't forget to charge your phone before bed.

near_synonyms.difference: 充分 describes abstract adequacy (充分的理由/准备); 充足 describes concrete supply quantity (光线/时间充足)

充分.meaning: ample; sufficient; full (充分的准备 thorough preparation; 充分利用 make full use of)

examples.hanzi: 考试前要做好充分的准备。
examples.pinyin: kǎoshì qián yào zuò hǎo chōngfèn de zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: Make thorough preparations before the exam.

重复.meaning: to repeat; repetition (重复一遍 say it again; 避免重复 avoid duplication)

examples.hanzi: 请你把这个词重复一遍。
examples.pinyin: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhège cí chóngfù yī biàn.
examples.english: Please repeat this word once more.

充满.meaning: to be full of; to fill with (充满信心 full of confidence; 空气中充满花香 the air is filled with the scent of flowers)

examples.hanzi: 孩子们对未来充满了希望。
examples.pinyin: háizimen duì wèilái chōngmǎn le xīwàng.
examples.english: The children are full of hope for the future.

宠物.meaning: pet (养宠物 keep a pet; 宠物医院 a pet hospital)

examples.hanzi: 她养了一只猫当宠物。
examples.pinyin: tā yǎng le yī zhī māo dāng chǒngwù.
examples.english: She keeps a cat as a pet.

充值.meaning: to top up; to recharge (an account or card) (给交通卡充值 top up the transit card)

examples.hanzi: 我每个月都给交通卡充值。
examples.pinyin: wǒ měi gè yuè dōu gěi jiāotōngkǎ chōngzhí.
examples.english: I top up my transit card every month.

虫子.meaning: insect; bug; worm (菜叶子上有虫子 there are bugs on the vegetable leaves)

examples.hanzi: 菜叶上有一条小虫子。
examples.pinyin: càiyè shàng yǒu yī tiáo xiǎo chóngzi.
examples.english: There is a small bug on the vegetable leaf.

充足.meaning: abundant; sufficient (光线充足 well-lit; 时间充足 plenty of time)

examples.hanzi: 这间屋子光线充足。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiān wūzi guāngxiàn chōngzú.
examples.english: This room has plenty of light.

臭.meaning: stinky; smelly (臭豆腐 stinky tofu; 鱼臭了 the fish has gone bad); terrible; lousy (棋下得臭 plays chess terribly)

examples.hanzi: 这块奶酪闻起来很臭。
examples.pinyin: zhè kuài nǎilào wén qǐlái hěn chòu.
examples.english: This cheese smells very stinky.

丑.meaning: ugly (长得丑 good-looking-ugly, i.e. plain ugly); disgraceful (家丑 family shame; 出丑 make a fool of oneself)

examples.hanzi: 这只小狗长得并不丑。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu zhǎng de bìng bù chǒu.
examples.english: This puppy is not ugly at all.

抽.meaning: to draw out; to pull out (抽屉 drawer; 抽出时间 find time); to draw lots (抽签 draw lots); to smoke (a cigarette) (抽烟 smoke); to whip (抽一鞭 give a whip)

examples.hanzi: 他忙里抽空去看了医生。
examples.pinyin: tā máng lǐ chōukòng qù kàn le yīshēng.
examples.english: He squeezed in time from his busy schedule to see a doctor.

处.meaning: place; spot (好处 good point; 办事处 office; 到处 everywhere)

examples.hanzi: 这个小镇到处都是游客。
examples.pinyin: zhège xiǎo zhèn dào chù dōu shì yóukè.
examples.english: This little town is full of tourists everywhere.

处.meaning: to handle; to get along with (处理 handle; 相处 get along; 处于 be situated in)

examples.hanzi: 同事之间要友好相处。
examples.pinyin: tóngshì zhī jiān yào yǒuhǎo xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: Colleagues should get along well with each other.

初.meaning: beginning; first; early (初中 junior high; 初学者 beginner; 月初 the start of the month; 初次 the first time; 当初 at the outset)

examples.hanzi: 这个月初我要出差。
examples.pinyin: zhège yuè chū wǒ yào chūchāi.
examples.english: I'm going on a business trip at the start of this month.

传.meaning: to pass; to transmit (传给下一代 pass on to the next generation; 传消息 pass on news); to spread (传说 spread as legend)

examples.hanzi: 这个民间故事代代相传。
examples.pinyin: zhège mínjiān gùshi dàidài xiāngchuán.
examples.english: This folk tale has been passed down through generations.

传.meaning: biography (人物传记 a biography; 自传 an autobiography; 水浒传 Water Margin — a novel title)

examples.hanzi: 他正在读一本名人传。
examples.pinyin: tā zhèngzài dú yī běn míngrén zhuàn.
examples.english: He is reading a biography of a famous person.

传播.meaning: to spread; to disseminate (传播疾病 spread disease; 传播信息 spread information)

examples.hanzi: 网络让信息传播得更快。
examples.pinyin: wǎngluò ràng xìnxī chuánbō de gèng kuài.
examples.english: The internet makes information spread faster.

传递.meaning: to pass on; to transmit; to relay (传递包裹 pass on a parcel; 传递正能量 spread positive energy)

examples.hanzi: 火炬手一个接一个传递着火炬。
examples.pinyin: huǒjù shǒu yī gè jiē yī gè chuándì zhe huǒjù.
examples.english: The torchbearers passed the torch one after another.

床单.meaning: bed sheet (换床单 change the sheets)

examples.hanzi: 她每个星期都换床单。
examples.pinyin: tā měi gè xīngqī dōu huàn chuángdān.
examples.english: She changes the bed sheets every week.

窗台.meaning: windowsill (把花放在窗台上 put the flowers on the windowsill)

examples.hanzi: 妈妈把花盆放在了窗台上。
examples.pinyin: māma bǎ huāpén fàng zài le chuāngtái shàng.
examples.english: Mom put the flowerpot on the windowsill.

创新.meaning: to innovate; innovation (科技创新 technological innovation; 创新能力 ability to innovate)

examples.hanzi: 企业要发展就必须不断创新。
examples.pinyin: qǐyè yào fāzhǎn jiù bìxū bùduàn chuàngxīn.
examples.english: Companies must keep innovating to grow.

创业.meaning: to start a business; entrepreneurship (大学毕业以后他想创业 after graduating he wants to start a business)

examples.hanzi: 他大学毕业后决定自己创业。
examples.pinyin: tā dàxué bìyè hòu juédìng zìjǐ chuàngyè.
examples.english: After graduating from university he decided to start his own business.

创造.meaning: to create; to produce (创造价值 create value; 创造奇迹 work a miracle)

examples.hanzi: 劳动人民创造了灿烂的文化。
examples.pinyin: láodòng rénmín chuàngzào le cànlàn de wénhuà.
examples.english: The working people created a splendid culture.

创作.meaning: to create (works of art or literature) (创作小说 write a novel; 文学创作 literary creation)

examples.hanzi: 这位作家创作了很多小说。
examples.pinyin: zhè wèi zuòjiā chuàngzuò le hěn duō xiǎoshuō.
examples.english: This writer has created many novels.

传说.meaning: legend (古老的传说 an ancient legend); it is said; rumor has it (传说他要结婚了 rumor has it he's getting married)

examples.hanzi: 这是一个古老的传说。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì yī gè gǔlǎo de chuánshuō.
examples.english: This is an ancient legend.

传统.meaning: tradition; traditional (中国的传统 Chinese traditions; 传统节日 traditional festivals)

examples.hanzi: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjié shì Zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de chuántǒng jiérì.
examples.english: Spring Festival is China's most important traditional festival.

出版.meaning: to publish (a book or magazine) (出版了一本新书 published a new book; 出版社 publishing house)

examples.hanzi: 他的第一本书去年出版了。
examples.pinyin: tā de dì yī běn shū qùnián chūbǎn le.
examples.english: His first book was published last year.

初级.meaning: elementary; beginner level (初级班 a beginner class; 初级阶段 the initial stage)

examples.hanzi: 我是初学者，报了初级班。
examples.pinyin: wǒ shì chūxuézhě, bào le chūjí bān.
examples.english: I'm a beginner and signed up for the elementary class.

处理.meaning: to handle; to deal with; to process (处理问题 handle a problem; 垃圾处理 waste processing)

examples.hanzi: 经理正在处理客户的投诉。
examples.pinyin: jīnglǐ zhèngzài chǔlǐ kèhù de tóusù.
examples.english: The manager is handling the customer's complaint.

初期.meaning: initial stage; early period (二十世纪初期 the early twentieth century; 治疗初期 the early phase of treatment)

examples.pinyin: zhìliáo chūqī tā gǎndào hěn píláo.

出色.meaning: outstanding; excellent (表现很出色 performed brilliantly; 出色的成绩 outstanding results)

examples.hanzi: 她在比赛中的表现非常出色。
examples.pinyin: tā zài bǐsài zhōng de biǎoxiàn fēicháng chūsè.
examples.english: Her performance in the competition was outstanding.

出售.meaning: to sell; to offer for sale (对外出售 for external sale; 出售二手车 sell a used car)

examples.hanzi: 这家店出售各种电子产品。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn chūshòu gè zhǒng diànzǐ chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This store sells all kinds of electronic products.

除夕.meaning: New Year's Eve (Chinese lunar) (除夕夜 New Year's Eve night)

examples.pinyin: chúxī wǎnshang quán jiā rén yīqǐ chī niányèfàn.

出席.meaning: to attend (a formal occasion) (出席会议 attend a meeting; 出席婚礼 attend a wedding)

examples.hanzi: 校长出席了毕业典礼。
examples.pinyin: xiàozhǎng chūxí le bìyè diǎnlǐ.
examples.english: The principal attended the graduation ceremony.

处于.meaning: to be situated in; to be in (a state or position) (处于危险之中 in danger; 处于领先地位 in the lead)

examples.hanzi: 公司目前处于困难时期。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī mùqián chǔyú kùnnán shíqī.
examples.english: The company is currently in a difficult period.

出自.meaning: to come from; to originate from (这句话出自《论语》 this saying comes from the Analects of Confucius)

examples.hanzi: 这句话出自一本古代小说。
examples.pinyin: zhè jù huà chū zì yī běn gǔdài xiǎoshuō.
examples.english: This saying comes from an ancient novel.

此后.meaning: after this; from then on (此后他再没来过 he never came again after that)

examples.hanzi: 他毕业后去了国外，此后我们再没见过面。
examples.pinyin: tā bìyè hòu qù le guówài, cǐhòu wǒmen zài méi jiànguò miàn.
examples.english: He went abroad after graduation, and from then on we never met again.

词汇.meaning: vocabulary; words (丰富词汇 enrich one's vocabulary; 汉语词汇 Chinese vocabulary)

examples.hanzi: 读小说可以丰富我们的词汇。
examples.pinyin: dú xiǎoshuō kěyǐ fēngfù wǒmen de cíhuì.
examples.english: Reading novels can enrich our vocabulary.

刺激.meaning: to stimulate (刺激经济 stimulate the economy); stimulus; thrill (寻求刺激 seek thrills); exciting (很刺激 thrilling)

examples.pinyin: guòshānchē shì hěn cìjī de yóuxì.

examples.hanzi: 此前他从未离开过家乡。
examples.pinyin: cǐqián tā cóngwèi líkāi guò jiāxiāng.

此时.meaning: this moment; at this point (此时此刻 at this very moment)

examples.pinyin: cǐshí cǐkè, wǒ fēicháng gǎnxiè dàjiā.
examples.english: At this very moment I am deeply grateful to everyone.

辞职.meaning: to resign; to quit a job (他上个月辞职了 he resigned last month)

examples.hanzi: 他上个月向公司提出了辞职。
examples.pinyin: tā shàng gè yuè xiàng gōngsī tí chū le cízhí.
examples.english: Last month he submitted his resignation to the company.

从不.meaning: never (他从不迟到 he is never late)

examples.hanzi: 他从不抽烟，也很少喝酒。
examples.pinyin: tā cóngbù chōu yān, yě hěn shǎo hē jiǔ.
examples.english: He never smokes and seldom drinks.

从而.meaning: thereby; thus (改善了交通，从而减少了事故 improved transport, thereby reducing accidents)

examples.hanzi: 地铁修好了，从而方便了市民出行。
examples.pinyin: dìtiě xiū hǎo le, cóng'ér biànli le shìmín chūxíng.
examples.english: The subway was completed, thereby making travel easier for residents.

从前.meaning: in the past; formerly; once upon a time (从前的老朋友 old friends from the past)

examples.hanzi: 从前这里是一个安静的小渔村。
examples.pinyin: cóngqián zhèlǐ shì yī gè ānjìng de xiǎo yúcūn.

从事.meaning: to engage in; to work in (a profession) (从事教育工作 work in education)

examples.pinyin: tā cóngshì jiàoyù gōngzuò èrshí nián le.

催.meaning: to urge; to press; to rush someone (别催我 don't rush me; 催他快点 hurry him up)

examples.pinyin: bié cuī wǒ, wǒ mǎshàng jiù hǎo.
examples.english: Don't rush me; I'll be done in a moment.

促进.meaning: to promote; to advance (促进交流 promote exchange; 促进经济发展 promote economic growth)

examples.hanzi: 这次活动促进了两国之间的交流。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì huódòng cùjìn le liǎng guó zhī jiān de jiāoliú.
examples.english: This event promoted exchange between the two countries.

存放.meaning: to store; to leave something for safekeeping (把行李存放在车站 store luggage at the station)

examples.hanzi: 旅客可以把行李存放在车站。
examples.pinyin: lǚkè kěyǐ bǎ xíngli cúnfàng zài chēzhàn.
examples.english: Passengers can store their luggage at the station.

存款.meaning: bank deposit; savings (银行存款 bank savings; 定期存款 a fixed-term deposit); to deposit money

examples.hanzi: 他们的银行存款足够买一套房子。
examples.pinyin: tāmen de yínháng cúnkuǎn zúgòu mǎi yī tào fángzi.
examples.english: Their bank savings are enough to buy an apartment.

存在.meaning: to exist; existence (问题依然存在 the problem still exists; 客观存在 objective existence)

examples.hanzi: 两个方案都存在一些问题。
examples.pinyin: liǎng gè fāng'àn dōu cúnzài yīxiē wèntí.
examples.english: Both plans have some problems.

措施.meaning: measure; step (采取有效措施 take effective measures)

examples.hanzi: 政府采取了有效措施治理污染。
examples.pinyin: zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ le yǒuxiào cuòshī zhìlǐ wūrǎn.
examples.english: The government took effective measures to control pollution.

促使.meaning: to impel; to prompt (促使他改变主意 prompted him to change his mind)

examples.hanzi: 这件事促使他重新思考人生。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì cùshǐ tā chóngxīn sīkǎo rénshēng.
examples.english: This matter prompted him to rethink his life.

促销.meaning: to promote sales; sales promotion (节日促销 holiday sales; 促销活动 a promotional campaign)

examples.hanzi: 商场在节日里搞大规模促销。
examples.pinyin: shāngchǎng zài jiérì lǐ gǎo dà guīmó cùxiāo.
examples.english: The mall holds large-scale sales promotions during holidays.

打扮.meaning: to dress up; to make oneself up (她打扮得很漂亮 she dressed up beautifully; 节日的打扮 festive attire)

examples.hanzi: 她今天打扮得特别漂亮。
examples.pinyin: tā jīntiān dǎban de tèbié piàoliang.
examples.english: She is dressed up especially beautifully today.

打包.meaning: to pack up (leftovers at a restaurant) (吃不完就打包 if you can't finish it, get it boxed up); to bundle (software) (打包下载 download as a bundle)

examples.hanzi: 菜没吃完，我们打包带走吧。
examples.pinyin: cài méi chī wán, wǒmen dǎbāo dài zǒu ba.

examples.pinyin: shuāngfāng zuìzhōng dáchéng le xiéyì.
examples.english: The two sides finally reached an agreement.

大胆.meaning: bold; daring (大胆的尝试 a bold attempt; 大胆说出自己的想法 speak one's mind boldly)

examples.pinyin: kètáng shàng yào dàdǎn de fābiǎo zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.english: In class you should boldly voice your opinions.

打断.meaning: to interrupt; to break off (打断他的话 interrupt him; 打断了思路 broke one's train of thought)

examples.hanzi: 对不起，打断一下，我有问题问。
examples.pinyin: duìbuqǐ, dǎduàn yīxià, wǒ yǒu wèntí wèn.
examples.english: Sorry to interrupt — I have a question.

大多.meaning: mostly; for the most part (学生大多是本地人 the students are mostly locals)

examples.hanzi: 这栋楼里住的大多是年轻人。
examples.pinyin: zhè dòng lóu lǐ zhù de dàduō shì niánqīngrén.
examples.english: Most of the people living in this building are young.

大会.meaning: general meeting; plenary congress; rally (会员大会 the members' general meeting; 运动会 a sports meet)

examples.hanzi: 公司下周召开年度大会。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī xià zhōu kāihuì niándù dàhuì.
examples.english: The company holds its annual general meeting next week.

代.meaning: generation (一代人 a generation; 下一代 the next generation); era (唐代 the Tang era); to substitute; to act on behalf of (代替 replace; 代表 represent; 代课 teach in someone's place)

examples.hanzi: 我们这一代人的生活比过去好多了。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zhè yī dài rén de shēnghuó bǐ guòqù hǎo duō le.
examples.english: Our generation's life is much better than the past.

代表.meaning: to represent; on behalf of (代表公司发言 speak on behalf of the company); representative; delegate (学生代表 a student representative)

examples.hanzi: 他代表公司参加了会议。
examples.pinyin: tā dàibiǎo gōngsī cānjiā le huìyì.
examples.english: He attended the meeting on behalf of the company.

带动.meaning: to drive; to spur; to bring along (带动经济发展 drive economic growth; 带动年轻人参与 spur young people to take part)

examples.hanzi: 旅游业带动了当地经济的发展。
examples.pinyin: lǚyóuyè dàidòng le dāngdì jīngjì de fāzhǎn.
examples.english: Tourism has driven the local economy's development.

代替.meaning: to replace; to substitute for (用电子邮件代替信件 replace letters with email)

examples.hanzi: 机器人正在代替人做一些危险的工作。
examples.pinyin: jīqìrén zhèngzài dàitì rén zuò yīxiē wēixiǎn de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Robots are replacing humans for some dangerous work.

待遇.meaning: treatment (of employees); pay and benefits (福利待遇 pay and benefits; 受到不公平的待遇 receive unfair treatment)

examples.hanzi: 这家公司的待遇很好。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā gōngsī de dàiyù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This company's pay and benefits are very good.

大力.meaning: vigorously; energetically (大力发展 vigorously develop; 大力支持 strongly support)

examples.hanzi: 政府大力发展新能源汽车。
examples.pinyin: zhèngfǔ dàlì fāzhǎn xīn néngyuán qìchē.
examples.english: The government is vigorously developing new-energy vehicles.

大妈.meaning: auntie; middle-aged woman (跳广场舞的大妈 the aunties dancing in the square)

examples.hanzi: 广场上很多大妈在跳舞。
examples.pinyin: guǎngchǎng shàng hěn duō dàmā zài tiào wǔ.
examples.english: Many aunties are dancing in the square.

大米.meaning: rice (uncooked) (一斤大米 a jin of rice)

examples.hanzi: 南方人主要以大米为主食。
examples.pinyin: nánfāng rén zhǔyào yǐ dàmǐ wéi zhǔshí.
examples.english: Southerners mainly eat rice as their staple food.

淡.meaning: light; bland (in taste or color) (味道太淡 too bland; 颜色很淡 a pale color); indifferent (淡淡地笑了笑 gave a faint smile); slack (生意清淡 business is slow)

examples.hanzi: 这个菜味道太淡了，再加点儿盐吧。
examples.pinyin: zhège cài wèidào tài dàn le, zài jiā yīdiǎnr yán ba.
examples.english: This dish is too bland; add a bit more salt.

单.meaning: list; form; bill (菜单 the menu; 名单 a name list; 账单 the bill); single; odd (单人床 a single bed; 单数 an odd number); alone (孤单 lonely; 单独 alone)

examples.hanzi: 服务员把账单送来了。
examples.pinyin: fúwùyuán bǎ zhàngdān sòng lái le.
examples.english: The waiter brought the bill.

examples.hanzi: 睡眠对大脑的发育非常重要。
examples.pinyin: shuìmián duì dànǎo de fāyù fēicháng zhòngyào.
examples.english: Sleep is very important for brain development.

单独.meaning: alone; by oneself; separate (单独行动 act alone; 单独谈一谈 talk privately)

examples.hanzi: 老师想和你单独谈一谈。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī xiǎng hé nǐ dāndú tán yī tán.
examples.english: The teacher wants to talk with you alone.

当.meaning: to serve as; to work as (当老师 work as a teacher); to be (someone) at the moment of (当我到家 when I got home); ought; to treat as (把我当朋友 treat me as a friend); that very (当天 that same day)

examples.hanzi: 当他到家的时候，饭已经做好了。
examples.pinyin: dāng tā dào jiā de shíhou, fàn yǐjīng zuò hǎo le.
examples.english: When he got home, the meal was already ready.

当.meaning: to regard as; to treat as — used mainly in compounds 当作/当成 treat as; also to pawn (当铺 pawnshop); proper (恰当 appropriate; 典当 pawn)

examples.hanzi: 他把我当成了自己的亲哥哥。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ wǒ dàng chéng le zìjǐ de qīn gēge.
examples.english: He treats me as his own older brother.

挡.meaning: to block; to obstruct; to shield (挡路 block the way; 用手挡住 shield with one's hand; 挡风 keep out the wind)

examples.hanzi: 那辆卡车挡住了我们的路。
examples.pinyin: nà liàng kǎchē dǎng zhù le wǒmen de lù.
examples.english: That truck blocked our way.

当成.meaning: to treat as; to take for (把这句话当成玩笑 take this remark as a joke)

examples.hanzi: 别把他的话当成玩笑。
examples.pinyin: bié bǎ tā de huà dàngchéng wánxiào.
examples.english: Don't take his words as a joke.

当地.meaning: local (place) (当地的风俗 local customs; 当地人 locals)

examples.hanzi: 我们要尊重当地的风俗习惯。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen yào zūnzhòng dāngdì de fēngsú xíguàn.
examples.english: We should respect local customs.

当年.meaning: in those years; back then (想当年 back in the day); the prime of one's life (正值当年 in one's prime)

examples.hanzi: 想当年，这里还是一片农田。
examples.pinyin: xiǎng dāngnián, zhèlǐ háishì yī piàn nóngtián.
examples.english: Back in the day, this was all farmland.

当年.meaning: the same year (他1990年毕业，当年就工作了 he graduated in 1990 and started work that very year)

examples.hanzi: 他二零一五年毕业，当年就找到了工作。
examples.pinyin: tā èr líng yī wǔ nián bìyè, dàngnián jiù zhǎodào le gōngzuò.
examples.english: He graduated in 2015 and found a job that very year.

当前.meaning: present; current (当前的形势 the current situation; 当前任务 the task at hand)

examples.hanzi: 当前最重要的是解决资金问题。
examples.pinyin: dāngqián zuì zhòngyào de shì jiějué zījīn wèntí.
examples.english: The most important thing at present is solving the funding problem.

当中.meaning: among; in the middle of (同学们当中 among the classmates; 房间当中 in the middle of the room)

examples.hanzi: 同学们当中他的口语最好。
examples.pinyin: tóngxuémen dāngzhōng tā de kǒuyǔ zuì hǎo.
examples.english: Among the classmates his spoken Chinese is the best.

当作.meaning: to treat as; to regard as (把客人当作家人 treat guests as family)

examples.hanzi: 他把图书馆当作第二个家。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ túshūguǎn dàngzuò dì èr gè jiā.
examples.english: He treats the library as his second home.

担任.meaning: to hold (a post); to serve as (担任班长 serve as class monitor; 担任经理 work as manager)

examples.hanzi: 她担任这家医院的院长。
examples.pinyin: tā dānrèn zhè jiā yīyuàn de yuànzhǎng.
examples.english: She serves as the director of this hospital.

胆小.meaning: timid; cowardly (胆小如鼠 as timid as a mouse; 他从小就胆小 he's been timid since childhood)

examples.hanzi: 他从小胆小，不敢一个人睡觉。
examples.pinyin: tā cóngxiǎo dǎnxiǎo, bù gǎn yī gè rén shuì jiào.
examples.english: He has been timid since childhood and dare not sleep alone.

单一.meaning: single; uniform; homogeneous (颜色单一 monochrome; 经济结构单一 a homogeneous economic structure)

examples.hanzi: 这个国家的经济结构比较单一。
examples.pinyin: zhège guójiā de jīngjì jiégòu bǐjiào dānyī.
examples.english: This country's economic structure is rather homogeneous.

单元.meaning: unit (in an apartment building) (三号楼二单元 Unit 2, Building 3); unit (of a textbook) (第五单元 Unit 5)

examples.hanzi: 我们住在三号楼二单元。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zhù zài sān hào lóu èr dānyuán.
examples.english: We live in Unit 2, Building 3.

倒.meaning: to fall over; to collapse (他累倒了 he collapsed from exhaustion; 大树倒了 the tree fell); to fail; to close down (公司倒闭了 the firm went under); to transfer goods (倒买倒卖 buy and resell)

examples.hanzi: 大风把路边的树刮倒了。
examples.pinyin: dà fēng bǎ lù biān de shù guā dǎo le.
examples.english: The strong wind blew down the trees by the road.

倒.meaning: to pour; to tip out (倒茶 pour tea; 倒垃圾 take out the trash); to reverse (倒车 back up a car; 倒着走 walk backwards)

examples.hanzi: 他给客人倒了一杯茶。
examples.pinyin: tā gěi kèrén dào le yī bēi chá.
examples.english: He poured the guest a cup of tea.

到达.meaning: to arrive at; to reach (火车到达北京 the train arrives in Beijing; 顺利到达 arrive safely)

examples.hanzi: 火车准时到达了北京。
examples.pinyin: huǒchē zhǔnshí dàodá le Běijīng.
examples.english: The train arrived in Beijing on time.

道理.meaning: reason; logic; principle (有道理 it makes sense; 懂道理 sensible; 讲道理 be reasonable)

examples.hanzi: 他说的话很有道理。
examples.pinyin: tā shuō de huà hěn yǒu dàolǐ.
examples.english: What he said makes a lot of sense.

到期.meaning: to expire; to fall due (合同到期 the contract expires; 护照到期了 the passport has expired)

examples.hanzi: 我的租房合同下个月就到期了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de zūfáng hétong xià gè yuè jiù dàoqī le.
examples.english: My rental contract expires next month.

导演.meaning: director (of a film or play) (著名导演 a famous director); to direct (a film)

examples.hanzi: 这位导演拍过很多有名的电影。
examples.pinyin: zhè wèi dǎoyǎn pāi guò hěn duō yǒumíng de diànyǐng.
examples.english: This director has made many famous films.

导致.meaning: to lead to; to result in (导致失败 lead to failure; 导致交通堵塞 cause a traffic jam)

examples.hanzi: 大雨导致了航班取消。
examples.pinyin: dà yǔ dǎozhì le hángbān qǔxiāo.
examples.english: The heavy rain led to flight cancellations.

大批.meaning: large quantities of; a large batch of (大批游客 large numbers of tourists)

examples.hanzi: 节日期间大批游客来到这里。
examples.pinyin: jiérì qījiān dàpī yóukè lái dào zhèlǐ.
examples.english: Large numbers of tourists come here during the holidays.

打破.meaning: to break; to smash (a record or rule) (打破纪录 break a record; 打破沉默 break the silence)

examples.hanzi: 他打破了学校一百米的纪录。
examples.pinyin: tā dǎpò le xuéxiào yī bǎi mǐ de jìlù.
examples.english: He broke the school record for the hundred meters.

大厦.meaning: mansion; large building (办公大厦 an office tower)

examples.hanzi: 这座办公大厦有一百层高。
examples.pinyin: zhè zuò bàngōng dàshà yǒu yī bǎi céng gāo.
examples.english: This office tower is a hundred stories tall.

大事.meaning: major event; big issue (国家大事 affairs of state; 一件大事 a major event)

examples.hanzi: 结婚是一个人一生中的大事。
examples.pinyin: jiéhūn shì yī gè rén yīshēng zhōng de dàshì.
examples.english: Getting married is a major event in one's life.

打听.meaning: to ask about; to inquire (打听消息 ask around for news; 跟他打听一下 ask him about it)

examples.hanzi: 我帮他打听了一下火车的时间。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bāng tā dǎting le yīxià huǒchē de shíjiān.
examples.english: I asked around about the train times for him.

大象.meaning: elephant (大象的鼻子 an elephant's trunk)

examples.hanzi: 大象是陆地上最大的动物。
examples.pinyin: dàxiàng shì lùdì shàng zuì dà de dòngwù.
examples.english: The elephant is the largest animal on land.

大型.meaning: large-scale (大型活动 a large-scale event; 大型企业 a large enterprise)

examples.hanzi: 上海举办过大型国际展览会。
examples.pinyin: Shànghǎi jǔbàn guò dàxíng guójì zhǎnlǎnhuì.
examples.english: Shanghai has held large-scale international exhibitions.

大爷.meaning: uncle (father's elder brother); respectful term for an elderly man (隔壁的大爷 the old man next door)

examples.hanzi: 隔壁的大爷每天早上都去打太极拳。
examples.pinyin: gébì de dàyé měitiān zǎoshang dōu qù dǎ tàijíquán.
examples.english: The old man next door practices tai chi every morning.

大爷.meaning: uncle (father's elder brother) — colloquial variant pronunciation; also arrogant 那大爷 a bossy type

examples.hanzi: 大爷，您先请坐。
examples.pinyin: dàye, nín xiān qǐng zuò.
examples.english: Uncle, please have a seat first.

大于.meaning: to be greater than (三大于二 three is greater than two); to exceed (支出大于收入 spending exceeds income)

examples.hanzi: 在这个公司里，支出大于收入。
examples.pinyin: zài zhège gōngsī lǐ, zhīchū dàyú shōurù.
examples.english: In this company, spending exceeds income.

大众.meaning: the public; the masses (大众文化 popular culture; 大众交通 public transit)

examples.hanzi: 这种大众交通工具既便宜又方便。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng dàzhòng jiāotōng gōngjù jì piányi yòu fāngbiàn.
examples.english: This form of public transit is both cheap and convenient.

登.meaning: to climb; to scale (登山 mountaineering; 登上山顶 climb to the summit); to publish; to record (登广告 place an ad; 登记 register)

examples.hanzi: 我们花了五个小时登上山顶。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen huā le wǔ gè xiǎoshí dēng shàng shāndǐng.
examples.english: It took us five hours to climb to the summit.

等待.meaning: to wait; to await (耐心等待 wait patiently; 等待机会 await an opportunity)

examples.hanzi: 大家在门口耐心地等待着结果。
examples.pinyin: dàjiā zài ménkǒu nàixīn de děngdài zhe jiéguǒ.
examples.english: Everyone waited patiently at the door for the result.

灯光.meaning: stage light; lamplight; lighting (柔和的灯光 soft lighting; 灯光效果 the lighting effects)

examples.hanzi: 柔和的灯光让房间显得很温暖。
examples.pinyin: róuhé de dēngguāng ràng fángjiān xiǎnde hěn wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: The soft lighting makes the room feel warm.

等候.meaning: to wait; to await (formal) (等候通知 await notification; 请在大厅等候 please wait in the lobby)

examples.hanzi: 请各位乘客在大厅等候登机。
examples.pinyin: qǐng gè wèi chéngkè zài dàtīng děnghòu dēngjī.
examples.english: Passengers, please wait in the lobby to board.

登记.meaning: to register; to check in (登记姓名 register one's name; 住宿登记 hotel check-in)

examples.hanzi: 住旅馆时要先在前台登记。
examples.pinyin: zhù lǚguǎn shí yào xiān zài qiántái dēngjì.
examples.english: When staying at a hotel you must first register at the front desk.

登录.meaning: to log in; to log on (登录账号 log in to your account; 请先登录 please log in first)

examples.hanzi: 请输入密码登录你的账号。
examples.pinyin: qǐng shūrù mìmǎ dēnglù nǐ de zhànghào.
examples.english: Please enter your password to log in to your account.

等于.meaning: to equal; to be equivalent to (三加二等于五 three plus two equals five; 等于白说 it amounts to saying nothing)

examples.hanzi: 三加二等于五。
examples.pinyin: sān jiā èr děngyú wǔ.
examples.english: Three plus two equals five.

递.meaning: to hand over; to pass (递给我一杯水 hand me a glass of water; 递简历 submit a resume)

examples.hanzi: 他递给我一份文件。
examples.pinyin: tā dì gěi wǒ yī fèn wénjiàn.
examples.english: He handed me a document.

电池.meaning: battery (手机电池 a phone battery; 充电电池 rechargeable battery)

examples.hanzi: 这块电池能用多长时间？
examples.pinyin: zhè kuài diànchí néng yòng duō cháng shíjiān?
examples.english: How long can this battery last?

电动.meaning: electric-powered (电动汽车 an electric car; 电动牙刷 an electric toothbrush)

examples.hanzi: 越来越多的人开电动汽车。
examples.pinyin: yuè lái yuè duō de rén kāi diàndòng qìchē.
examples.english: More and more people drive electric cars.

电器.meaning: electrical appliance (家用电器 home appliances)

examples.hanzi: 商场四楼卖家用电器。
examples.pinyin: shāngchǎng sì lóu mài jiāyòng diànqì.
examples.english: The fourth floor of the mall sells home appliances.

电商.meaning: e-commerce (电商平台 an e-commerce platform; 跨境电商 cross-border e-commerce)

examples.hanzi: 这几年电商发展得非常快。
examples.pinyin: zhè jǐ nián diànshāng fāzhǎn de fēicháng kuài.
examples.english: E-commerce has developed very fast these years.

电视台.meaning: TV station (地方电视台 a local TV station)

examples.hanzi: 她在电视台工作了很多年。
examples.pinyin: tā zài diànshìtái gōngzuò le hěn duō nián.
examples.english: She worked at the TV station for many years.

点心.meaning: dim sum; light refreshments (广式点心 Cantonese dim sum; 吃点儿点心 have a snack)

examples.hanzi: 奶奶给我们准备了很多点心。
examples.pinyin: nǎinai gěi wǒmen zhǔnbèi le hěn duō diǎnxin.
examples.english: Grandma prepared lots of snacks for us.

点赞.meaning: to like (a post online) (给视频点赞 like the video; 收到很多点赞 get lots of likes)

examples.hanzi: 这条视频收到了上万个点赞。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo shìpín shōudào le shàng wàn gè diǎnzàn.
examples.english: This video received tens of thousands of likes.

电子版.meaning: electronic version; digital copy (教材的电子版 the e-textbook version)

examples.hanzi: 这份报告有电子版，我发给你。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn bàogào yǒu diànzǐbǎn, wǒ fā gěi nǐ.
examples.english: This report has an electronic version; I'll send it to you.

调1.meaning: to adjust; to harmonize (调整 adjust; 调节 regulate; 调料 seasoning; 调皮 naughty)

examples.hanzi: 请把空调的温度调低一点儿。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ kōngtiáo de wēndù tiáo dī yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: Please turn the air conditioner's temperature down a bit.

调1.meaning: to transfer; to move (调换 swap; 调动 transfer personnel); tune; melody (曲调 a tune; 语调 intonation); key (of music) (C调 the key of C)

examples.hanzi: 公司把他调到了上海分部。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī bǎ tā diào dào le Shànghǎi fēnbù.
examples.english: The company transferred him to the Shanghai branch.

调研.meaning: to investigate and survey; research (市场调研 market research; 实地调研 field research)

examples.hanzi: 他们针对年轻人的消费习惯做了市场调研。
examples.pinyin: tāmen zhēnduì niánqīngrén de xiāofèi xíguàn zuò le shìchǎng diàoyán.
examples.english: They did market research on young people's spending habits.

地理.meaning: geography (地理课 a geography class; 地理位置 geographic position)

examples.hanzi: 我最喜欢的课是地理课。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐhuan de kè shì dìlǐ kè.
examples.english: My favorite class is geography.

地面.meaning: ground; floor; surface (地面上 on the ground; 地面交通 ground transport)

examples.hanzi: 地震后地面上出现了很多裂缝。
examples.pinyin: dìzhèn hòu dìmiàn shàng chūxiàn le hěn duō lièfèng.
examples.english: After the earthquake many cracks appeared on the ground.

定期.meaning: regular; at fixed intervals (定期检查 a regular checkup; 定期存款 a fixed-term deposit)

examples.hanzi: 他定期去医院检查身体。
examples.pinyin: tā dìngqī qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá shēntǐ.
examples.english: He goes to the hospital for checkups regularly.

地区.meaning: region; area (西部地区 the western region; 地区差异 regional differences)

低头.meaning: to lower one's head (低头看书 lower one's head to read); to yield (从不低头 never yield)

丢失.meaning: to lose (an object); to be lost (行李丢失了 the luggage was lost; 丢失的数据 the lost data)

地位.meaning: position; status (社会地位 social status; 国际地位 international standing)

地下.meaning: underground; basement (地下停车场 an underground parking garage); on the ground (地下有一本书 there's a book on the floor); secret; underground (地下活动 underground activity)

examples.pinyin: tāmen bǎ chē tíng zài dìxià tíngchēchǎng.

地震.meaning: earthquake; to have an earthquake (发生地震 an earthquake occurred; 地震仪 a seismograph)

examples.pinyin: dìzhèn fāshēng shí qǐng bù yào chéng diàntī.
examples.english: Don't take the elevator when an earthquake occurs.

冻.meaning: to freeze; frozen (水冻成冰 the water froze; 冷冻食品 frozen food; 冻得发抖 frozen shivering)

洞.meaning: hole; cave (墙上有个洞 there's a hole in the wall; 山洞 a cave)

动画.meaning: animation; cartoon (动画片 an animated film; 动画设计 animation design)

examples.pinyin: háizimen dōu xǐhuan kàn dònghuàpiàn.
examples.english: Children all like watching cartoons.

动人.meaning: moving; touching (动人的故事 a moving story; 感人动人 deeply touching)

动手.meaning: to start work; to set about (自己动手做 do it yourself; 动手能力 hands-on ability); to hit out, to get physical (两人差点儿动手 the two nearly came to blows)

examples.english: Breakfast is simple; we can make it ourselves.

examples.pinyin: mápó dòufu shì zhè dào chuāncài de jīngdiǎn cài.
examples.english: Mapo tofu is the classic dish of Sichuan cuisine.

豆浆.meaning: soy milk (一杯豆浆 a cup of soy milk; 豆浆油条 soy milk and fried dough sticks)

examples.hanzi: 早上他习惯喝一杯豆浆。
examples.pinyin: zǎoshang tā xíguàn hē yī bēi dòujiāng.
examples.english: He is used to drinking a cup of soy milk in the morning.

度.meaning: degree (temperature, angle, intensity) (三十度 thirty degrees; 高度 height; 速度 speed); a time (一年一度 once a year); to spend (欢度春节 spend the Spring Festival); to limit (制度 system; 过度 excessive)

堵.meaning: to stop up; to jam (堵车 a traffic jam; 鼻子堵了 a blocked nose; 把洞堵上 stop up the hole)

断.meaning: to break; to snap (绳子断了 the rope snapped; 断电 a power cut); to decide (判断 judge; 断定 conclude); to cut off continuously (不断 continuously)

examples.pinyin: fēng tài dà le, shùzhī dōu bèi guāduàn le.
examples.english: The wind was so strong that branches were snapped off.

短处.meaning: shortcoming; weak point (每个人都有短处 everyone has weak points)

examples.english: Humbly accept it when others point out your shortcomings.

短期.meaning: short-term (短期培训 short-term training; 短期目标 short-term goals)

examples.pinyin: tā cānjiā le yī gè duǎnqī de yǔyán péixùn bān.
examples.english: He took a short-term language training course.

堆.meaning: to pile up; to stack (把书堆在桌上 pile the books on the desk); a pile (一堆书 a pile of books); measure word for piles — 一堆 trouble 一堆问题 a pile of problems)

examples.pinyin: háizimen zài yuànzi lǐ duī le yī gè xuěrén.

对比.meaning: to compare; contrast (两幅图对比 compare the two pictures; 明显的对比 a sharp contrast)

examples.pinyin: bǎ xīn jiù liǎng gè bǎnběn duìbǐ yīxià, chābié hěn míngxiǎn.
examples.english: Compare the old and new versions; the differences are obvious.

对待.meaning: to treat; to handle (a person or matter) (认真对待工作 take work seriously; 区别对待 treat differently)

examples.pinyin: wǒmen yào rènzhēn duìdài měi yī cì kǎoshì.

对手.meaning: opponent; rival; adversary (强大的对手 a strong opponent; 商业对手 a business rival)

examples.pinyin: tā shì zhè cì bǐsài zhōng zuì qiáng de duìshǒu.
examples.english: He is the strongest opponent in this competition.

队伍.meaning: troops; a line of people; team (排成队伍 form a line; 队伍越来越壮大 the ranks keep growing)

examples.pinyin: mǎi piào de duìwu pái dào le mén wài.
examples.english: The ticket line stretched out the door.

对象.meaning: target; object (of study) (研究对象 the object of study); boyfriend or girlfriend — colloquial (有对象了吗 do you have a partner?)

examples.hanzi: 这项研究的对象是大学生。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng yánjiū de duìxiàng shì dàxuéshēng.
examples.english: The subjects of this research are university students.

examples.pinyin: shíbā suì yǐhòu tā jiù kāishǐ dúlì shēnghuó le.
examples.english: After turning eighteen he began living independently.

吨.meaning: ton (measure word/mass unit) — 一吨重 a ton in weight)

examples.hanzi: 这头大象重达五吨。
examples.pinyin: zhè tóu dàxiàng zhòng dá wǔ dūn.
examples.english: This elephant weighs as much as five tons.

朵.meaning: measure word for flowers and clouds — 一朵花 a flower, 一朵云 a cloud

examples.english: It's raining; let's take shelter under the eaves.

独特.meaning: unique; distinctive (独特的风格 a distinctive style; 独特的优势 a unique advantage)

examples.english: This restaurant has a unique style of decor.

读音.meaning: pronunciation (of a character) (这个字的读音 the character's reading; 标准读音 standard pronunciation)

examples.english: This character has two different readings.

独自.meaning: alone; by oneself (独自旅行 travel alone; 独自在家 home alone)

examples.english: China's ancient Four Great Inventions had far-reaching influence.
