examples.pinyin: xuéxiào gōngbù le zhège xuéqī de kǎoshì ānpái.
examples.english: The school announced this term's exam schedule.

工程.meaning: project; engineering (大型工程 a large project; 软件工程 software engineering; 土木工程 civil engineering)

examples.hanzi: 这项工程预计明年年底完工。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng gōngchéng yùjì míngnián niándǐ wángōng.
examples.english: This project is expected to be completed by the end of next year.

工程师.meaning: engineer (软件工程师 a software engineer)

examples.hanzi: 他的理想是当一名桥梁工程师。
examples.pinyin: tā de lǐxiǎng shì dāng yī míng qiáoliáng gōngchéngshī.
examples.english: His dream is to become a bridge engineer.

工具.meaning: tool (修理工具 repair tools; 学习工具 study aids)

examples.hanzi: 修自行车需要一些专门的工具。
examples.pinyin: xiū zìxíngchē xūyào yīxiē zhuānmén de gōngjù.
examples.english: Fixing a bicycle requires some special tools.

功能.meaning: function; feature (手机的功能 a phone's features; 基本功能 basic functions)

examples.hanzi: 这款手机增加了很多新功能。
examples.pinyin: zhè kuǎn shǒujī zēngjiā le hěn duō xīn gōngnéng.
examples.english: This phone has added many new features.

公平.meaning: fair; just (公平竞争 fair competition; 不公平的待遇 unfair treatment)

examples.hanzi: 裁判应该公平地对待每一位运动员。
examples.pinyin: cáipàn yīnggāi gōngpíng de duìdài měi yī wèi yùndòngyuán.
examples.english: Referees should treat every athlete fairly.

公务员.meaning: civil servant; government official (考上公务员 pass the civil-service exam)

examples.hanzi: 她毕业后考上了公务员。
examples.pinyin: tā bìyè hòu kǎo shàng le gōngwùyuán.
examples.english: After graduating she passed the civil-service exam.

恭喜.meaning: congratulations! to congratulate (恭喜发财 may you prosper; 恭喜你们新婚 congratulations on the wedding)

examples.hanzi: 恭喜你考上理想的大学！
examples.pinyin: gōngxǐ nǐ kǎo shàng lǐxiǎng de dàxué!
examples.english: Congratulations on getting into the university of your dreams!

贡献.meaning: contribution (做出贡献 make a contribution); to contribute (为科学事业贡献力量 contribute to science)

examples.hanzi: 科学家们为国家的发展做出了巨大贡献。
examples.pinyin: kēxuéjiāmen wèi guójiā de fāzhǎn zuò chū le jùdà gòngxiàn.
examples.english: Scientists have made enormous contributions to the country's development.

near_synonyms.difference: sharing an experience or content with others; 共享 is joint use of resources or things

共享.meaning: to share; shared (共享单车 shared bikes; 资源共享 resource sharing)

examples.hanzi: 共享单车给人们的出行带来了方便。
examples.pinyin: gòngxiǎng dānchē gěi rénmen de chūxíng dài lái le fāngbiàn.
examples.english: Shared bikes have made getting around convenient.

工业.meaning: industry (manufacturing) (工业园区 an industrial park; 工业化 industrialization)

examples.hanzi: 这个城市的工业发展得很快。
examples.pinyin: zhège chéngshì de gōngyè fāzhǎn de hěn kuài.
examples.english: Industry in this city has developed quickly.

工艺.meaning: craft; craftsmanship; technology/process (传统工艺 traditional craftsmanship; 制作工艺 manufacturing process)

examples.hanzi: 这件瓷器的制作工艺非常复杂。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn cíqì de zhìzuò gōngyì fēicháng fùzá.
examples.english: The craftsmanship of this porcelain is very intricate.

公寓.meaning: apartment (block) (出租公寓 an apartment for rent; 学生公寓 student apartments)

examples.hanzi: 他在学校附近租了一间公寓。
examples.pinyin: tā zài xuéxiào fùjìn zū le yī jiān gōngyù.
examples.english: He rented an apartment near the school.

near_synonyms.difference: everyday, also used in math; 构成 is formal, also legal (构成犯罪 constitute a crime)

构成.meaning: to constitute; to form (由三部分构成 composed of three parts; 知识的构成 the make-up of knowledge)

examples.hanzi: 这个委员会由七名成员构成。
examples.pinyin: zhège wěiyuánhuì yóu qī míng chéngyuán gòuchéng.
examples.english: The committee is composed of seven members.

near_synonyms.difference: exchanging ideas or feelings; 沟通 emphasizes communicating to reach mutual understanding and close gaps

沟通.meaning: to communicate (与家长沟通 communicate with parents; 沟通能力 communication skills)

examples.hanzi: 父母和孩子之间需要多沟通。
examples.pinyin: fùmǔ hé háizi zhī jiān xūyào duō gōutōng.
examples.english: Parents and children need to communicate more.

古.meaning: ancient; old (古老 ancient; 古代 ancient times; 古人 the ancients; 古诗 classical poetry)

examples.hanzi: 这座古城有一千多年的历史。
examples.pinyin: zhè zuò gǔchéng yǒu yī qiān duō nián de lìshǐ.
examples.english: This ancient city has a history of over a thousand years.

鼓.meaning: drum (打鼓 beat a drum); to rouse; to bulge (鼓励 encourage; 鼓掌 applaud; 鼓起勇气 pluck up courage)

examples.hanzi: 节日的晚上，村里的年轻人敲起了鼓。
examples.pinyin: jiérì de wǎnshàng, cūnlǐ de niánqīngrén qiāo qǐ le gǔ.
examples.english: On the festival evening, the village youth beat the drums.

挂号.meaning: to register (at a hospital) (挂号费 the registration fee; 网上挂号 register online)

examples.hanzi: 在这家医院看病要先在网上挂号。
examples.pinyin: zài zhè jiā yīyuàn kànbìng yào xiān zài wǎngshang guàhào.
examples.english: To see a doctor at this hospital you first register online.

怪.meaning: strange; odd (奇怪 strange; 怪事 a strange affair); to blame (怪他自己 blame himself); quite; rather (怪不好意思的 quite embarrassing)

examples.hanzi: 这件事不能怪他，是我自己弄错了。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì bù néng guài tā, shì wǒ zìjǐ nòng cuò le.
examples.english: You can't blame him for this — I got it wrong myself.

near_synonyms.difference: single everyday verb; 关闭 is written/formal, also for shutting down a factory or service

关闭.meaning: to close; to shut down (关闭门窗 close the doors and windows; 关闭工厂 shut down a factory)

examples.hanzi: 出门以前别忘了关闭门窗。
examples.pinyin: chūmén yǐqián bié wàng le guānbì mén chuāng.
examples.english: Before going out, don't forget to close the doors and windows.

观察.meaning: to observe; observation (仔细观察 observe carefully; 观察力 powers of observation)

examples.hanzi: 他仔细观察了植物的生长过程。
examples.pinyin: tā zǐxì guānchá le zhíwù de shēngzhǎng guòchéng.
examples.english: He carefully observed the growth process of plants.

near_synonyms.difference: personal opinion, everyday; 观点 is more formal, used in academic and public discussion

观点.meaning: point of view; viewpoint (表达观点 express a view; 观点不同 differ in opinion)

examples.hanzi: 会上大家交换了各自的观点。
examples.pinyin: huì shàng dàjiā jiāohuàn le gèzì de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: At the meeting everyone exchanged their views.

广.meaning: wide; broad; vast (广场 a square; 广泛 widespread; 面积很广 covers a vast area); numerous (大庭广众 in public)

examples.hanzi: 这片草原很广，一眼望不到边。
examples.pinyin: zhè piàn cǎoyuán hěn guǎng, yī yǎn wàng bù dào biān.
examples.english: This grassland is so vast you can't see the edge.

广场.meaning: public square; plaza (天安门广场 Tiananmen Square)

examples.hanzi: 每天晚上都有很多人在广场上跳舞。
examples.pinyin: měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu yǒu hěn duō rén zài guǎngchǎng shàng tiào wǔ.
examples.english: Every evening many people dance in the square.

near_synonyms.difference: broad in scope or coverage; 广大 means vast in extent or the broad masses of people

广大.meaning: vast; extensive; the broad masses (广大人民群众 the broad masses; 广大的农村 vast rural areas)

examples.hanzi: 这项政策惠及了广大农村地区。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng zhèngcè huìjí le guǎngdà nóngcūn dìqū.
examples.english: This policy benefits the vast rural areas.

near_synonyms.difference: vast in area or referring to the masses; 广泛 means widespread in scope, range or coverage

广泛.meaning: widespread; extensive (广泛的应用 widespread application; 广泛征求意见 solicit opinions widely)

examples.hanzi: 这项技术在医疗领域得到了广泛的应用。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng jìshù zài yīliáo lǐngyù dédào le guǎngfàn de yìngyòng.
examples.english: This technology has been widely applied in medicine.

光临.meaning: to grace with one's presence — polite/honorific for a customer or guest arriving (欢迎光临 welcome!; 敬请光临 your presence is cordially requested)

examples.hanzi: 欢迎光临本店，请随便看看。
examples.pinyin: huānyíng guānglín běn diàn, qǐng suíbiàn kànkan.
examples.english: Welcome to our store — feel free to look around.

光明.meaning: light; bright (光明的未来 a bright future); open; aboveboard (光明正大 open and aboveboard)

examples.hanzi: 孩子们的前途是光明的。
examples.pinyin: háizimen de qiántú shì guāngmíng de.
examples.english: The children's future is bright.

光线.meaning: ray; light (光线充足 good lighting; 光线太暗 the light is too dim)

examples.hanzi: 教室里的光线很充足。
examples.pinyin: jiàoshì lǐ de guāngxiàn hěn chōngzú.
examples.english: The lighting in the classroom is very good.

冠军.meaning: champion (获得冠军 win the championship; 世界冠军 world champion)

examples.hanzi: 经过多年的努力，她终于获得了世界冠军。
examples.pinyin: jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, tā zhōngyú huòdé le shìjiè guànjūn.
examples.english: After years of effort, she finally became world champion.

near_synonyms.difference: a specific term or abstract concept; 观念 is an outlook or set of notions, e.g. values

观念.meaning: concept; notion; sense (传统观念 traditional notions; 价值观念 values)

examples.hanzi: 随着社会的发展，人们的观念也在变化。
examples.pinyin: suízhe shèhuì de fāzhǎn, rénmen de guānniàn yě zài biànhuà.
examples.english: As society develops, people's notions are changing too.

古代.meaning: ancient times (在中国古代 in ancient China)

examples.hanzi: 在中国古代，四大发明对世界影响很大。
examples.pinyin: zài Zhōngguó gǔdài, sì dà fāmíng duì shìjiè yǐngxiǎng hěn dà.
examples.english: In ancient China, the Four Great Inventions had a great impact on the world.

固定.meaning: to fix; to fasten (把桌子固定住 fix the table in place); fixed; regular (固定收入 a fixed income; 固定的时间 a set time)

examples.hanzi: 我的工资是固定的，每个月五千块。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de gōngzī shì gùdìng de, měi gè yuè wǔ qiān kuài.
examples.english: My salary is fixed — five thousand yuan a month.

near_synonyms.difference: man-made rules to follow; 规律 is an objective, lawlike pattern

规律.meaning: law (of nature); regular pattern (自然规律 the laws of nature; 生活有规律 a regular lifestyle); regular (作息规律 regular daily routine)

examples.hanzi: 大自然有它自己的规律。
examples.pinyin: dà zìrán yǒu tā zìjǐ de guīlǜ.
examples.english: Nature has its own laws.

规模.meaning: scale; scope (生产规模 the scale of production; 大规模 large-scale)

examples.hanzi: 这家工厂的生产规模扩大了一倍。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā gōngchǎng de shēngchǎn guīmó kuòdà le yī bèi.
examples.english: The factory's production scale has doubled.

贵姓.meaning: your (honorable) surname — polite way to ask (您贵姓? your surname, please?)

examples.hanzi: 请问您贵姓？
examples.pinyin: qǐngwèn nín guìxìng?
examples.english: May I ask your surname, please?

near_synonyms.difference: objective, lawlike pattern of nature or events; 规则 is a man-made rule or regulation

规则.meaning: rule; regulation (交通规则 traffic rules; 违反规则 break the rules); regular (不规则的形状 an irregular shape)

examples.hanzi: 踢足球必须遵守比赛规则。
examples.pinyin: tī zúqiú bìxū zūnshǒu bǐsài guīzé.
examples.english: Playing football requires following the rules of the game.

柜子.meaning: cabinet; cupboard (书柜 a bookcase; 衣柜 a wardrobe)

examples.hanzi: 她把衣服叠好，放进了柜子里。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ yīfu dié hǎo, fàng jìn le guìzi lǐ.
examples.english: She folded the clothes and put them in the cupboard.

near_synonyms.difference: general word for old; 古老 specifically means ancient or age-old with a long history

古老.meaning: ancient; age-old (古老的文明 an ancient civilization; 古老的传说 an old legend)

examples.hanzi: 长城是中华民族古老文化的象征。
examples.pinyin: Chángchéng shì Zhōnghuá mínzú gǔlǎo wénhuà de xiàngzhēng.
examples.english: The Great Wall is a symbol of the Chinese nation's ancient culture.

滚.connotation: 滚开 is a strong insult
滚.meaning: to roll (滚下楼梯 roll down the stairs; 滚开 get lost! — rude); to boil (水滚了 the water is boiling)

examples.hanzi: 小狗从楼梯上滚了下来。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo gǒu cóng lóutī shàng gǔn le xiàlái.
examples.english: The puppy tumbled down the stairs.

锅.meaning: pot; pan; wok (炒菜锅 a wok; 电饭锅 rice cooker); measure word for the contents of a pot — 一锅汤 a pot of soup

examples.hanzi: 妈妈在厨房里用锅炒菜。
examples.pinyin: māma zài chúfáng lǐ yòng guō chǎo cài.
examples.english: Mom is stir-frying in the wok in the kitchen.

near_synonyms.difference: blaming, over the line morally or socially; 过度 is a neutral description of too high a degree

过度.meaning: excessive; undue (过度疲劳 excessive fatigue; 过度使用 overuse)

examples.hanzi: 长期过度工作会损害健康。
examples.pinyin: chángqī guòdù gōngzuò huì sǔnhài jiànkāng.
examples.english: Working excessively for long periods harms your health.

near_synonyms.difference: neutral, descriptive of degree or amount; 过分 carries blame — behavior that crosses the line

过分.meaning: excessive; going too far (要求太过分 the demands are way out of line; 开玩笑别太过分 don't carry a joke too far)

examples.hanzi: 他这样做实在太过分了。
examples.pinyin: tā zhèyàng zuò shízài tài guòfèn le.

国画.meaning: traditional Chinese painting (画国画 paint in the traditional style; 国画大师 a master of Chinese painting)

examples.hanzi: 爷爷退休后开始学国画。
examples.pinyin: yéye tuìxiū hòu kāishǐ xué guóhuà.
examples.english: After retiring, Grandpa started learning traditional Chinese painting.

过敏.meaning: to be allergic; allergy (对花粉过敏 allergic to pollen; 过敏性鼻炎 allergic rhinitis; 皮肤过敏 an allergic skin reaction)

examples.hanzi: 她对花粉过敏，春天经常打喷嚏。
examples.pinyin: tā duì huāfěn guòmǐn, chūntiān jīngcháng dǎ pēntì.
examples.english: She is allergic to pollen and sneezes a lot in spring.

过期.meaning: to expire; expired (食品过期了 the food has expired; 过期食品 expired food)

examples.hanzi: 这盒牛奶已经过期了，不能喝了。
examples.pinyin: zhè hé niúnǎi yǐjīng guòqī le, bù néng hē le.
examples.english: This carton of milk has expired and can't be drunk.

国庆.meaning: National Day (国庆节 National Day, October 1; 国庆假期 the National Day holiday)

examples.hanzi: 国庆假期我们打算去外地旅行。
examples.pinyin: guóqìng jiàqī wǒmen dǎsuàn qù wàidì lǚxíng.
examples.english: We plan to travel out of town during the National Day holiday.

near_synonyms.difference: contrary to expectation; 果然 means just as expected

果然.meaning: as expected; sure enough (他果然来了 he came, as expected; 果然不出所料 just as predicted)

examples.hanzi: 天气预报说今天下雨，果然下午就下起来了。
examples.pinyin: tiānqì yùbào shuō jīntiān xià yǔ, guǒrán xiàwǔ jiù xià qǐlái le.
examples.english: The forecast said rain today, and sure enough it started in the afternoon.

果实.meaning: fruit (of a plant) (果实的营养成分 the fruit's nutrients); fruits (of labor) — figurative (劳动的果实 the fruits of one's labor)

examples.hanzi: 秋天到了，果树上结满了果实。
examples.pinyin: qiūtiān dào le, guǒshù shàng jiē mǎn le guǒshí.
examples.english: Autumn is here and the fruit trees are full of fruit.

near_synonyms.difference: carries blame; 过于 is a neutral degree modifier meaning too, excessively

过于.meaning: too; excessively (过于紧张 too nervous; 过于自信 overly confident)

examples.hanzi: 对孩子过于严格反而不好。
examples.pinyin: duì háizi guòyú yángé fǎn'ér bù hǎo.
examples.english: Being too strict with children actually backfires.

near_synonyms.difference: neutral everyday word; 故乡 is literary and often emotionally colored

故乡.meaning: hometown; native place (回到故乡 return to one's hometown)

examples.hanzi: 多年以后，他回到了自己的故乡。
examples.pinyin: duō nián yǐhòu, tā huídào le zìjǐ de gùxiāng.
examples.english: Many years later he returned to his hometown.

鼓掌.meaning: to applaud; to clap (观众热烈鼓掌 the audience applauded warmly)

examples.hanzi: 演出结束后，观众们热烈鼓掌。
examples.pinyin: yǎnchū jiéshù hòu, guānzhòngmen rèliè gǔzhǎng.
examples.english: After the performance the audience applauded warmly.

哈.meaning: ha (sound of laughter) (哈哈大笑 laugh out loud); to breathe out (哈气 breathe on the glass);哈！ expressing surprise

examples.hanzi: 听完这个笑话，大家都哈哈大笑起来。
examples.pinyin: tīng wán zhège xiàohuà, dàjiā dōu hāhā dà xiào qǐlái.
examples.english: After hearing the joke, everyone burst out laughing.

海关.meaning: customs (通过海关 go through customs; 海关检查 a customs inspection)

examples.hanzi: 过海关的时候，工作人员检查了他的行李。
examples.pinyin: guò hǎiguān de shíhou, gōngzuò rényuán jiǎnchá le tā de xínglǐ.
examples.english: Going through customs, the staff checked his luggage.

near_synonyms.difference: simply outside one's own country, everyday; 海外 emphasizes overseas, often with a Chinese-diaspora flavor

海外.meaning: overseas; abroad (海外华人 overseas Chinese; 海外市场 overseas markets)

examples.hanzi: 越来越多的海外学生来中国学习汉语。
examples.pinyin: yuè lái yuè duō de hǎiwài xuéshēng lái Zhōngguó xuéxí Hànyǔ.
examples.english: More and more overseas students come to China to study Chinese.

海鲜.meaning: seafood (海鲜市场 a seafood market; 吃海鲜 eat seafood)

examples.hanzi: 这家餐厅的海鲜非常新鲜。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā cāntīng de hǎixiān fēicháng xīnxiān.
examples.english: The seafood at this restaurant is very fresh.

含.meaning: to hold in the mouth (含着一颗糖 hold a candy in the mouth); to contain (含铁量 the iron content); to imply (含义 meaning)

examples.hanzi: 他嘴里含着一块糖，说话不清楚。
examples.pinyin: tā zuǐ lǐ hán zhe yī kuài táng, shuōhuà bù qīngchǔ.
examples.english: With a candy in his mouth, he couldn't speak clearly.

near_synonyms.difference: a row of seats or people; 行 is a line/row of text, or a trade/profession

行.meaning: row; line (第一行 the first line; 银行 bank); trade; profession (各行各业 all trades; 行家 an expert); measure word for rows — 一行字 a line of characters)

examples.hanzi: 请把名字写在第三行。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ míngzi xiě zài dì sān háng.
examples.english: Please write your name on the third line.

near_synonyms.difference: permission or possibility; 行 judges whether something is acceptable or a person is capable

行.meaning: to walk; to travel (步行 on foot; 行程 the itinerary); to do; to carry out (实行 implement; 行不行 will it do?); capable (你真行 you're really something); OK (这样行吗 is this OK?)

examples.hanzi: 这样行不行，你给个话。
examples.pinyin: zhèyàng xíng bù xíng, nǐ gěi gè huà.
examples.english: Is this OK or not? Give me an answer.

near_synonyms.difference: a person's job; 行业 is an industry or trade as a whole

行业.meaning: industry; trade; profession (服务行业 the service industry; 各行各业 all walks of life)

examples.hanzi: 他在服务行业工作了十多年。
examples.pinyin: tā zài fúwù hángyè gōngzuò le shí duō nián.
examples.english: He has worked in the service industry for over ten years.

含量.meaning: content; level of a substance (含糖量 sugar content; 维生素含量 vitamin content)

examples.hanzi: 这种牛奶的钙含量很高。

examples.english: The competition is nearing its end.

结论.meaning: conclusion (得出结论 draw a conclusion; 最后的结论 the final conclusion)

examples.english: After discussion, everyone reached the same conclusion.

near_synonyms.difference: 节约 is used for resources (water, electricity); 节省 is for time, money, and expenses.

节省.meaning: to save; to economize (节省时间 save time; 节省开支 cut expenses)

examples.hanzi: 这种办法可以节省很多时间。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng bànfǎ kěyǐ jiéshěng hěn duō shíjiān
examples.english: This method can save a lot of time.

near_synonyms.difference: 接受 is to accept (an offer, criticism, a fact); 接收 is to receive signals, transfers, or to take over an organization.

接收.meaning: to receive (a signal, a transfer) (接收信号 receive a signal; 接收邮件 receive email); to take over (接收财产 take over property)

examples.hanzi: 这个设备可以接收无线电信号。
examples.pinyin: zhège shèbèi kěyǐ jiēshōu wúxiàndiàn xìnhào
examples.english: This device can receive radio signals.

及格.meaning: to pass (a test) (考试及格 pass the exam; 不及格 fail)

examples.hanzi: 他这次考试勉强及格了。
examples.pinyin: tā zhè cì kǎoshì miǎnqiǎng jígé le
examples.english: He barely passed the exam this time.

机构.meaning: institution; organization; agency (政府机构 government agencies; 教育机构 educational institutions)

examples.hanzi: 这个机构专门为老年人提供服务。
examples.pinyin: zhège jīgòu zhuānmén wèi lǎoniánrén tígōng fúwù
examples.english: This organization provides services especially for the elderly.

near_synonyms.difference: 集中 is to concentrate things or attention in one place; 集合 is for people gathering as a group.

集合.meaning: to assemble; to gather (学生在操场集合 the students assembled on the field; 集合地点 assembly point)

examples.hanzi: 明天早上八点在学校门口集合。
examples.pinyin: míngtiān zǎoshang bā diǎn zài xuéxiào ménkǒu jíhé
examples.english: Assemble at the school gate at eight tomorrow morning.

near_synonyms.difference: 快要 is the everyday spoken word; 即将 is formal and written.

即将.meaning: be about to; soon (火车即将到达 the train is about to arrive; 即将出版 about to be published)

examples.hanzi: 火车即将进站，请大家做好准备。
examples.pinyin: huǒchē jíjiāng jìn zhàn, qǐng dàjiā zuò hǎo zhǔnbèi
examples.english: The train is about to enter the station; please get ready.

near_synonyms.difference: 猛烈 describes physical force (wind, fire, attacks); 激烈 describes arguments, competition, emotions.

激烈.meaning: intense; fierce (激烈的争论 a heated argument; 竞争激烈 the competition is fierce)

examples.pinyin: tāmen jiù zhège wèntí zhǎnkāi le jīliè de tǎolùn
examples.english: They had a heated discussion about this issue.

near_synonyms.difference: 纪录 is only the noun 'record' as in 世界纪录; 记录 is the verb 'to record' and its product.

记录.meaning: to record (记录会议内容 record what was said at the meeting); a record (打破记录 break the record — also written 纪录); notes (会议记录 meeting minutes)

examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ huìyì de zhòngyào nèiróng jìlù xiàlai
examples.english: Please write down the important content of the meeting.

near_synonyms.difference: 记录 means writing something down; 纪录 refers only to a record-setting achievement.

纪录.meaning: record (best performance) (世界纪录 world record; 创造纪录 set a record; 纪录片 documentary)

examples.hanzi: 他打破了世界纪录。
examples.pinyin: tā dǎpò le shìjiè jìlù
examples.english: He broke the world record.

纪录片.meaning: documentary (film) (拍纪录片 shoot a documentary; 一部关于自然的纪录片 a nature documentary)

examples.hanzi: 我最近看了一部关于海洋的纪录片。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zuìjìn kàn le yī bù guānyú hǎiyáng de jìlùpiàn
examples.english: I recently watched a documentary about the ocean.

near_synonyms.difference: 匆忙 describes a hurried state that often leads to oversights; 急忙 stresses anxious, quick reaction.

急忙.meaning: hurriedly; in a rush (他急忙赶到医院 he rushed to the hospital)

examples.hanzi: 听到电话响了，他急忙跑过去接。
examples.pinyin: tīng dào diànhuà xiǎng le, tā jímáng pǎo guòqu jiē
examples.english: Hearing the phone ring, he hurried over to answer it.

near_synonyms.difference: 紧张 covers nervous feelings and tight schedules; 紧 is physical tightness or urgency of time/money.

紧.meaning: tight (鞋子太紧 the shoes are too tight); urgent; pressing (时间很紧 time is tight); close (紧跟着 right behind); tighten (抓紧 grasp tightly; 抓紧时间 make the most of the time)

examples.hanzi: 这双鞋有点儿紧。
examples.pinyin: zhè shuāng xié yǒu diǎnr jǐn
examples.english: These shoes are a bit tight.

进步.meaning: to make progress; progress (学习进步 make progress in one's studies; 进步很快 progressing quickly)

examples.hanzi: 这学期他的汉语进步很快。
examples.pinyin: zhè xuéqī tā de hànyǔ jìnbù hěn kuài
examples.english: His Chinese has improved quickly this semester.

近代.meaning: modern times (in the historian's periodization, mid-19th to mid-20th century) (中国近代史 modern Chinese history)

examples.hanzi: 中国近代发生了巨大的变化。
examples.pinyin: zhōngguó jìndài fāshēng le jùdà de biànhuà
examples.english: Enormous changes took place in modern China.

near_synonyms.difference: 技术 is methods and technology in general; 技能 is a person's learned ability.

技能.meaning: skill (专业技能 professional skills; 培养技能 develop skills)

examples.hanzi: 阅读是一种很重要的技能。
examples.pinyin: yuèdú shì yī zhǒng hěn zhòngyào de jìnéng
examples.english: Reading is a very important skill.

near_synonyms.difference: 安静 is the everyday word for a quiet environment; 静 is more literary and as a single character often appears in compounds.

静.meaning: quiet; still (安静 quiet; 平静 calm; 冷静 cool-headed; 静下心来 calm down and focus)

examples.hanzi: 夜深了，四周静了下来。
examples.pinyin: yè shēn le, sìzhōu jìng le xiàlai
examples.english: It was late at night, and everything around grew quiet.

经典.meaning: classic; classical (经典作品 classic works; 经典老歌 classic old songs); scripture (佛经 Buddhist sutras)

examples.hanzi: 这部电影已经成为经典。
examples.pinyin: zhè bù diànyǐng yǐjīng chéngwéi jīngdiǎn
examples.english: This film has become a classic.

精力.meaning: energy; vigor (精力充沛 full of energy; 花费很多精力 take a lot of energy)

examples.hanzi: 他把全部精力都放在工作上。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ quánbù jīnglì dōu fàng zài gōngzuò shàng
examples.english: He puts all his energy into his work.

精神.meaning: spirit; essence; mind (奋斗精神 the spirit of striving; 精神负担 mental strain; 集体主义精神 the collectivist spirit)

examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng jiānkǔ fèndòu de jīngshén zhídé wǒmen xuéxí
examples.english: This spirit of hard struggle is worth learning from.

精神.meaning: vitality; liveliness; spirit (mood) (精神不好 not in good spirits; 看起来很精神 looks bright and perky)

examples.hanzi: 他今天看起来没什么精神。
examples.pinyin: tā jīntiān kàn qǐlai méi shénme jīngshen
examples.english: He doesn't look very lively today.

惊喜.meaning: pleasant surprise (意外的惊喜 an unexpected surprise; 给他一个惊喜 give him a surprise)

examples.hanzi: 朋友们为我准备了一个惊喜。
examples.pinyin: péngyou men wèi wǒ zhǔnbèi le yī ge jīngxǐ
examples.english: My friends prepared a surprise for me.

near_synonyms.difference: 管理 is to manage people, affairs, or systems; 经营 is to run a business for it to develop.

经营.meaning: to run; to manage (a business) (经营一家餐厅 run a restaurant; 经营理念 management philosophy; 合法经营 lawful business operation)

examples.hanzi: 他们家经营着一家小餐馆。
examples.pinyin: tāmen jiā jīngyíng zhe yī jiā xiǎo cānguǎn
examples.english: Their family runs a small restaurant.

纪念.meaning: to commemorate; commemoration (纪念活动 a commemorative event; 纪念品 a souvenir; 留作纪念 keep as a memento)

examples.pinyin: péngyou men sòng tā yī fèn lǐwù zuòwéi jìniàn
examples.english: His friends gave him a gift as a keepsake.

纪念日.meaning: anniversary; commemorative day (结婚纪念日 wedding anniversary)

examples.english: Tomorrow is their wedding anniversary.

near_synonyms.difference: 急 covers both urgent matters and anxious feelings; 紧急 is a formal adjective for pressing situations only.

紧急.meaning: urgent; critical (紧急情况 an emergency; 紧急会议 an emergency meeting; 紧急出口 emergency exit)

进口.meaning: to import (进口设备 import equipment); import (进口商品 imported goods; 进口关税 import duty)

examples.english: Please reply to my email as soon as possible.

尽力.meaning: to do one's utmost; to try one's best (尽力而为 do one's best; 我会尽力的 I'll do my best)

尽量.meaning: as far as possible (尽量少用塑料袋 use as few plastic bags as possible)

紧密.meaning: close-knit; tight; close (紧密的联系 close ties; 紧密合作 close cooperation)

近年来.meaning: in recent years (近年来经济发展很快 the economy has grown fast in recent years)

今日.meaning: today (今日新闻 today's news) — more formal than 今天

谨慎.meaning: cautious; careful (小心谨慎 careful and cautious; 谨慎行事 act with caution)

进一步.meaning: further; a step further (进一步改善 further improve; 进一步的调查 a further investigation)

near_synonyms.difference: 十分 is plain 'very'; 极其 is the strongest degree, 'extremely'.

极其.meaning: extremely; exceedingly (极其重要 extremely important)

机器.meaning: machine (机器的发明 the invention of machines; 操作机器 operate a machine)

机器人.meaning: robot (智能机器人 an intelligent robot; 工业机器人 an industrial robot)

肌肉.meaning: muscle (锻炼肌肉 build muscle; 肌肉酸痛 muscle soreness)

examples.pinyin: duànliàn kěyǐ ràng jīròu gèng jiēshi
examples.english: Exercise makes muscles firmer.

计算.meaning: to calculate; to compute (计算成本 calculate the cost; 计算机计算机科学 computer science)

examples.hanzi: 请计算这道题的结果。

near_synonyms.difference: 电脑 is the everyday spoken word for computer; 计算机 is formal and also means 'calculator'.

计算机.meaning: computer (计算机专业 computer science major; 计算机病毒 a computer virus)

examples.english: He majored in computer science in college.

集体.meaning: collective; group (集体活动 a group activity; 集体利益 collective interests)

救.meaning: to rescue; to save (救命 help!; 救人 save a person; 抢救 rescue; 救护 first aid)

酒吧.meaning: bar (pub) (去酒吧喝酒 go to a bar for drinks)

examples.pinyin: tāmen yuē hǎo wǎnshang zài jiǔbā jiànmiàn
examples.english: They arranged to meet at a bar in the evening.

救护车.meaning: ambulance (叫救护车 call an ambulance)

examples.pinyin: yǒu rén shòushāng le, kuài jiào jiùhùchē!
examples.english: Someone is hurt — call an ambulance quick!

就业.meaning: to get a job; employment (就业机会 job opportunities; 就业压力 employment pressure; 失业 unemployment)

examples.hanzi: 现在就业市场竞争很激烈。

examples.english: Competition in the job market is fierce right now.

久远.meaning: remote (in time); long-standing (年代久远 dating back a long time; 久远的记忆 a distant memory)

examples.pinyin: zhè zuò qiáo de niándài yǐjīng shífēn jiǔyuǎn
examples.english: This bridge dates from a very remote era.

急需.meaning: to urgently need (急需帮助 in urgent need of help; 急需用钱 urgently need money)

examples.hanzi: 灾区急需药品和食物。
examples.pinyin: zāiqū jíxū yàopǐn hé shíwù
examples.english: The disaster area urgently needs medicine and food.

near_synonyms.difference: 回忆 is the act of recalling or things recalled; 记忆 is the faculty of memory or what is stored in it.

记忆.meaning: memory; to remember (童年的记忆 childhood memories; 记忆力 memory (faculty); 深深地留在记忆里 remains deep in the memory)

examples.hanzi: 童年的记忆总是特别美好。
examples.pinyin: tóngnián de jìyì zǒng shì tèbié měihǎo
examples.english: Childhood memories are always especially beautiful.

记载.meaning: to record (in writing); written record (历史记载 historical records; 书中记载 the book records)

examples.pinyin: zhè běn shū xiángxì jìzǎi le nà duàn lìshǐ
examples.english: This book records that period of history in detail.

急诊.meaning: emergency treatment (挂急诊 go to the emergency department; 急诊室 the ER)

examples.pinyin: bànyè háizi fāshāo, wǒmen gǎnjǐn qù guà jízhěn
examples.english: The child had a fever in the middle of the night, so we rushed to the emergency room.

near_synonyms.difference: 集合 is for a group of people gathering at a place; 集中 is for things or attention being concentrated.

集中.meaning: to concentrate; to centralize; concentrated (集中注意力 concentrate one's attention; 集中在…集中在北方 concentrated in the north)

examples.hanzi: 上课的时候要集中注意力。
examples.pinyin: shàngkè de shíhou yào jízhōng zhùyìlì
examples.english: You should concentrate during class.

据.meaning: according to (据说明天有雨 it is said it will rain tomorrow; 据报道 according to reports); to occupy (占据 occupy; 据为己有 appropriate)

examples.pinyin: jù bàodào, huǒzāi méiyǒu zàochéng rényuán shāngwáng
examples.english: According to reports, the fire caused no casualties.

near_synonyms.difference: 距离 is the everyday noun/verb for distance; 距 as a verb is mostly written and formal.

距.meaning: to be apart from; distance (距离 distance; 距离终点三公里 three kilometers from the finish)

examples.hanzi: 现在距考试只有一个星期了。
examples.pinyin: xiànzài jù kǎoshì zhǐ yǒu yī ge xīngqī le
examples.english: There is only one week left before the exam.

捐.meaning: to donate; to contribute (捐款 donate money; 捐给灾区 donate to the disaster zone; 捐血 donate blood)

examples.hanzi: 他每年都为山区的孩子们捐款。
examples.pinyin: tā měinián dōu wèi shānqū de háizimen juān kuǎn
examples.english: Every year he donates money to children in mountain areas.

near_synonyms.difference: 具有 is having an abstract quality (具有意义); 具备 is being fully equipped with a set of conditions or abilities.

具备.meaning: to possess; to have (条件具备 the conditions are met; 具备资格 possess the qualifications)

examples.hanzi: 这个项目具备了开工的条件。
examples.pinyin: zhège xiàngmù jùbèi le kāigōng de tiáojiàn
examples.english: The project now meets the conditions to start work.

near_synonyms.difference: 剧院 is a larger theater building or institution; 剧场 is the performance hall itself.

剧场.meaning: theater (playhouse) (国家大剧院 National Centre for the Performing Arts; 剧场演出 a theater performance)

examples.hanzi: 我们在剧场看了一场话剧。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zài jùchǎng kàn le yī chǎng huàjù
examples.english: We watched a stage play at the theater.

巨大.meaning: huge; enormous (巨大的变化 enormous changes; 压力巨大 under huge pressure)

examples.hanzi: 改革给这座城市带来了巨大的变化。
examples.pinyin: gǎigé gěi zhè zuò chéngshì dàilai le jùdà de biànhuà
examples.english: Reform brought enormous changes to this city.

绝对.meaning: absolute (绝对多数 an absolute majority); absolutely; definitely (绝对不行 absolutely not; 绝对可靠 absolutely reliable)

examples.hanzi: 我绝对不会再犯同样的错误。
examples.pinyin: wǒ juéduì bù huì zài fàn tóngyàng de cuòwù
examples.english: I will absolutely not make the same mistake again.

决赛.meaning: finals (进入决赛 reach the finals; 世界杯决赛 the World Cup final)

examples.hanzi: 他们队打进了决赛。

near_synonyms.difference: 结合 combines abstract things (theory and practice); 联合 unites parties for joint action, e.g. 联合国.

联合.meaning: to unite; to combine; joint (联合声明 a joint statement; 联合国 the United Nations; 联合起来 unite)

examples.hanzi: 两家公司联合开发新产品。
examples.pinyin: liǎng jiā gōngsī liánhé kāifā xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: The two companies jointly developed a new product.

near_synonyms.difference: 联系 is abstract relation or getting in touch; 连接 physically joins two things.

连接.meaning: to connect; to join (网络连接 the network connection; 连接两个城市 connect two cities)

examples.hanzi: 这座桥连接着两个村子。
examples.pinyin: zhè zuò qiáo liánjiē zhe liǎng gè cūnzi.
examples.english: This bridge connects the two villages.

near_synonyms.difference: 赶紧 is colloquial and can initiate action; 连忙 is a reaction that immediately follows an event.

连忙.meaning: at once; hurriedly (他连忙道歉 he immediately apologized)

examples.hanzi: 看见老人摔倒，他连忙去扶。
examples.pinyin: kànjiàn lǎorén shuāidǎo, tā liánmáng qù fú.
examples.english: Seeing the old man fall, he hurried over to help him up.

脸色.meaning: complexion; facial expression (脸色苍白 a pale complexion; 看他脸色不对 saw from his face something was wrong)

examples.hanzi: 她脸色不太好，是不是病了？
examples.pinyin: tā liǎnsè bù tài hǎo, shì bù shì bìng le?
examples.english: She looks off-color — is she sick?

near_synonyms.difference: 继续 resumes or carries on an action; 连续 stresses unbroken succession over time.

连续.meaning: continuously; in a row (连续三天 for three days straight; 连续剧 a serial drama)

examples.hanzi: 他连续工作了十个小时。
examples.pinyin: tā liánxù gōngzuò le shí gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: He worked for ten hours straight.

了不起.meaning: amazing; remarkable (了不起的成就 a remarkable achievement; 你真了不起 you're really something)

examples.hanzi: 他竟然解决了这个问题，真了不起！
examples.pinyin: tā jìngrán jiějué le zhège wèntí, zhēn liǎobuqǐ!
examples.english: He actually solved this problem — truly amazing!

near_synonyms.difference: 火车 is the everyday word; 列车 is formal/technical, used in announcements and news.

列车.meaning: train (formal word) (高速列车 a high-speed train; 旅客列车 a passenger train)

examples.hanzi: 高速列车两个小时就能到北京。
examples.pinyin: gāosù lièchē liǎng gè xiǎoshí jiù néng dào Běijīng.
examples.english: The high-speed train gets to Beijing in two hours.

离婚.meaning: to divorce; divorce (他们离婚了 they got divorced; 离婚率 the divorce rate)

examples.hanzi: 他们结婚三年后就离婚了。
examples.pinyin: tāmen jiéhūn sān nián hòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: They divorced three years after getting married.

near_synonyms.difference: 立刻 is neutral and colloquial; 立即 is formal and written.

立即.meaning: immediately; at once (立即采取行动 take action immediately)

examples.hanzi: 情况紧急，请立即采取行动。
examples.pinyin: qíngkuàng jǐnjí, qǐng lìjí cǎiqǔ xíngdòng.
examples.english: The situation is urgent — please take action immediately.

立刻.meaning: immediately; right away (他立刻答应了 he agreed at once)

examples.hanzi: 听到消息，他立刻赶到了医院。
examples.pinyin: tīngdào xiāoxi, tā lìkè gǎndào le yīyuàn.
examples.english: On hearing the news, he rushed to the hospital at once.

near_synonyms.difference: 力气 is bodily, physical strength; 力量 is abstract or collective power (knowledge, a team).

力量.meaning: strength; power; force (知识就是力量 knowledge is power; 团队的力量 the team's strength)

examples.hanzi: 团结就是力量。
examples.pinyin: tuánjié jiù shì lìliàng.
examples.english: Unity is strength.

理论.meaning: theory (理论与实践 theory and practice; 从理论上讲 in theory)

examples.hanzi: 这个理论很难懂。
examples.pinyin: zhège lǐlùn hěn nán dǒng.
examples.english: This theory is hard to understand.

厘米.meaning: centimeter (长十厘米 ten centimeters long)

examples.hanzi: 这张桌子高八十厘米。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhuōzi gāo bāshí límǐ.
examples.english: This table is eighty centimeters high.

铃.meaning: bell (门铃 doorbell; 铃声响 the bell rings; 车铃 a bicycle bell)

examples.hanzi: 上课铃响了。
examples.pinyin: shàngkè líng xiǎng le.
examples.english: The class bell rang.

令.meaning: to make; to cause (令人满意 satisfying — cause people to be satisfied; 令人兴奋 exciting); order; command (命令 an order; 令尊 your father — honorific); measure word for reams of paper

examples.hanzi: 这个消息令人兴奋。
examples.pinyin: zhège xiāoxi lìng rén xīngfèn.
examples.english: This news is exciting.

near_synonyms.difference: 领取 is the formal disyllabic verb for collecting payments or items; 领 also means to lead (带领).

领.meaning: to receive; to get (领取 collect; 领工资 pick up one's pay); to lead (带领 lead; 领导 lead); collar (衣领 a collar); to understand (领会 grasp; 领悟 comprehend)

examples.hanzi: 他每个月五号领工资。
examples.pinyin: tā měi gè yuè wǔ hào lǐng gōngzī.
examples.english: He picks up his salary on the fifth of every month.

领带.meaning: necktie (打领带 tie a tie; 一条领带 a tie)

examples.hanzi: 他今天打了一条新领带。
examples.pinyin: tā jīntiān dǎ le yī tiáo xīn lǐngdài.
examples.english: He put on a new tie today.

near_synonyms.difference: 领袖 is a great leader of a nation or movement; 领导 is the everyday word for one's boss or leadership.

领导.meaning: leader; leadership; to lead (单位领导 the unit's leadership; 领导班子 the leading group; 领导人民 lead the people)

examples.hanzi: 我们领导对人很客气。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen lǐngdǎo duì rén hěn kèqi.
examples.english: Our boss is very polite to people.

near_synonyms.difference: 机灵 describes a clever, sharp person or animal; 灵活 describes flexible methods, thinking, or arrangements.

灵活.meaning: flexible; nimble (灵活运用 apply flexibly; 头脑灵活 quick-minded; 时间灵活 flexible hours)

examples.hanzi: 他的教学方法很灵活。
examples.pinyin: tā de jiàoxué fāngfǎ hěn línghuó.
examples.english: His teaching methods are very flexible.

领取.meaning: to collect; to draw (a payment or item) (领取快递 collect a parcel; 领取工资 draw one's salary)

examples.hanzi: 请带身份证来领取包裹。
examples.pinyin: qǐng dài shēnfènzhèng lái lǐngqǔ bāoguǒ.
examples.english: Please bring your ID card to collect the parcel.

领先.meaning: to lead (in a race or field); leading (技术领先 technologically ahead; 遥遥领先 far in the lead)

examples.hanzi: 这家公司的技术处于世界领先地位。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā gōngsī de jìshù chǔyú shìjiè lǐngxiān dìwèi.
examples.english: This company's technology is in a world-leading position.

near_synonyms.difference: 范围 is the range or scope something covers; 领域 is a field or sphere of activity and study.

领域.meaning: field; domain; sphere (科学领域 the field of science; 在国际领域 on the international stage)

examples.hanzi: 他在医学领域工作了很多年。
examples.pinyin: tā zài yīxué lǐngyù gōngzuò le hěn duō nián.
examples.english: He has worked in the field of medicine for many years.

near_synonyms.difference: 暂时 means for a limited, planned time; 临时 means improvised or decided on the spur of the moment.

临时.meaning: temporary; at the last moment (临时工 a temp worker; 临时改变主意 change one's mind at the last minute)

examples.english: The meeting was moved to next week at the last minute.

利润.meaning: profit (追求利润 pursue profit; 利润率 the profit margin)

examples.pinyin: zhè jiā gōngsī jīnnián de lìrùn zēngzhǎng hěn kuài.
examples.english: The company's profits grew quickly this year.

near_synonyms.difference: 里面 is the neutral word for inside; 里头 is colloquial, more common in northern speech.

里头.meaning: inside; interior (屋子里头 inside the room; 里头很暖和 it's warm inside)

流传.meaning: to circulate; to be handed down (这个故事流传很广 the story is widely told; 流传至今 handed down to this day)

near_synonyms.difference: 阅读 is careful, thorough reading; 浏览 is skimming or browsing quickly.

浏览.meaning: to browse; to skim (浏览网页 browse the web; 浏览了一遍标题 skimmed the headlines)

留言.meaning: to leave a message; a message left (给我留言 leave me a message; 留言板 message board)

examples.english: He's not in the office — please leave him a message.

near_synonyms.difference: 好处 is the everyday word for a benefit or gain, often personal; 利益 is formal, interests of a person, group, or country.

利益.meaning: interest; benefit (维护自身利益 protect one's own interests; 个人利益与集体利益 personal and collective interests)

理由.meaning: reason; grounds (充分的理由 a good reason; 没有理由拒绝 have no reason to refuse)

离职.meaning: to leave one's job; to resign (离职原因 the reason for leaving; 主动离职 resign voluntarily)

龙.meaning: dragon (龙是中国文化的象征 the dragon is a symbol of Chinese culture; 龙舟 a dragon boat)

漏.meaning: to leak (屋顶漏雨 the roof leaks); to leave out; to miss (漏了一道题 missed a question; 遗漏 omit); to reveal (泄露/走漏 leak a secret)

录.meaning: to record (录音 record sound; 录像 record video; 录取 admit (to a school or job)); to register; to copy (记录 record; 登录 log in)

陆地.meaning: land (as opposed to sea) (陆地动物 land animals)

examples.pinyin: hǎitún ǒu'ěr yě huì kàojìn lùdì.
examples.english: Dolphins occasionally come close to land.

论文.meaning: paper; thesis (毕业论文 a graduation thesis; 发表论文 publish a paper)

逻辑.meaning: logic (符合逻辑 logical; 逻辑思维 logical thinking; 逻辑性 coherence)

录取.meaning: to admit (to a school); to hire (be accepted) (被大学录取 be admitted to a university; 录取通知书 a letter of admission)

examples.hanzi: 一位路人帮他报了警。

路线.meaning: route; itinerary; line (公交车路线 the bus route; 旅游路线 a travel itinerary; 政治路线 a political line)

near_synonyms.difference: 连续 is unbroken succession in time; 陆续 describes arrivals or events happening one after another with gaps.

陆续.meaning: one after another; in succession (客人陆续到了 the guests arrived one after another)

录音.meaning: audio recording; to record sound (听录音 listen to the recording; 录音笔 a voice recorder)

near_synonyms.difference: 批评 points out faults reasonably; 骂 scolds with harsh, abusive language.

买卖.meaning: business; trade; deal (做买卖 do business; 一笔买卖 a deal)

examples.pinyin: tā duō nián qián jiù kāishǐ zuò mǎimai le.

near_synonyms.difference: 忙 is the plain adjective; 忙碌 depicts continuous bustling activity and is more descriptive.

忙碌.meaning: busy (忙碌的一天 a busy day; 为生活而忙碌 bustling about making a living)

near_synonyms.difference: 满意 is being satisfied with a specific thing or person; 满足 is needs being met or a contented feeling.

满足.meaning: to satisfy; to meet (a need) (满足需求 meet demand; 满足感 a sense of satisfaction); satisfied (知足常乐，容易满足 easily satisfied)

examples.pinyin: xiànzài de shēnghuó ràng tā hěn mǎnzú.

毛笔.meaning: writing brush (毛笔字 calligraphy with a brush)

near_synonyms.difference: 问题 is the neutral word for a problem; 毛病 is colloquial for a device's fault or a person's bad habit.

毛病.meaning: fault; defect; illness (机器出毛病了 the machine broke down; 老毛病 an old ailment; 坏毛病 a bad habit)

玫瑰.meaning: rose (一束玫瑰 a bouquet of roses; 玫瑰花 roses)

near_synonyms.difference: 吸引力 is general drawing power; 魅力 is a personal, magnetic charm, usually of people or places.

魅力.meaning: charm; appeal (人格魅力 personal charisma; 城市的魅力 the city's charm)

美术.meaning: fine arts (美术课 an art class; 美术馆 an art museum)

媒体.meaning: media (新闻媒体 the news media; 社交媒体 social media)

examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo xīnwén hěn kuài bèi méitǐ bàodào le.

near_synonyms.difference: 好吃 is the colloquial predicate for tasty food; 美味 is more elevated, works attributively and as a noun.

examples.english: Mom cooked a tableful of delicious dishes.

门诊.meaning: outpatient (service) (挂门诊号 register as an outpatient; 门诊部 the outpatient department)

迷.meaning: to be fascinated by; fan (足球迷 a football fan; 迷上了打游戏 got hooked on video games); to bewilder; confused (迷惑 confuse; 迷路 lose one's way; 执迷不悟 refuse to see the light)

面积.meaning: area (房间的面积 the room's area; 覆盖面积 coverage area)
