near_synonyms.difference: 面对 is actively confronting or dealing with something; 面临 is being confronted with difficulties or choices, often passively.

面临.meaning: to face; to be confronted with (a problem, choice) (面临困难 face difficulties; 面临失业 face unemployment)

examples.hanzi: 公司面临着很大的困难。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī miànlín zhe hěn dà de kùnnan.
examples.english: The company is facing great difficulties.

面向.meaning: to face; to be geared toward (面向未来 face the future; 面向大众的服务 services aimed at the general public)

examples.hanzi: 这种产品主要面向年轻人。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng chǎnpǐn zhǔyào miànxiàng niánqīngrén.
examples.english: This product is aimed mainly at young people.

near_synonyms.difference: 描写 is literary depiction in writing; 描述 is recounting facts or how something looked.

描述.meaning: to describe; description (描述事情的经过 describe what happened; 根据他的描述 according to his description)

examples.hanzi: 请详细描述一下当时的情况。
examples.pinyin: qǐng xiángxì miáoshù yīxià dāngshí de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Please describe the situation at the time in detail.

迷路.meaning: to get lost; to lose one's way (在森林里迷路了 got lost in the forest)

examples.hanzi: 他在山里迷路了。
examples.pinyin: tā zài shān lǐ mílù le.
examples.english: He got lost in the mountains.

near_synonyms.difference: 机密 is a grave official or state secret; 秘密 is the everyday word for any secret.

秘密.meaning: secret (保守秘密 keep a secret; 秘密协议 a secret agreement)

examples.hanzi: 这是我们之间的秘密。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒmen zhījiān de mìmì.
examples.english: This is a secret between the two of us.

命1.meaning: life; fate; order (生命 life; 命运 fate; 拼命 with all one's might; 使命 mission; 命令 order)

examples.hanzi: 医生救了他一条命。
examples.pinyin: yīshēng jiù le tā yī tiáo mìng.
examples.english: The doctor saved his life.

敏感.meaning: sensitive (对价格很敏感 very price-sensitive; 敏感话题 a sensitive topic; 过敏的边缘敏感期 a sensitive period)

examples.hanzi: 她对别人的评价很敏感。
examples.pinyin: tā duì biérén de píngjià hěn mǐngǎn.
examples.english: She is very sensitive to other people's judgments of her.

near_synonyms.difference: 名字 is a person's name; 名称 is the name of an organization, product, or event.

名称.meaning: name; title (of an organization or thing) (产品名称 the product name; 公司名称 the company name)

examples.hanzi: 请填写公司名称和地址。
examples.pinyin: qǐng tiánxiě gōngsī míngchēng hé dìzhǐ.
examples.english: Please fill in the company name and address.

名牌.meaning: famous brand; designer (名牌大学 a prestigious university; 穿名牌 wear designer clothes)

examples.hanzi: 她从来不买名牌衣服。
examples.pinyin: tā cónglái bù mǎi míngpái yīfu.
examples.english: She never buys designer clothes.

名片.meaning: business card (交换名片 exchange business cards)

examples.hanzi: 我们交换一下名片吧。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen jiāohuàn yīxià míngpiàn ba.
examples.english: Let's exchange business cards.

near_synonyms.difference: 清楚 is plainly clear or understood; 明确 is explicit and definite about goals, attitudes, or responsibilities.

明确.meaning: clear; explicit; to make clear (明确的目标 a clear goal; 明确责任 make responsibilities clear)

examples.hanzi: 老师明确地告诉了我们考试范围。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī míngquè de gàosù le wǒmen kǎoshì fànwéi.
examples.english: The teacher told us clearly what the exam would cover.

near_synonyms.difference: 显然 is the speaker's judgment that something is obvious; 明显 describes a change or difference that is easy to see.

明显.meaning: obvious; evident (明显的进步 obvious progress; 明显不同 clearly different)

examples.hanzi: 他的汉语水平有了明显的进步。
examples.pinyin: tā de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng yǒu le míngxiǎn de jìnbù.
examples.english: His Chinese has visibly improved.

明星.meaning: star (celebrity) (电影明星 a film star; 娱乐圈明星 a star of the entertainment world)

examples.hanzi: 她小时候就想当明星。
examples.pinyin: tā xiǎoshíhou jiù xiǎng dāng míngxīng.
examples.english: She wanted to be a star when she was little.

near_synonyms.difference: 运气 is luck in chance events; 命运 is the overall course of a life, beyond chance.

命运.meaning: destiny; fate (掌握自己的命运 take control of your own destiny)

examples.hanzi: 每个人都应该掌握自己的命运。
examples.pinyin: měi gè rén dōu yīnggāi zhǎngwò zìjǐ de mìngyùn.
examples.english: Everyone should take control of their own destiny.

密切.meaning: close; intimate; closely (密切的关系 close ties; 密切关注 pay close attention; 密切配合 work in close coordination)

examples.hanzi: 这两个问题有密切的关系。
examples.pinyin: zhè liǎng gè wèntí yǒu mìqiè de guānxi.
examples.english: These two problems are closely related.

秘书.meaning: secretary (总经理的秘书 the general manager's secretary)

examples.hanzi: 经理的秘书帮他安排日程。
examples.pinyin: jīnglǐ de mìshū bāng tā ānpái rìchéng.
examples.english: The manager's secretary arranges his schedule for him.

摸.meaning: to touch; to feel (摸一摸小狗 pet the puppy; 摸黑 move in the dark); to feel for; to find out (摸清情况 size up the situation)

examples.hanzi: 黑暗中他摸到了开关。
examples.pinyin: hēi'àn zhōng tā mō dào le kāiguān.
examples.english: In the darkness he felt for the light switch and found it.

模糊.meaning: blurry; vague; to blur (照片很模糊 the photo is blurry; 记忆模糊 the memory is hazy; 界限模糊 the line is blurred)

examples.hanzi: 这张照片有点儿模糊。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhàopiàn yǒu diǎnr móhu.
examples.english: This photo is a little blurry.

near_synonyms.difference: 生疏 is rusty through lack of contact (skills, old friends); 陌生 is never having known something or someone before.

陌生.meaning: unfamiliar; strange (陌生的地方 an unfamiliar place; 陌生人 a stranger)

examples.hanzi: 我对这个城市还很陌生。
examples.pinyin: wǒ duì zhège chéngshì hái hěn mòshēng.
examples.english: This city is still quite unfamiliar to me.

模式.meaning: mode; pattern; model (商业模式 a business model; 教学模式 a teaching model)

examples.hanzi: 这种商业模式很成功。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng shāngyè móshì hěn chénggōng.
examples.english: This business model is very successful.

某.meaning: a certain; some (某人 someone; 某些 some; 某种程度 to some degree; 某天 one day)

examples.hanzi: 某人昨天来找过你。
examples.pinyin: mǒu rén zuótiān lái zhǎo guo nǐ.
examples.english: Someone came looking for you yesterday.

near_synonyms.difference: 眼光 is judgment or discernment, or a way of seeing; 目光 is the literal gaze.

目光.meaning: gaze; eyes; vision (吸引众人的目光 draw everyone's gaze; 目光短浅 short-sighted)

examples.hanzi: 她的目光一直看着窗外。
examples.pinyin: tā de mùguāng yīzhí kàn zhe chuāngwài.
examples.english: Her gaze kept resting on the view outside the window.

木头.meaning: wood; timber (一块木头 a piece of wood; 木头做的家具 furniture made of wood)

examples.hanzi: 这个椅子是木头做的。
examples.pinyin: zhège yǐzi shì mùtou zuò de.
examples.english: This chair is made of wood.

难得.meaning: rare; hard to come by (难得的机会 a rare opportunity; 难得他这么努力 it's rare for him to work so hard)

examples.hanzi: 这是一次难得的机会。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì yī cì nándé de jīhuì.
examples.english: This is a rare opportunity.

难度.meaning: difficulty; level of difficulty (难度很大 quite difficult; 增加难度 increase the difficulty)

examples.hanzi: 这道题的难度很大。
examples.pinyin: zhè dào tí de nándù hěn dà.
examples.english: This question is very difficult.

难以.meaning: hard to; difficult to (with disyllabic verbs) (难以置信 hard to believe; 难以形容 indescribable)

examples.hanzi: 这里的美难以用语言形容。
examples.pinyin: zhèlǐ de měi nányǐ yòng yǔyán xíngróng.
examples.english: The beauty here is hard to put into words.

男子.meaning: man; male (formal or news register) (一名男子 a man — news style; 男子汉 a real man)

examples.hanzi: 警察正在询问一名男子。
examples.pinyin: jǐngchá zhèngzài xúnwèn yī míng nánzǐ.
examples.english: The police are questioning a man.

near_synonyms.difference: 吵 is the adjective noisy; 闹 is making a disturbance or fooling around.

闹.meaning: to make noise; to cause a disturbance (别闹了 stop fooling around; 闹矛盾 have a falling-out; 闹钟 alarm clock — the clock that makes noise); to suffer (from) (闹水灾 have a flood; 闹肚子 have diarrhea); to make a scene (大闹一场 make a big scene)

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在教室里又闹起来了。
examples.pinyin: háizi men zài jiàoshì lǐ yòu nào qǐlái le.
examples.english: The kids started acting up again in the classroom.

闹钟.meaning: alarm clock (闹钟响了 the alarm went off; 上闹钟 set the alarm)

examples.hanzi: 闹钟一响我就起床了。
examples.pinyin: nàozhōng yī xiǎng wǒ jiù qǐchuáng le.
examples.english: I got up as soon as the alarm went off.

near_synonyms.difference: 即使 is the neutral hypothetical even-if; 哪怕 is concessive and colloquial, carrying determination or contrast.

哪怕.meaning: even if; even though (哪怕失败也要尝试 try even if you fail)

examples.hanzi: 哪怕再难，我也要坚持下去。
examples.pinyin: nàpà zài nán, wǒ yě yào jiānchí xiàqù.
examples.english: However hard it gets, I will keep going.

内部.meaning: interior; internal (内部消息 inside information; 内部矛盾 internal contradictions)

examples.hanzi: 这个消息只在公司内部流传。
examples.pinyin: zhège xiāoxi zhǐ zài gōngsī nèibù liúchuán.
examples.english: This news has only circulated inside the company.

能干.meaning: capable; competent (很能干 very capable; 能干的女人 a capable woman)

examples.hanzi: 她既能干又热心。
examples.pinyin: tā jì nénggàn yòu rèxīn.
examples.english: She is both capable and warm-hearted.

near_synonyms.difference: 读 is reading in general, silently or aloud; 念 is reading aloud, and colloquially attending school (念大学).

念.meaning: to read aloud (念课文 read the text aloud); to study (念大学 attend university); to miss (想念 miss someone); thought (念头 an idea); twenty (廿) — dated

examples.hanzi: 请大家跟我念这篇课文。
examples.pinyin: qǐng dàjiā gēn wǒ niàn zhè piān kèwén.
examples.english: Please read this text aloud after me.

年初.meaning: the beginning of the year (年初计划 plans for the start of the year)

examples.hanzi: 年初我们定了一个计划。
examples.pinyin: niánchū wǒmen dìng le yī gè jìhuà.
examples.english: At the beginning of the year we set a plan.

年代.meaning: age; era; decade (八十年代 the 1980s; 战争年代 the war years)

examples.hanzi: 这首歌让他想起了八十年代。
examples.pinyin: zhè shǒu gē ràng tā xiǎngqǐ le bāshí niándài.
examples.english: This song took him back to the eighties.

near_synonyms.difference: 年龄 is the neutral age in years for anyone; 年纪 is used about people, especially in 年纪大 for being advanced in years.

年纪.meaning: age (of a person) (年纪大了 getting on in years; 上年纪 advanced in years)

examples.hanzi: 爷爷年纪大了，走路慢。
examples.pinyin: yéye niánjì dà le, zǒulù màn.
examples.english: Grandpa is getting on in years and walks slowly.

年夜饭.meaning: New Year's Eve dinner (吃年夜饭 have the reunion dinner on New Year's Eve)

examples.hanzi: 除夕那天全家人一起吃年夜饭。
examples.pinyin: chúxī nà tiān quán jiā rén yīqǐ chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve the whole family has the reunion dinner together.

examples.hanzi: 他几乎每天都穿牛仔裤。
examples.pinyin: tā jīhū měitiān dōu chuān niúzǎikù.
examples.english: He wears jeans almost every day.

浓.meaning: dense; thick; concentrated (味道很浓 a strong flavor; 浓茶 strong tea; 兴趣很浓 great interest; 浓雾 dense fog; 浓眉 heavy eyebrows)

examples.hanzi: 我喜欢喝浓一点的茶。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan hē nóng yī diǎn de chá.
examples.english: I like my tea on the strong side.

农民.meaning: farmer; peasant (农民的收入 farmers' income; 农民工 migrant farm workers)

examples.hanzi: 这些农民种了一辈子地。
examples.pinyin: zhèxiē nóngmín zhòng le yī bèizi dì.
examples.english: These farmers have worked the land all their lives.

农业.meaning: agriculture (发展农业 develop agriculture; 农业现代化 agricultural modernization)

examples.hanzi: 这个国家的农业比较落后。
examples.pinyin: zhège guójiā de nóngyè bǐjiào luòhòu.
examples.english: This country's agriculture is rather backward.

女子.meaning: woman; female (formal or sports register) (女子足球队 a women's football team; 一名女子 a woman — news style)

examples.hanzi: 女子组决赛下午三点开始。
examples.pinyin: nǚzǐ zǔ juésài xiàwǔ sān diǎn kāishǐ.
examples.english: The women's final starts at three in the afternoon.

哦.meaning: oh; ah — expressing sudden understanding (哦，原来是这样 oh, so that's how it is)

examples.hanzi: 哦，原来是你啊！
examples.pinyin: ó, yuánlái shì nǐ a!
examples.english: Oh, so it's you!

near_synonyms.difference: 偶尔 is a frequency adverb — from time to time; 偶然 means by chance, accidental.

偶然.meaning: accidental; by chance (偶然的发现 a chance discovery; 偶然相遇 meet by chance)

examples.hanzi: 这是一个很偶然的发现。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì yī gè hěn ǒurán de fāxiàn.
examples.english: This was quite a chance discovery.

欧洲.meaning: Europe (欧洲国家 European countries; 欧洲联盟 the European Union)

examples.hanzi: 欧洲有很多有趣的国家。
examples.pinyin: ōuzhōu yǒu hěn duō yǒuqù de guójiā.
examples.english: There are many interesting countries in Europe.

near_synonyms.difference: 分配 distributes tasks or resources systematically; 派 dispatches a person on a specific errand or mission.

派.meaning: to dispatch; to send (派人 send someone; 派出所 local police station); faction; school (of thought) (学派 a school of thought; 派别 faction); pie (苹果派 apple pie); measure word for schools/styles — 一派新气象 a breath of fresh air

examples.hanzi: 公司派他去上海出差。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī pài tā qù Shànghǎi chūchāi.
examples.english: The company sent him to Shanghai on business.

派出所.meaning: local police station (到派出所报案 report a case at the local police station)

examples.hanzi: 钱包被偷了，我去派出所报案。
examples.pinyin: qiánbāo bèi tōu le, wǒ qù pàichūsuǒ bào'àn.
examples.english: My wallet was stolen — I'm going to the police station to report it.

near_synonyms.difference: 排序 is ordering data or ranking by criteria; 排列 is arranging things in rows or sequences.

排列.meaning: to arrange in order; arrangement (按顺序排列 arrange in order; 座位的排列 the seating arrangement)

examples.hanzi: 请把这些单词按字母顺序排列。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ zhèxiē dāncí àn zìmǔ shùnxù páiliè.
examples.english: Please arrange these words in alphabetical order.

拍摄.meaning: to shoot (a film, photo) (拍摄地点 the shooting location; 拍摄纪录片 shoot a documentary)

examples.hanzi: 这部电影在西藏拍摄的。
examples.pinyin: zhè bù diànyǐng zài Xīzàng pāishè de.
examples.english: This film was shot in Tibet.

跑道.meaning: runway; track (飞机跑道 an airport runway; 田径跑道 a running track)

examples.hanzi: 运动员们正在跑道上训练。
examples.pinyin: yùndòngyuán men zhèngzài pǎodào shàng xùnliàn.
examples.english: The athletes are training on the track.

near_synonyms.difference: 赔偿 is the formal disyllabic verb for compensation for loss or damage; 赔 is more colloquial and also means to lose money (赔钱).

赔.meaning: to compensate; to pay for a loss (损坏东西要赔 if you damage it you must pay); to lose (money) (赔本 sell at a loss); to make it up to someone (赔礼道歉 apologize)

examples.hanzi: 打坏了别人的东西要赔。
examples.pinyin: dǎ huài le biérén de dōngxi yào péi.
examples.english: If you break someone's things, you have to pay for them.

near_synonyms.difference: 适合 means something suits a person or purpose; 配 is to match or go together, and to mix or combine (配药).

配.meaning: to match; to fit (颜色很配 the colors match; 配钥匙 cut a key); to mix (配方 recipe/formula); to allot (分配 distribute); to deserve (配得上 worthy of)

examples.hanzi: 这条领带很配你的西装。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo lǐngdài hěn pèi nǐ de xīzhuāng.
examples.english: This tie goes well with your suit.

near_synonyms.difference: 陪同 formally accompanies a guest or official on an activity; 陪伴 is everyday companionship, with emotional closeness.

陪伴.meaning: to accompany; to keep company (陪伴孩子成长 accompany one's children as they grow; 有家人陪伴 with family at one's side)

examples.hanzi: 周末她常陪伴父母聊天。
examples.pinyin: zhōumò tā cháng péibàn fùmǔ liáotiān.
examples.english: On weekends she often keeps her parents company and chats with them.

near_synonyms.difference: 合作 is parties working together on a shared project; 配合 is one side fitting in with another's plan or treatment.

配合.meaning: to coordinate; to cooperate; fitting (密切配合 coordinate closely; 配合治疗 cooperate with the treatment; 配合默契 work in seamless cooperation)

examples.hanzi: 手术很成功，病人配合得很好。
examples.pinyin: shǒushù hěn chénggōng, bìngrén pèihé de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: The operation went well — the patient cooperated fully.

配送.meaning: to deliver (goods) (配送中心 a distribution center; 外卖配送 food delivery)

examples.hanzi: 这家超市免费配送水果。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā chāoshì miǎnfèi pèisòng shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: This supermarket delivers fruit free of charge.

near_synonyms.difference: 训练 drills physical or technical skills (athletes, troops); 培训 is instruction to qualify staff for a job.

培训.meaning: to train; training (员工培训 staff training; 参加培训 attend training)

examples.hanzi: 新员工要先参加三个月的培训。
examples.pinyin: xīn yuángōng yào xiān cānjiā sān gè yuè de péixùn.
examples.english: New employees must first attend three months of training.

near_synonyms.difference: 教育 is systematic schooling and moral instruction; 培养 is gradually developing an ability, habit, or person.

培养.meaning: to cultivate; to train up (培养人才 cultivate talent; 培养兴趣 foster an interest; 培养细菌 culture bacteria)

examples.hanzi: 老师应该培养学生的兴趣。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī yīnggāi péiyǎng xuéshēng de xìngqù.
examples.english: Teachers should foster students' interests.

盆.meaning: basin; pot (洗脸盆 a washbasin; 花盆 a flowerpot); measure word for potfuls — 一盆花 a potted flower, 一盆水 a basin of water

examples.hanzi: 阳台上摆着几盆花。
examples.pinyin: yángtái shàng bǎi zhe jǐ pén huā.
examples.english: Several pots of flowers sit on the balcony.

near_synonyms.difference: 撞 is a strong collision, often accidental and damaging; 碰 is a light touch or bump, and colloquially to meet or to try.

碰.meaning: to touch; to bump (碰了一下头 bumped one's head); to meet (碰见 run into); to try one's luck (碰运气 try one's luck); 碰杯 clink glasses

examples.hanzi: 小心别碰到头。
examples.pinyin: xiǎoxīn bié pèng dào tóu.
examples.english: Careful not to bump your head.

near_synonyms.difference: 遇见 is any encounter; 碰见 stresses the chance, unplanned nature of meeting someone.

碰见.meaning: to run into; to bump into (someone by chance) (在超市碰见了老朋友 ran into an old friend at the supermarket)

examples.hanzi: 我在超市碰见了小学同学。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài chāoshì pèngjiàn le xiǎoxué tóngxué.
examples.english: I ran into an elementary-school classmate at the supermarket.

匹.meaning: measure word for horses — 一匹马 a horse

examples.hanzi: 草原上跑着一匹白马。
examples.pinyin: cǎoyuán shàng pǎo zhe yī pǐ báimǎ.
examples.english: A white horse is running on the grassland.

批1.meaning: batch; lot (第一批 the first batch; 一批货物 a shipment of goods); wholesale (批发 wholesale)

examples.hanzi: 书店刚进了一批新书。
examples.pinyin: shūdiàn gāng jìn le yī pī xīn shū.
examples.english: The bookstore has just received a new batch of books.

near_synonyms.difference: 批准 is the formal approval of applications or requests; 批 is the single verb, also meaning to annotate or to criticize (批评).

批2.meaning: to comment on; to criticize (批评 criticize); to approve; to check and sign off (审批 examine and approve; 批准 approve; 批作业 mark homework)

examples.hanzi: 这份报告领导已经批了。
examples.pinyin: zhè fèn bàogào lǐngdǎo yǐjīng pī le.
examples.english: The leadership has already signed off on this report.

near_synonyms.difference: 欺骗 is the formal word for deceiving; 骗 is colloquial and covers cheating someone of money or telling lies.

骗.meaning: to deceive; to cheat (骗人 deceive people; 受骗 be taken in; 骗钱 swindle money)

examples.hanzi: 网上有人骗他的钱。
examples.pinyin: wǎngshang yǒu rén piàn tā de qián.
examples.english: Someone online cheated him out of his money.

品.meaning: product; item (产品 product; 商品 merchandise); grade; quality (品质 quality); to taste; to appraise (品尝 taste; 品茶 savor tea; 品味 savor/grade); suffix for goods — 食品 foodstuffs, 礼品 gifts

examples.hanzi: 商店里的商品十分丰富。
examples.pinyin: shāngdiàn lǐ de shāngpǐn shífēn fēngfù.
examples.english: The goods in the shop are very abundant.

拼.meaning: to piece together (拼图 jigsaw puzzle; 拼音 spell in pinyin); to go all out; to strive (拼命 risk one's life, go all out; 拼搏 struggle; 在深圳打拼 strive in Shenzhen)

examples.hanzi: 弟弟在客厅里拼积木。
examples.pinyin: dìdi zài kètīng lǐ pīn jīmù.
examples.english: My little brother is putting together building blocks in the living room.

平.meaning: flat; level (平坦 flat and level; 平地 flat ground); peaceful; calm (和平 peace; 平静 calm); average; ordinary (平凡 ordinary; 平常 ordinary); equal (平等 equal; 公平 fair); to level out (把地平一平 level the ground)

examples.hanzi: 这条路很平，骑车很舒服。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo lù hěn píng, qí chē hěn shūfu.
examples.english: This road is very flat — comfortable for cycling.

评.meaning: to comment; to judge; to evaluate (评价 evaluate; 评论 comment; 批评 criticize; 评分 grade; 评委 judge (of a competition))

examples.hanzi: 评委给这场比赛打了高分。
examples.pinyin: píngwěi gěi zhè chǎng bǐsài dǎ le gāo fēn.
examples.english: The judges gave this competition a high score.

near_synonyms.difference: 靠 is the everyday word for relying on someone or leaning on; 凭 is formal, basing an action on a credential or ability.

凭.meaning: on the basis of; by means of (凭票入场 admission by ticket; 凭本事 by one's own ability); to rely on (凭借 rely on)

examples.hanzi: 请凭票入场。
examples.pinyin: qǐng píng piào rùchǎng.
examples.english: Please enter with your ticket.

平安.meaning: safe and sound (一路平安 have a safe journey; 平安夜 Christmas Eve)

examples.hanzi: 祝您一路平安。
examples.pinyin: zhù nín yī lù píng'ān.
examples.english: Wishing you a safe journey.

平衡.meaning: balance (保持平衡 keep one's balance; 生态平衡 ecological balance; 收支平衡 balanced budget)

examples.hanzi: 骑自行车要保持平衡。
examples.pinyin: qí zìxíngchē yào bǎochí pínghéng.
examples.english: You have to keep your balance when riding a bike.

near_synonyms.difference: 评论 expresses opinions or commentary, e.g. on news; 评价 assesses worth or quality against a standard.

评价.meaning: to evaluate; to judge; evaluation (客观评价 make an objective assessment; 用户评价 user reviews)

examples.hanzi: 老师对这篇作文的评价很高。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī duì zhè piān zuòwén de píngjià hěn gāo.
examples.english: The teacher rated this essay very highly.

凭借.meaning: to rely on; on the strength of (凭借实力 succeed on one's own merits; 凭借记忆 from memory)

examples.hanzi: 他凭借多年的经验解决了难题。
examples.pinyin: tā píngjiè duō nián de jīngyàn jiějué le nántí.
examples.english: He solved the hard problem by drawing on years of experience.

near_synonyms.difference: 安静 is free from noise; 平静 is untroubled — still water or a composed mind.

平静.meaning: calm; tranquil (心情平静 a calm state of mind; 平静的湖面 a still lake; 恢复平静 calm down)

examples.hanzi: 风暴过后，湖面又恢复了平静。
examples.pinyin: fēngbào guòhòu, húmiàn yòu huīfù le píngjìng.
examples.english: After the storm, the lake returned to calm.

平均.meaning: average; on average (平均温度 the average temperature; 平均每人三本 three books per person on average; 平均分配 divide equally)

examples.hanzi: 这个班平均年龄十五岁。
examples.pinyin: zhège bān píngjūn niánlíng shíwǔ suì.
examples.english: The average age in this class is fifteen.

屏幕.meaning: screen (电脑屏幕 a computer screen; 触摸屏 a touchscreen)

examples.hanzi: 他把文件投到大屏幕上。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ wénjiàn tóu dào dà píngmù shàng.
examples.english: He projected the document onto the big screen.

平台.meaning: platform (网络平台 an online platform; 提供交流平台 provide a platform for exchange; 车站平台 the station platform)

examples.hanzi: 这个平台可以在线学习汉语。
examples.pinyin: zhège píngtái kěyǐ zàixiàn xuéxí Hànyǔ.
examples.english: You can learn Chinese online on this platform.

品牌.meaning: brand (知名品牌 a well-known brand; 品牌效应 brand power)

examples.hanzi: 消费者越来越重视品牌。
examples.pinyin: xiāofèizhě yuèláiyuè zhòngshì pǐnpái.
examples.english: Consumers pay more and more attention to brands.

near_synonyms.difference: 邀请 invites someone to an event; 聘请 hires a professional for a position, formal and contract-based.

聘请.meaning: to engage; to hire (a professional) (聘请律师 hire a lawyer; 聘请顾问 engage a consultant)

examples.hanzi: 学校聘请了一位外国专家教英语。
examples.pinyin: xuéxiào pìnqǐng le yī wèi wàiguó zhuānjiā jiāo Yīngyǔ.
examples.english: The school engaged a foreign expert to teach English.

拼音.meaning: pinyin; phonetic spelling (汉语拼音 Hanyu Pinyin; 标注拼音 mark the pinyin)

examples.hanzi: 一年级的学生正在学拼音。
examples.pinyin: yī niánjí de xuéshēng zhèngzài xué pīnyīn.
examples.english: The first-graders are learning pinyin.

near_synonyms.difference: 质量 is the standard word for quality of goods or services; 品质 also covers moral character and is more formal.

品质.meaning: quality; character (产品的品质 product quality; 高品质的服务 top-quality service; 道德品质 moral character)

examples.hanzi: 这家企业十分重视产品品质。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā qǐyè shífēn zhòngshì chǎnpǐn pǐnzhì.
examples.english: This company takes product quality very seriously.

near_synonyms.difference: 种类 is any classification of kinds; 品种 is specifically cultivated breeds or strains of plants and animals.

品种.meaning: variety; breed; kind (葡萄的品种 grape varieties; 新品种 a new strain)

examples.hanzi: 这个公园里有上百个品种的玫瑰。
examples.pinyin: zhège gōngyuán lǐ yǒu shàng bǎi gè pǐnzhǒng de méigui.
examples.english: There are over a hundred varieties of roses in this park.

near_synonyms.difference: 同意 is agreeing with a person or idea; 批准 is an authority formally approving a request.

批准.meaning: to approve; to ratify (上级批准了 the higher level approved; 获得批准 obtain approval)

examples.hanzi: 他的出国申请终于被批准了。
examples.pinyin: tā de chūguó shēnqǐng zhōngyú bèi pīzhǔn le.
examples.english: His application to go abroad was finally approved.

破坏.meaning: to destroy; to damage; destruction (破坏环境 damage the environment; 遭到破坏 suffered damage)

examples.hanzi: 乱扔垃圾会破坏环境。
examples.pinyin: luàn rēng lājī huì pòhuài huánjìng.
examples.english: Littering damages the environment.

普及.meaning: to popularize; to spread widely; universal (普及教育 universal education; 智能手机已经普及 smartphones have become universal)

examples.hanzi: 智能手机在乡村也已经普及了。
examples.pinyin: zhìnéng shǒujī zài xiāngcūn yě yǐjīng pǔjí le.
examples.english: Smartphones have already become widespread in the countryside.

齐.meaning: neat; even; complete (牙齿整齐 even teeth; 东西都齐了 everything is ready; 人齐了吗 is everyone here?); together (一齐 simultaneously); ready (准备齐了 all prepared)

examples.hanzi: 人到齐了，我们开会吧。
examples.pinyin: rén dào qí le, wǒmen kāihuì ba.
examples.english: Everyone is here — let's start the meeting.

其.meaning: its; his; her; their; that (formal literary pronoun) (其实 actually; 其中 among them; 其他 others; 其余 the rest; 尤其 especially)

examples.hanzi: 其中有几个人我认识。
examples.pinyin: qízhōng yǒu jǐ gè rén wǒ rènshi.
examples.english: I know a few of them.

欠.meaning: to owe (欠债 owe a debt; 欠他一个人情 owe him a favor); to lack; to be wanting (还欠点火候 still needs a little more work)

examples.hanzi: 他还欠着银行一大笔钱。
examples.pinyin: tā hái qiàn zhe yínháng yī dà bǐ qián.
examples.english: He still owes the bank a large sum of money.

浅.meaning: shallow (河水很浅 the river is shallow); light in color (颜色太浅 the color is too light); simple; superficial (功底浅 shallow grounding; 浅见 a humble view)

examples.hanzi: 这条河的水很浅。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo hé de shuǐ hěn qiǎn.
examples.english: The water in this river is shallow.

签1.meaning: to sign; to make one's mark (签名 sign one's name; 签字 sign a document; 签合同 sign a contract; 签证 visa)

examples.hanzi: 请在这里签上您的名字。
examples.pinyin: qǐng zài zhèlǐ qiān shàng nín de míngzi.
examples.english: Please sign your name here.

near_synonyms.difference: 签署 is solemnly signing documents by leaders or parties; 签订 is concluding and signing a contract or treaty, stressing the agreement reached.

签订.meaning: to conclude and sign (a treaty or contract) (签订协议 sign an agreement; 签订合同 conclude a contract)

examples.hanzi: 两家公司昨天签订了合作协议。
examples.pinyin: liǎng jiā gōngsī zuótiān qiāndìng le hézuò xiéyì.
examples.english: The two companies signed a cooperation agreement yesterday.

墙.meaning: wall (墙上挂着一幅画 a picture hangs on the wall; 城墙 a city wall)

examples.hanzi: 墙上挂着一幅山水画。
examples.pinyin: qiáng shàng guà zhe yī fú shānshuǐ huà.
examples.english: A landscape painting hangs on the wall.

near_synonyms.difference: 争夺 is contending for something significant over a long struggle; 抢 is the quick, colloquial grab or snatch.

抢.meaning: to snatch; to grab (抢钱包 snatch a wallet; 抢座位 grab a seat; 抢时间 race against time; 抢购 snap up (bargains); rob (抢劫 rob))

examples.hanzi: 节日的时候大家都在抢打折商品。
examples.pinyin: jiérì de shíhou dàjiā dōu zài qiǎng dǎzhé shāngpǐn.
examples.english: During the holidays everyone was grabbing discounted goods.

near_synonyms.difference: 强壮 describes physical bodily strength; 强大 is power of a country, force, or influence.

强大.meaning: powerful; strong (强大的祖国 a powerful country; 实力强大 formidably strong)

examples.hanzi: 经过多年发展，这支队伍变得非常强大。
examples.pinyin: jīngguò duō nián fāzhǎn, zhè zhī duìwǔ biàn de fēicháng qiángdà.
examples.english: After years of development this team has become very strong.

near_synonyms.difference: 重视 is valuing something in one's attitude; 强调 is verbally stressing a point to others.

强调.meaning: to stress; to emphasize (强调重点 emphasize the key points; 他强调说 he stressed that)

examples.hanzi: 老师再三强调要注意安全。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī zàisān qiángdiào yào zhùyì ānquán.
examples.english: The teacher stressed again and again to be careful about safety.

强度.meaning: intensity; strength (劳动强度 the intensity of labor; 高强度训练 high-intensity training)

examples.hanzi: 这次训练的强度比上次大。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì xùnliàn de qiángdù bǐ shàng cì dà.
examples.english: The intensity of this training session was greater than last time.

near_synonyms.difference: 拯救 is saving from disaster or ruin, often abstract; 抢救 is emergency rescue of the critically ill or of property.

抢救.meaning: to rescue; emergency treatment (抢救病人 make an all-out effort to save a patient; 抢救文物 salvage cultural relics)

examples.hanzi: 医生们连夜抢救受伤的工人。
examples.pinyin: yīshēng men liányè qiǎngjiù shòushāng de gōngrén.
examples.english: The doctors worked through the night to save the injured workers.

near_synonyms.difference: 激烈 describes fierce competition, argument, or fighting; 强烈 describes strong feelings, light, reactions, or demands.

强烈.meaning: intense; strong (强烈的责任感 a strong sense of duty; 反应强烈 a strong reaction; 强烈要求 demand strongly)

examples.hanzi: 观众对这部电影的反应十分强烈。
examples.pinyin: guānzhòng duì zhè bù diànyǐng de fǎnyìng shífēn qiángliè.
examples.english: The audience's reaction to this film was very strong.

near_synonyms.difference: 进步 is improving to a better level; 前进 is literally moving forward or advancing toward a goal.

前进.meaning: to go forward; to advance (继续前进 press on; 阻碍前进 hinder progress)

examples.hanzi: 不管遇到什么困难，我们都要继续前进。
examples.pinyin: bùguǎn yùdào shénme kùnnan, wǒmen dōu yào jìxù qiánjìn.
examples.english: Whatever difficulties we meet, we must keep moving forward.

near_synonyms.difference: 来到 is neutral arrival; 前来 is formal, coming with a purpose, often in announcements.

前来.meaning: to come (formal, purposeful) (专程前来 come specifically; 前来参观 come to visit)

examples.hanzi: 各地游客纷纷前来参观展览。
examples.pinyin: gè dì yóukè fēnfēn qiánlái cānguān zhǎnlǎn.
examples.english: Tourists from all over have been coming to see the exhibition.

near_synonyms.difference: 签字 is signing official documents; 签名 is signing one's name, including autographs for fans.

签名.meaning: to sign one's name; autograph (请在这里签名 please sign here; 收集明星签名 collect autographs)

examples.hanzi: 球迷们排队请运动员签名。
examples.pinyin: qiúmí men páiduì qǐng yùndòngyuán qiānmíng.
examples.english: The fans lined up to ask the athletes for autographs.

near_synonyms.difference: 未来 is the neutral future as time; 前途 is a person's or endeavor's prospects, often in 前途光明/没前途.

前途.meaning: future; prospects (前途光明 a bright future; 有前途 promising)

examples.hanzi: 这个行业前途光明。
examples.pinyin: zhège hángyè qiántú guāngmíng.
examples.english: This industry has a bright future.

near_synonyms.difference: 去 is the everyday verb; 前往 is formal for proceeding to a destination, common in news.

前往.meaning: to head for; to proceed to (前往机场 head for the airport)

examples.hanzi: 代表团明天前往上海访问。
examples.pinyin: dàibiǎotuán míngtiān qiánwǎng Shànghǎi fǎngwèn.
examples.english: The delegation heads for Shanghai tomorrow.

签字.meaning: to sign (a document) (在合同上签字 sign the contract)

examples.hanzi: 经理让我在合同上签字。
examples.pinyin: jīnglǐ ràng wǒ zài hétóng shàng qiānzì.
examples.english: The manager asked me to sign the contract.

near_synonyms.difference: 偷偷 means secretly so no one finds out, often with wrongdoing; 悄悄 is quietly, without noise, not necessarily hiding anything.

悄悄.meaning: quietly; on the quiet (悄悄地离开了 left quietly; 悄悄话 a whispered confidence)

examples.hanzi: 他悄悄地走进了房间。
examples.pinyin: tā qiāoqiāo de zǒu jìn le fángjiān.
examples.english: He slipped quietly into the room.

near_synonyms.difference: 希望 is generally hoping for something; 期待 is expecting with anticipation of something good coming.

期待.meaning: to look forward to; to await (期待你的回复 look forward to your reply; 期待已久的旅行 the long-awaited trip)

examples.hanzi: 我们非常期待你的到来。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen fēicháng qīdài nǐ de dàolái.
examples.english: We are very much looking forward to your arrival.

切.meaning: to cut; to slice (切菜 chop vegetables; 切成小块 cut into small pieces; 切西瓜 cut a watermelon)

examples.hanzi: 他把西瓜切成了一块一块的。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ xīguā qiē chéng le yī kuài yī kuài de.
examples.english: He cut the watermelon into pieces.

切.meaning: to be close to; to fit (切身 of immediate concern; 切合实际 suit actual conditions); urgently; eagerly (迫切 urgent; 急切 eager; 切记 remember well)

examples.hanzi: 这个建议切合实际。
examples.pinyin: zhège jiànyì qièhé shíjì.
examples.english: This suggestion fits the actual situation.

奇迹.meaning: miracle; wonder (创造奇迹 work a miracle; 医学上的奇迹 a medical miracle)

examples.hanzi: 他能活下来，简直是医学上的奇迹。
examples.pinyin: tā néng huó xiàlái, jiǎnzhí shì yīxué shàng de qíjì.
examples.english: His survival is simply a medical miracle.

near_synonyms.difference: 时期 names a stretch of historical or personal time; 期间 is the duration of a named event, used with 在…期间.

期间.meaning: period; duration (春节期间 during the Spring Festival; 在学习期间 during one's studies)

examples.hanzi: 春节期间，火车站非常拥挤。
examples.pinyin: chūnjié qījiān, huǒchēzhàn fēicháng yōngjǐ.
examples.english: During the Spring Festival the train stations are very crowded.

near_synonyms.difference: 亲近 emphasizes being on familiar, friendly terms with someone; 亲 emphasizes blood relation or deep intimacy.

亲.meaning: close; intimate; related by blood (亲人 one's closest kin; 亲戚 relatives; 亲近 close); parent (父亲 father; 母亲 mother; 双亲 both parents); in person (亲自 personally); to kiss (亲吻 kiss)

examples.hanzi: 这些孩子跟爷爷奶奶很亲。
examples.pinyin: zhèxiē háizi gēn yéye nǎinai hěn qīn.
examples.english: These kids are very close to their grandparents.

亲爱.meaning: dear; beloved (亲爱的同学们 dear classmates; 亲爱的人 beloved person)

examples.hanzi: 亲爱的妈妈,谢谢您。
examples.pinyin: qīn'ài de māma, xièxie nín.
examples.english: Dear Mom, thank you.

near_synonyms.difference: 勤劳 describes an industrious nature, often of laborers; 勤奋 emphasizes diligent effort in study or work.

勤奋.meaning: diligent; hardworking (勤奋学习 study diligently; 天道酬勤勤能补拙 diligence pays)

examples.hanzi: 他工作非常勤奋。
examples.pinyin: tā gōngzuò fēicháng qínfèn.
examples.english: He is very diligent in his work.

青.meaning: blue-green; green (青草 green grass); young (青年 youth; 青春 youth); black (青丝 black hair — literary)

examples.hanzi: 青草长满了山坡。
examples.pinyin: qīngcǎo zhǎng mǎn le shānpō.
examples.english: Green grass covers the hillside.

near_synonyms.difference: 感情 is the everyday word for feelings between people; 情感 is more formal and abstract (emotions in general).

情感.meaning: emotion; feeling (情感丰富 emotionally rich; 控制情感 control one's emotions)

examples.hanzi: 他不太会表达自己的情感。
examples.pinyin: tā bù tài huì biǎodá zìjǐ de qínggǎn.
examples.english: He isn't good at expressing his emotions.

near_synonyms.difference: 咨询 means consulting a professional/service; 请教 is humbly asking a person you respect for advice.

请教.meaning: to ask for advice (向老师请教 ask the teacher for advice; 请教问题 ask about a question)

examples.hanzi: 我有问题想向您请教。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yǒu wèntí xiǎng xiàng nín qǐngjiào.
examples.english: I have a question I'd like to ask your advice on.

near_synonyms.difference: 场景 is a concrete scene/setting (in a film, event); 情景 is a recalled situation and its circumstances.

情景.meaning: scene; circumstances (童年的情景 childhood scenes; 当时的情景 the scene at the time)

examples.hanzi: 我还记得毕业那天的情景。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hái jìde bìyè nà tiān de qíngjǐng.
examples.english: I still remember the scene on graduation day.

near_synonyms.difference: 要求 is a demand or requirement, stronger; 请求 is a humble, polite appeal.

请求.meaning: to request; to ask for; request (提出请求 make a request; 请求帮助 ask for help)

examples.hanzi: 他请求老板给他一天假。
examples.pinyin: tā qǐngqiú lǎobǎn gěi tā yī tiān jià.
examples.english: He asked his boss to give him a day off.

near_synonyms.difference: 心情 is one's everyday mood; 情绪 is stronger, can denote emotional agitation (情绪激动).

情绪.meaning: mood; emotion (情绪低落 feeling low; 控制情绪 control one's emotions; 情绪稳定 emotionally stable)

examples.hanzi: 今天他情绪很好。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān tā qíngxù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He is in a very good mood today.

轻易.meaning: easily; rashly (usually in negatives) (不轻易放弃 not give up easily; 轻易相信别人 trust people too readily)

examples.hanzi: 他不轻易答应别人。
examples.pinyin: tā bù qīngyì dāying biérén.
examples.english: He doesn't make promises to people easily.

轻重.meaning: weight; relative importance (分清轻重缓急 distinguish the urgent from the important; 病情的轻重 the severity of the illness)

examples.hanzi: 做事要分清轻重。

说服.meaning: to persuade; to convince (说服父母 persuade one's parents; 我被他说服了 he talked me around)

examples.hanzi: 我说服了父母同意我一个人去旅行。
examples.pinyin: wǒ shuōfú le fùmǔ tóngyì wǒ yī ge rén qù lǚxíng
examples.english: I persuaded my parents to agree to let me travel alone.

examples.hanzi: 他被我的理由说服了。
examples.pinyin: tā bèi wǒ de lǐyóu shuōfú le
examples.english: He was convinced by my reasoning.

熟人.meaning: acquaintance; someone one knows (遇到熟人 run into an acquaintance; 都是熟人 they are all acquaintances)

examples.hanzi: 我在机场遇到了一个熟人。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài jīchǎng yùdào le yī ge shúrén
examples.english: I ran into an acquaintance at the airport.

examples.hanzi: 这家店只做熟人的生意。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn zhǐ zuò shúrén de shēngyì
examples.english: This shop only does business with people the owner knows.

输入.meaning: to input; to import (输入密码 enter a password; 输入法 input method; 从国外输入 import from abroad)

examples.hanzi: 请输入密码后再按回车键。
examples.pinyin: qǐng shūrù mìmǎ hòu zài àn huíchē jiàn
examples.english: Please enter your password and then press Enter.

examples.hanzi: 这个软件可以把语音输入成文字。
examples.pinyin: zhège ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ bǎ yǔyīn shūrù chéng wénzì
examples.english: This software can convert voice input into text.

near_synonyms.difference: 舒服 is the everyday word describing how something feels to the body (坐得很舒服); 舒适 describes an environment or setting that provides comfort, slightly more formal/written.

舒适.meaning: comfortable; cozy (舒适的环境 a comfortable environment; 舒适的温度 a pleasant temperature)

examples.hanzi: 这家酒店的房间宽敞又舒适。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā jiǔdiàn de fángjiān kuānchang yòu shūshì
examples.english: The rooms in this hotel are spacious and comfortable.

examples.hanzi: 我换上了舒适的运动鞋。
examples.pinyin: wǒ huàn shàng le shūshì de yùndòngxié
examples.english: I changed into comfortable sneakers.

属于.meaning: to belong to; to be part of (这本书属于图书馆 this book belongs to the library; 属于常见错误 counts as a common mistake)

examples.hanzi: 这片土地属于国家。
examples.pinyin: zhè piàn tǔdì shǔyú guójiā
examples.english: This land belongs to the state.

examples.hanzi: 成功属于努力的人。
examples.pinyin: chénggōng shǔyú nǔlì de rén
examples.english: Success belongs to those who work hard.

near_synonyms.difference: 到处 is the plain 'everywhere'; 四处 stresses movement or looking in all four directions, more written-flavored than 到处.

四处.meaning: in all directions; everywhere (四处张望 look around in all directions; 四处寻找 search everywhere)

examples.hanzi: 他四处找工作，可是哪儿都不要人。
examples.pinyin: tā sìchù zhǎo gōngzuò, kěshì nǎr dōu bù yào rén
examples.english: He looked for work everywhere, but nobody was hiring.

examples.hanzi: 小狗四处闻了闻，才坐下。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo gǒu sìchù wén le wén, cái zuò xià
examples.english: The little dog sniffed around in all directions before sitting down.

near_synonyms.difference: 好像 is more colloquial and also literally means 'to resemble'; 似乎 is slightly more written and only expresses 'it seems', marking an uncertain judgment.

似乎.meaning: it seems; as if (他似乎有点儿不高兴 he seems a bit unhappy; 似乎有道理 it seems to make sense)

examples.hanzi: 他似乎不太高兴，一句话也没说。
examples.pinyin: tā sìhū bù tài gāoxìng, yī jù huà yě méi shuō
examples.english: He didn't seem very happy; he didn't say a word.

examples.hanzi: 这个说法似乎有道理。
examples.pinyin: zhège shuōfǎ sìhū yǒu dàolǐ
examples.english: This claim seems to make sense.

near_synonyms.difference: 想 covers wanting, missing, and casual thinking; 思考 is deliberate, systematic thinking about a question or problem.

思考.meaning: to think over; to reflect; thinking (独立思考 think independently; 深入思考 think deeply)

examples.hanzi: 遇到问题要先独立思考，再问别人。
examples.pinyin: yùdào wèntí yào xiān dúlì sīkǎo, zài wèn biérén
examples.english: When you meet a problem, think it through independently first, then ask others.

examples.hanzi: 他思考了很久，才做出决定。
examples.pinyin: tā sīkǎo le hěn jiǔ, cái zuò chū juédìng
examples.english: He thought for a long time before making a decision.

near_synonyms.difference: 个人 contrasts one individual with the collective (个人意见 personal opinion); 私人 stresses privacy and non-public ownership (私人飞机 a private plane).

私人.meaning: private; personal (私人财产 private property; 私人飞机 a private plane; 私人时间 one's own time)

examples.hanzi: 这是我的私人电话，请别告诉别人。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ de sīrén diànhuà, qǐng bié gàosù biérén
examples.english: This is my private phone number; please don't tell anyone.

examples.hanzi: 游泳池只对会员的私人朋友开放。
examples.pinyin: yóuyǒngchí zhǐ duì huìyuán de sīrén péngyou kāifàng
examples.english: The pool is open only to members' personal friends.

思维.meaning: thinking; thought process (思维方式 way of thinking; 逻辑思维 logical thinking; 创新思维 innovative thinking)

examples.hanzi: 学习数学能锻炼逻辑思维。
examples.pinyin: xuéxí shùxué néng duànliàn luójí sīwéi
examples.english: Studying math can train logical thinking.

examples.hanzi: 他们的思维方式完全不同。
examples.pinyin: tāmen de sīwéi fāngshì wánquán bùtóng
examples.english: Their ways of thinking are completely different.

near_synonyms.difference: 思维 is the cognitive process of thinking (逻辑思维 logical thinking); 思想 is the content — ideas, views, ideology (思想开放 open-minded).

思想.meaning: thought; thinking; ideology (思想变化 a change in thinking; 思想教育 ideological education; 他的思想很开放 he is very open-minded)

examples.hanzi: 这本书改变了他的思想。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn shū gǎibiàn le tā de sīxiǎng
examples.english: This book changed his thinking.

examples.hanzi: 大学是交流思想的地方。
examples.pinyin: dàxué shì jiāoliú sīxiǎng de dìfang
examples.english: A university is a place for exchanging ideas.

四周.meaning: all around; surroundings (房子的四周 around the house; 环顾四周 look around)

examples.hanzi: 房子的四周种满了花。
examples.pinyin: fángzi de sìzhōu zhòng mǎn le huā
examples.english: Flowers are planted all around the house.

examples.hanzi: 他环顾四周，确认没有人跟着他。
examples.pinyin: tā huángù sìzhōu, quèrèn méiyǒu rén gēn zhe tā
examples.english: He looked all around to make sure no one was following him.

near_synonyms.difference: 搜索 is the common compound, now especially for online searches; bare 搜 is mostly bound in compounds (搜查, 搜寻) or short for 搜索.

搜.meaning: to search (搜索 search; 搜查 search a place; 搜寻 hunt for)

examples.hanzi: 警察搜了他的房间，什么也没找到。
examples.pinyin: jǐngchá sōu le tā de fángjiān, shénme yě méi zhǎodào
examples.english: The police searched his room and found nothing.

搜索.meaning: to search (online); search (搜索结果 the search results; 搜索引擎 a search engine)

examples.hanzi: 我用搜索引擎查了这个词的用法。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yòng sōusuǒ yǐnqíng chá le zhège cí de yòngfǎ
examples.english: I looked up the usage of this word with a search engine.

examples.hanzi: 他在网上的搜索记录暴露了他的兴趣。
examples.pinyin: tā zài wǎng shàng de sōusuǒ jìlù bàolù le tā de xìngqù
examples.english: His online search history revealed his interests.

酸甜苦辣.meaning: the sour, the sweet, the bitter and the spicy — the joys and sorrows of life (尝尽了人生的酸甜苦辣 tasted all that life has to offer)

examples.hanzi: 这些年他尝尽了酸甜苦辣。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiē nián tā cháng jìn le suān tián kǔ là
examples.english: Over these years he has tasted all the bitterness and sweetness of life.

随.meaning: to follow; to accompany (跟随 follow; 随身 on one's person); to comply with (随便 as one pleases; 随意 at will); at any time (随时 at any time); 随着 along with (随着经济的发展 as the economy develops)

examples.hanzi: 请随你的便，想吃什么就点什么。
examples.pinyin: qǐng suí nǐ de biàn, xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn shénme
examples.english: Please do as you wish; order whatever you want to eat.

examples.hanzi: 他随手把门关上了。
examples.pinyin: tā suíshǒu bǎ mén guān shàng le
examples.english: He closed the door behind him without thinking.

examples.hanzi: 参观时请随导游走。
examples.pinyin: cānguān shí qǐng suí dǎoyóu zǒu
examples.english: During the visit please follow the guide.

碎.meaning: broken into pieces (玻璃碎了 the glass shattered; 碎纸 shredded paper; 打碎 break into pieces); fragmented (碎片 fragment)

examples.hanzi: 玻璃杯掉在地上碎了。
examples.pinyin: bōlibēi diào zài dì shàng suì le
examples.english: The glass fell on the floor and shattered.

examples.hanzi: 她把纸撕碎后扔掉了。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ zhǐ sī suì hòu rēng diào le
examples.english: She tore the paper into pieces and threw it away.

随后.meaning: soon after; afterwards (他先走了，随后我也离开了 he left first; I followed soon after)

examples.hanzi: 他先回了家，随后我也到了。
examples.pinyin: tā xiān huí le jiā, suíhòu wǒ yě dào le
examples.english: He went home first; soon after, I arrived too.

examples.hanzi: 会议结束了，随后大家一起去吃饭。
examples.pinyin: huìyì jiéshù le, suíhòu dàjiā yīqǐ qù chī fàn
examples.english: The meeting ended, and afterwards everyone went to eat together.

随时.meaning: at any time; whenever (随时联系 contact me anytime; 随时可能下雨 it could rain at any moment)

examples.hanzi: 有问题随时给我打电话。
examples.pinyin: yǒu wèntí suíshí gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà
examples.english: Call me anytime if you have questions.

examples.hanzi: 门随时可能开，请注意。
examples.pinyin: mén suíshí kěnéng kāi, qǐng zhùyì
examples.english: The door may open at any moment; please be careful.

随手.meaning: conveniently; in passing (随手关门 close the door behind you; 随手扔垃圾 drop litter carelessly)

examples.hanzi: 离开房间时请随手关灯。
examples.pinyin: líkāi fángjiān shí qǐng suíshǒu guān dēng
examples.english: Please turn off the lights as you leave the room.

examples.hanzi: 他习惯随手把东西记在手机里。
examples.pinyin: tā xíguàn suíshǒu bǎ dōngxi jì zài shǒujī lǐ
examples.english: He's in the habit of jotting things down on his phone in passing.

near_synonyms.difference: 随便 is the everyday colloquial word (坐吧，随便坐); 随意 is a bit more written and describes a relaxed style or manner (穿着随意 dressed casually), and lacks 随便's 'whatever/anything goes' answer sense.

随意.meaning: at will; casual; arbitrary (随意安排 arrange as you like; 穿着随意 dress casually)

examples.hanzi: 茶话会上大家随意聊天。
examples.pinyin: cháhuà huì shàng dàjiā suíyì liáotiān
examples.english: At the tea party everyone chatted casually.

examples.hanzi: 这些装饰随意摆放就可以了。
examples.pinyin: zhèxiē zhuāngshì suíyì bǎifàng jiù kěyǐ le
examples.english: These decorations can just be arranged as you like.

near_synonyms.difference: 损失 is about losing something concrete like money (经济损失 economic loss); 损害 is about harming an interest or condition like health or reputation.

损害.meaning: to damage; to harm; damage (损害健康 harm one's health; 利益受损 interests harmed)

examples.hanzi: 吸烟严重损害健康。
examples.pinyin: xīyān yánzhòng sǔnhài jiànkāng
examples.english: Smoking seriously harms health.

examples.hanzi: 这次事故对公司的声誉造成了损害。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì shìgù duì gōngsī de shēngyù zàochéng le sǔnhài
examples.english: This accident caused damage to the company's reputation.

损失.meaning: loss; to lose (造成巨大损失 cause enormous losses; 经济损失 economic losses; 损失惨重 heavy losses)

examples.hanzi: 洪水给农民造成了巨大的损失。
examples.pinyin: hóngshuǐ gěi nóngmín zàochéng le jùdà de sǔnshī
examples.english: The flood caused enormous losses to the farmers.

examples.hanzi: 公司损失了一大笔钱。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī sǔnshī le yī dà bǐ qián
examples.english: The company lost a large sum of money.

所1.meaning: structural particle before a verb marking the verb as modifying a noun (所说 what was said; 所有权 ownership; 所引起 what has given rise to); place; institute (诊所 a clinic; 研究所 a research institute; 场所 a place); measure word for buildings/houses — 一所房子 a house, 一所学校 a school

examples.hanzi: 这是我所知道的全部情况。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ suǒ zhīdào de quánbù qíngkuàng
examples.english: This is everything I know.

examples.hanzi: 他所说的和事实不一样。
examples.pinyin: tā suǒ shuō de hé shìshí bù yīyàng
examples.english: What he said doesn't match the facts.

锁.meaning: lock (门锁 a door lock; 钥匙和锁 key and lock); to lock (把门锁上 lock the door); to lock in (锁屏 lock the screen)

examples.hanzi: 出门前记得锁门。
examples.pinyin: chūmén qián jìde suǒ mén
examples.english: Remember to lock the door before going out.

examples.hanzi: 钥匙丢了，我打不开这把锁。
examples.pinyin: yàoshi diū le, wǒ dǎ bù kāi zhè bǎ suǒ
examples.english: I lost the key and can't open this lock.

缩短.meaning: to shorten; to cut down (缩短距离 shorten the distance; 缩短时间 cut the time)

examples.hanzi: 新铁路把两个城市之间的时间缩短了一半。
examples.pinyin: xīn tiělù bǎ liǎng ge chéngshì zhījiān de shíjiān suōduǎn le yībàn
examples.english: The new railway cut the travel time between the two cities in half.

near_synonyms.difference: 缩短 applies to time or length being cut down (缩短时间); 缩小 applies to size, scope, or a gap becoming smaller (缩小范围).

缩小.meaning: to narrow; to reduce; to shrink (缩小差距 narrow the gap; 图片缩小了 the image shrank)

examples.hanzi: 老师把地图上的字缩小了。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī bǎ dìtú shàng de zì suōxiǎo le
examples.english: The teacher made the text on the map smaller.

examples.hanzi: 两国之间的差距正在缩小。
examples.pinyin: liǎng guó zhījiān de chājù zhèngzài suōxiǎo
examples.english: The gap between the two countries is narrowing.

宿舍.meaning: dormitory (学生宿舍 a student dorm; 宿舍楼 a dormitory building)

examples.hanzi: 我们四个人住在同一个宿舍。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen sì ge rén zhù zài tóng yī ge sùshè
examples.english: The four of us live in the same dorm room.

台灯.meaning: desk lamp; table lamp (打开台灯 turn on the desk lamp)

examples.hanzi: 晚上看书时别忘了打开台灯。
examples.pinyin: wǎnshang kàn shū shí bié wàng le dǎkāi táidēng
examples.english: Don't forget to turn on the desk lamp when reading at night.

台阶.meaning: steps; staircase (上台阶 go up the steps); a face-saving way out (给他个台阶下 give him a graceful way out)

examples.hanzi: 小心台阶，一级一级慢慢走。
examples.pinyin: xiǎoxīn táijiē, yī jí yī jí mànmàn zǒu
examples.english: Mind the steps; walk down slowly, one step at a time.

examples.hanzi: 他给我一个台阶下，我没再争辩。
examples.pinyin: tā gěi wǒ yī ge táijiē xià, wǒ méi zài zhēngbiàn
examples.english: He gave me a face-saving way out, so I stopped arguing.

太太.meaning: wife; Mrs. (王太太 Mrs. Wang; 他的太太 his wife)

examples.hanzi: 王太太每天早上都去公园打太极拳。
examples.pinyin: wáng tàitai měitiān zǎoshang dōu qù gōngyuán dǎ tàijíquán
examples.english: Mrs. Wang goes to the park to do tai chi every morning.

examples.hanzi: 他的太太在医院工作。
examples.pinyin: tā de tàitai zài yīyuàn gōngzuò
examples.english: His wife works at a hospital.

near_synonyms.difference: 聊天 is casual small talk for pleasure; 谈话 is a more serious or formal exchange, often with a purpose (领导找他谈话 the boss had a talk with him).

谈话.meaning: to talk; to converse; conversation (进行谈话 have a talk; 首脑谈话 summit talks)

examples.hanzi: 校长正在和一位家长谈话。
examples.pinyin: xiàozhǎng zhèngzài hé yī wèi jiāzhǎng tánhuà
examples.english: The principal is talking with a parent.

examples.hanzi: 那次谈话改变了我对工作的看法。
examples.pinyin: nà cì tánhuà gǎibiàn le wǒ duì gōngzuò de kànfǎ
examples.english: That conversation changed my view of work.

桃.meaning: peach (桃树 a peach tree; 水蜜桃 a honey peach)

examples.hanzi: 这个桃又甜又多汁。
examples.pinyin: zhège táo yòu tián yòu duō zhī
examples.english: This peach is sweet and juicy.

examples.hanzi: 院子里种着一棵桃树。
examples.pinyin: yuànzi lǐ zhòng zhe yī kē táo shù
examples.english: A peach tree is planted in the courtyard.

套.meaning: set; suite; cover (床套 a duvet cover; 外套 a coat; 一套房子 an apartment); to cover; to slip on (套上一个袋子 put a bag over it); to fit; to encircle (套路 a set routine); measure word for sets — 一套家具 a set of furniture, 一套办法 a set of methods

examples.hanzi: 他买了一套新房子。
examples.pinyin: tā mǎi le yī tào xīn fángzi
examples.english: He bought a new apartment.

examples.hanzi: 沙发上放着一套蓝色的坐垫。
examples.pinyin: shāfā shàng fàng zhe yī tào lánsè de zuòdiàn
examples.english: A set of blue cushions is on the sofa.

examples.hanzi: 冬天冷，出门时在毛衣外面套上外套。
examples.pinyin: dōngtiān lěng, chūmén shí zài máoyī wàimiàn tào shàng wàitào
examples.english: It's cold in winter; put a coat on over your sweater when going out.

他人.meaning: another person; other people; others (尊重他人 respect others; 他人利益 the interests of others)

examples.hanzi: 在公共场合应该尊重他人。
examples.pinyin: zài gōnggòng chǎnghé yīnggāi zūnzhòng tārén
examples.english: In public places one should respect others.

examples.hanzi: 不要把他人的帮助当成理所当然。
examples.pinyin: bù yào bǎ tārén de bāngzhù dàng chéng lǐsuǒdāngrán
examples.english: Don't take other people's help for granted.

特产.meaning: special local product (当地的特产 the local specialty; 买些特产带回去 buy some local specialties to take home)

examples.hanzi: 我去杭州旅游时买了一些当地特产。
examples.pinyin: wǒ qù hángzhōu lǚyóu shí mǎi le yīxiē dāngdì tèchǎn
examples.english: I bought some local specialties when traveling in Hangzhou.

near_synonyms.difference: 疼 is the everyday word for physical pain (头很疼 my head hurts); 疼痛 is the written/clinical noun for pain as a symptom (缓解疼痛 relieve the pain).

疼痛.meaning: pain; ache (剧烈的疼痛 severe pain; 感到疼痛 feel pain)

examples.hanzi: 手术后他感到剧烈的疼痛。
examples.pinyin: shǒushù hòu tā gǎndào jùliè de téngtòng
examples.english: He felt severe pain after the surgery.

特色.meaning: characteristic; distinguishing feature (地方特色 local characteristics; 特色菜 signature dishes; 有特色 distinctive)

examples.hanzi: 这家饭馆的菜很有地方特色。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài hěn yǒu dìfang tèsè
examples.english: The food at this restaurant has strong local character.

near_synonyms.difference: 特别 ranges from 'especially' (特别好吃) to 'particular'; 特殊 only means out of the ordinary, often in formal contexts like 特殊情况/特殊待遇.

特殊.meaning: special; particular (特殊情况 special circumstances; 特殊待遇 special treatment)

examples.hanzi: 他有特殊情况，可以申请延期。
examples.pinyin: tā yǒu tèshū qíngkuàng, kěyǐ shēnqǐng yánqī
examples.english: He has special circumstances and can apply for an extension.

特有.meaning: unique to; peculiar to; characteristic (中国文化特有的 unique to Chinese culture; 特有的气质 a distinctive air)

examples.hanzi: 熊猫是中国特有的动物。
examples.pinyin: xióngmāo shì zhōngguó tèyǒu de dòngwù
examples.english: The panda is an animal unique to China.

near_synonyms.difference: 特点 is any distinguishing point, neutral and everyday (性格特点 personality traits); 特征 stresses identifying marks used to recognize or classify something (面部特征 facial features).

特征.meaning: characteristic; feature; trait (外貌特征 physical features; 主要特征 the main characteristics)

examples.hanzi: 警察记住了嫌疑人的外貌特征。
examples.pinyin: jǐngchá jìzhù le xiányírén de wàimào tèzhēng
examples.english: The police remembered the suspect's physical features.

near_synonyms.difference: 给 marks the beneficiary of an action (给我买杯咖啡 buy me a coffee); 替 specifically means doing it in someone's place or on their behalf.

替.meaning: for; on behalf of (替我向她问好 say hello to her for me); to replace (替换 replace; 代替 substitute; 他病了，你替他 he's ill, you fill in for him)

examples.hanzi: 今天我替你值班，你去休息吧。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān wǒ tì nǐ zhíbān, nǐ qù xiūxi ba
examples.english: I'll cover your shift today; go rest.

examples.hanzi: 会议期间他替总经理发言。
examples.pinyin: huìyì qījiān tā tì zǒngjīnglǐ fāyán
examples.english: He spoke on behalf of the general manager during the meeting.

填.meaning: to fill in; to stuff (填写表格 fill in a form; 填空 fill in the blank; 把洞填上 fill the hole)

examples.hanzi: 请用黑色笔填写这张表格。
examples.pinyin: qǐng yòng hēisè bǐ tiánxiě zhè zhāng biǎogé
examples.english: Please fill in this form with a black pen.

天空.meaning: sky (仰望天空 look up at the sky; 天空湛蓝 the sky is a deep blue)

examples.hanzi: 今天天空湛蓝，一朵云也没有。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān tiānkōng zhànlán, yī duǒ yún yě méiyǒu
examples.english: The sky is deep blue today, without a single cloud.

甜品.meaning: dessert (饭后甜品 dessert; 甜品店 a dessert shop)

examples.hanzi: 饭后我们每人点了一份甜品。
examples.pinyin: fàn hòu wǒmen měi rén diǎn le yī fèn tiánpǐn
examples.english: After the meal each of us ordered a dessert.

天上.meaning: in the sky; heaven (天上飘着白云 white clouds drift in the sky; 天上掉馅饼 manna falls from heaven — windfalls don't happen)

examples.hanzi: 天上飘着几朵白云。
examples.pinyin: tiānshang piāo zhe jǐ duǒ báiyún
examples.english: A few white clouds are drifting in the sky.

examples.hanzi: 奶奶说，善良的人死后会去天上。
examples.pinyin: nǎinai shuō, shànliáng de rén sǐ hòu huì qù tiānshàng
examples.english: Grandma says good people go to heaven after they die.

调.meaning: to adjust; to blend; to mix (调整 adjust; 调节 regulate; 调味 season; 调皮 naughty)

examples.hanzi: 这张照片颜色太暗了，调一下亮度。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhàopiàn yánsè tài àn le, tiáo yīxià liàngdù
examples.english: This photo is too dark; adjust the brightness.

examples.hanzi: 妈妈在厨房调饺子馅。
examples.pinyin: māma zài chúfáng tiáo jiǎozi xiàn
examples.english: Mom is mixing the dumpling filling in the kitchen.

near_synonyms.difference: 调整 tiáozhěng means adjusting parameters or plans (调整音量 adjust the volume); 调 diào means transferring a person or moving something to another place (调工作 job transfer).

调.meaning: to transfer; to move (调动 transfer; 调换 exchange; 调查 investigate); tune; melody (曲调 a tune; 语调 intonation); pitch; key (变调 change tone)

examples.hanzi: 他被调到北京工作了。
examples.pinyin: tā bèi diào dào běijīng gōngzuò le
examples.english: He was transferred to work in Beijing.

examples.hanzi: 播音员正在调换节目顺序。
examples.pinyin: bōyīnyuán zhèngzài diàohuàn jiémù shùnxù
examples.english: The announcer is swapping the order of the programs.

挑.meaning: to choose; to select (挑选 pick out; 挑毛病 pick faults; 挑食 be a picky eater); to carry on a shoulder pole (挑水 carry water on a pole)

examples.hanzi: 她在商场挑了半天，才选中一件外套。
examples.pinyin: tā zài shāngchǎng tiāo le bàntiān, cái xuǎnzhòng yī jiàn wàitào
examples.english: She spent ages choosing in the mall before settling on a coat.

挑.meaning: to raise; to poke (挑眉 raise an eyebrow; 挑衅 provoke; 挑战 challenge; 挑拨 sow discord)

examples.hanzi: 他挑起竹帘，往屋里看了看。
examples.pinyin: tā tiǎo qǐ zhúlián, wǎng wū lǐ kàn le kàn
examples.english: He raised the bamboo curtain with a pole and looked inside.

跳高.meaning: high jump (跳高比赛 the high jump competition)

examples.hanzi: 他报名参加了学校的跳高比赛。
examples.pinyin: tā bàomíng cānjiā le xuéxiào de tiàogāo bǐsài
examples.english: He signed up for the school high-jump competition.

调皮.meaning: naughty; mischievous (调皮的孩子 a mischievous child; 调皮捣蛋 naughty and mischievous)

examples.hanzi: 这个小男孩很调皮，总爱捉弄同学。
examples.pinyin: zhège xiǎo nánhái hěn tiáopí, zǒng ài zhuōnòng tóngxué
examples.english: This little boy is very naughty and loves to play tricks on his classmates.

挑选.meaning: to pick out; to select (仔细挑选 choose carefully; 挑选礼物 pick out a gift)

examples.hanzi: 他仔细挑选了一双合适的跑鞋。
examples.pinyin: tā zǐxì tiāoxuǎn le yī shuāng héshì de pǎoxié
examples.english: He carefully picked out a suitable pair of running shoes.

跳远.meaning: long jump (跳远运动员 a long jumper)

examples.hanzi: 他是我们班跳远最好的运动员。
examples.pinyin: tā shì wǒmen bān tiàoyuǎn zuì hǎo de yùndòngyuán
examples.english: He's the best long-jump athlete in our class.

挑战.meaning: challenge; to challenge (面对挑战 face a challenge; 迎接挑战 rise to a challenge; 挑战自我 challenge oneself)

examples.hanzi: 这次比赛对他来说是一个很大的挑战。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì bǐsài duì tā lái shuō shì yī ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn
examples.english: This competition is a big challenge for him.

examples.hanzi: 他决定挑战世界纪录。
examples.pinyin: tā juédìng tiǎozhàn shìjiè jìlù
examples.english: He decided to challenge the world record.

调整.meaning: to adjust; to adapt (调整计划 adjust the plan; 调整心态 adjust one's mindset)

examples.hanzi: 天气冷了，我们调整了训练时间。
examples.pinyin: tiānqì lěng le, wǒmen tiáozhěng le xùnliàn shíjiān
examples.english: The weather turned cold, so we adjusted the training time.

examples.hanzi: 你要学会调整自己的情绪。
examples.pinyin: nǐ yào xuéhuì tiáozhěng zìjǐ de qíngxù
examples.english: You must learn to regulate your own emotions.

提倡.meaning: to advocate; to encourage (提倡节约 advocate thrift; 值得提倡 worth encouraging)

examples.hanzi: 学校提倡学生多读经典著作。
examples.pinyin: xuéxiào tíchàng xuéshēng duō dú jīngdiǎn zhùzuò
examples.english: The school encourages students to read more classics.

贴.meaning: to paste; to stick; to lean close (贴春联 paste up Spring Festival couplets; 把海报贴在墙上 stick the poster on the wall; 贴心 considerate)

examples.hanzi: 过春节时，家家户户都贴春联。
examples.pinyin: guò chūnjié shí, jiājiāhùhù dōu tiē chūnlián
examples.english: At Spring Festival every household pastes up spring couplets.

examples.hanzi: 她把照片贴在日记本里。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ zhàopiàn tiē zài rìjìběn lǐ
examples.english: She stuck the photos into her diary.

铁路.meaning: railway (修铁路 build a railway; 铁路运输 rail transport)

examples.hanzi: 这条铁路连接着两个大城市。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo tiělù liánjiē zhe liǎng ge dà chéngshì
examples.english: This railway connects two big cities.

体会.meaning: to realize from experience; understanding (深刻体会 deeply realize; 谈谈体会 share one's reflections)

examples.hanzi: 只有离开家，才能体会父母的辛苦。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyǒu líkāi jiā, cáinéng tǐhuì fùmǔ de xīnkǔ
examples.english: Only after leaving home can you truly appreciate your parents' hardship.

examples.hanzi: 这篇文章写出了他在农村生活的体会。
examples.pinyin: zhè piān wénzhāng xiě chū le tā zài nóngcūn shēnghuó de tǐhuì
examples.english: This essay captures his reflections from living in the countryside.

提交.meaning: to submit (提交申请 submit an application; 提交报告 hand in a report)

examples.hanzi: 请在周五之前提交申请表。
examples.pinyin: qǐng zài zhōuwǔ zhīqián tíjiāo shēnqǐng biǎo
examples.english: Please submit the application form before Friday.

体力.meaning: physical strength; stamina (体力劳动 manual labor; 体力不支 run out of strength)

examples.hanzi: 搬家是件很费体力的活。
examples.pinyin: bānjiā shì jiàn hěn fèi tǐlì de huó
examples.english: Moving house is work that takes a lot of physical strength.

examples.hanzi: 他年纪大了，体力不如从前了。
examples.pinyin: tā niánjì dà le, tǐlì bùrú cóngqián le
examples.english: He's getting old and doesn't have the stamina he used to.

near_synonyms.difference: 问题 is any question or problem; 题目 specifically means the title of an article or the questions on an exam.

题目.meaning: title; topic; exam question (论文题目 the thesis topic; 考试的题目 the exam questions)

examples.hanzi: 这次考试的题目不太难。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì kǎoshì de tímù bù tài nán
examples.english: The questions on this exam weren't too hard.

examples.hanzi: 我的毕业论文题目确定了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de bìyè lùnwén tímù quédìng le
examples.english: The topic of my thesis has been decided.

停留.meaning: to stay for a while; to make a stopover (在北京停留三天 stop over in Beijing for three days; 停留在目前阶段 stay at the current stage)

examples.hanzi: 这次旅行我们只在西安停留两天。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì lǚxíng wǒmen zhǐ zài xī'ān tíngliú liǎng tiān
examples.english: On this trip we're only staying two days in Xi'an.

提起.meaning: to mention; to bring up (提起这件事 bring this matter up); to lift up (提起行李 pick up the luggage)

examples.hanzi: 别在他面前提起那件事，他会难过。
examples.pinyin: bié zài tā miànqián tíqǐ nà jiàn shì, tā huì nánguò
examples.english: Don't bring that matter up in front of him; it will make him sad.

examples.hanzi: 他提起行李箱走出了车站。
examples.pinyin: tā tíqǐ xínglixiāng zǒu chū le chēzhàn
examples.english: He lifted his suitcase and walked out of the station.

提升.meaning: to raise; to promote; to upgrade (提升品质 improve quality; 职位提升 a promotion; 自我提升 self-improvement)

examples.hanzi: 公司提升他为部门经理。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī tíshēng tā wèi bùmén jīnglǐ
examples.english: The company promoted him to department manager.

examples.hanzi: 这门课程旨在提升学生的口语水平。
examples.pinyin: zhè mén kèchéng zhǐzài tíshēng xuéshēng de kǒuyǔ shuǐpíng
examples.english: This course aims to improve the students' spoken Chinese.

提问.meaning: to ask a question; question (自由提问 open the floor for questions; 向老师提问 ask the teacher a question)

examples.hanzi: 演讲结束后，大家可以自由提问。
examples.pinyin: yǎnjiǎng jiéshù hòu, dàjiā kěyǐ zìyóu tíwèn
examples.english: After the talk, everyone may ask questions freely.

examples.hanzi: 老师提问时，教室里没人举手。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī tíwèn shí, jiàoshì lǐ méi rén jǔshǒu
examples.english: When the teacher asked the question, no one in the classroom raised a hand.

体现.meaning: to embody; to reflect (体现了设计理念 embodies the design concept; 体现了合作精神 reflects a spirit of cooperation)

examples.hanzi: 这座建筑体现了传统与现代的结合。
examples.pinyin: zhè zuò jiànzhù tǐxiàn le chuántǒng yǔ xiàndài de jiéhé
examples.english: This building embodies a blend of tradition and modernity.

near_synonyms.difference: 体会 is to internalize and understand a feeling (体会辛苦 appreciate hardship); 体验 is to personally go through an activity or process (体验生活 experience life).

体验.meaning: to experience; experience (体验生活 experience life; 一次难忘的体验 an unforgettable experience; 用户体验 user experience)

examples.hanzi: 游客可以在村里体验农家生活。
examples.pinyin: yóukè kěyǐ zài cūn lǐ tǐyàn nóngjiā shēnghuó
examples.english: Visitors can experience farm life in the village.

examples.hanzi: 第一次坐飞机是一次难忘的体验。
examples.pinyin: dì yī cì zuò fēijī shì yī cì nánwàng de tǐyàn
examples.english: Flying for the first time was an unforgettable experience.

同.meaning: same; alike; with (相同的答案 the same answer; 同一个班 the same class; 同意 agree; 共同 together; 同事 colleague; 和…一同 along with)

examples.hanzi: 我们住在同一个小区。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zhù zài tóng yī ge xiǎoqū
examples.english: We live in the same neighborhood.

examples.hanzi: 这个问题我同他讨论过好几次。
examples.pinyin: zhège wèntí wǒ tóng tā tǎolùn guò hǎo jǐ cì
examples.english: I've discussed this issue with him several times.

通常.meaning: usually; normally (他通常七点起床 he usually gets up at seven; 通常情况下 under normal circumstances)

examples.hanzi: 他通常坐地铁上班。
examples.pinyin: tā tōngcháng zuò dìtiě shàngbān
examples.english: He usually takes the subway to work.

统计.meaning: to add up; statistics (据统计 according to statistics; 统计数据 statistical data)

examples.hanzi: 据统计，今年游客数量增加了百分之二十。
examples.pinyin: jù tǒngjì, jīnnián yóukè shùliàng zēngjiā le bǎifēnzhī èrshí
examples.english: According to statistics, the number of visitors rose by twenty percent this year.

examples.hanzi: 老师在统计有多少人参加春游。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī zài tǒngjì yǒu duōshǎo rén cānjiā chūnyóu
examples.english: The teacher is counting how many people are joining the spring outing.

痛苦.meaning: pain; suffering; painful (内心的痛苦 inner pain; 痛苦的经历 a painful experience)

examples.hanzi: 离婚那段日子他很痛苦。
examples.pinyin: líhūn nà duàn rìzi tā hěn tòngkǔ
examples.english: He was in great pain during the divorce.

examples.hanzi: 牙疼给他带来了很大的痛苦。
examples.pinyin: yáténg gěi tā dài lái le hěn dà de tòngkǔ
examples.english: The toothache caused him great suffering.

near_synonyms.difference: 可怜 describes someone as pitiable and can sound condescending when used of people directly; 同情 is the more neutral verb/noun for feeling sympathy for someone.

同情.meaning: to sympathize with; sympathy (同情弱者 sympathize with the underdog; 表示同情 express sympathy)

examples.hanzi: 大家都很同情他的遭遇。
examples.pinyin: dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng tā de zāoyù
examples.english: Everyone sympathized with what he had been through.

通行.meaning: to pass through; current; in general use (此路禁止通行 this road is closed; 这种说法各地通行 this usage is current everywhere; 通行证 a pass)

examples.hanzi: 这条路禁止机动车通行。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo lù jìnzhǐ jīdòngchē tōngxíng
examples.english: Motor vehicles are prohibited on this road.

examples.hanzi: 这种卡片在两国都能通行。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng kǎpiàn zài liǎng guó dōu néng tōngxíng
examples.english: This card is accepted in both countries.

同一.meaning: the same; identical (同一时间 at the same time; 同一目标 the same goal)

examples.hanzi: 我们坐同一班火车去上海。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zuò tóng yī bān huǒchē qù shànghǎi
examples.english: We're taking the same train to Shanghai.

统一.meaning: to unify; unified; uniform (统一意见 unify opinions; 统一标准 uniform standards; 祖国统一 national reunification)

examples.hanzi: 两国即将统一货币。
examples.pinyin: liǎng guó jíjiāng tǒngyī huòbì
examples.english: The two countries are about to unify their currencies.

examples.hanzi: 全公司使用统一的表格格式。
examples.pinyin: quán gōngsī shǐyòng tǒngyī de biǎogé géshì
examples.english: The whole company uses a uniform form format.

投.meaning: to throw; to cast; to put in (投票 vote; 投篮 shoot a basket; 投入资金 invest funds; 投简历 send in a resume)

examples.hanzi: 他把垃圾投进了垃圾桶。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ lājī tóu jìn le lājītǒng
examples.english: He tossed the trash into the bin.

examples.hanzi: 选民明天去投票站投票。
examples.pinyin: xuǎnmín míngtiān qù tóupiàozhàn tóupiào
examples.english: Voters will go to the polling station tomorrow to cast their ballots.

投入.meaning: to put in (resources); investment (投入生产 go into production; 资金投入 capital investment); engrossed (工作很投入 totally absorbed in work)

examples.hanzi: 公司投入了大量资金研发新产品。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī tóurù le dàliàng zījīn yánfā xīn chǎnpǐn
examples.english: The company invested a lot of money in developing new products.

examples.hanzi: 他工作起来非常投入，常常忘了时间。
examples.pinyin: tā gōngzuò qǐlái fēicháng tóurù, chángcháng wàng le shíjiān
examples.english: He gets completely absorbed in his work and often loses track of time.

团.meaning: group; society; ball (团体 a group; 团队 a team; 共青团 the Communist Youth League; 团结 unity; 面团 dough); measure word for group actions — 一团糟 a total mess

examples.hanzi: 孩子们把雪捏成了一团。
examples.pinyin: háizi men bǎ xuě niē chéng le yī tuán
examples.english: The children pressed the snow into a ball.

examples.hanzi: 代表团明天出发去日本。
examples.pinyin: dàibiǎotuán míngtiān chūfā qù rìběn
examples.english: The delegation leaves for Japan tomorrow.

团队.meaning: team (团队合作 teamwork; 打造优秀团队 build an excellent team)

examples.hanzi: 这个项目需要一个合作的团队来完成。
examples.pinyin: zhège xiàngmù xūyào yī ge hézuò de tuánduì lái wánchéng
examples.english: This project needs a cooperative team to complete.

突出.meaning: outstanding; prominent (成绩突出 outstanding results; 突出重点 highlight the key points; 矛盾突出 the contradictions are acute)

examples.hanzi: 她的表演能力十分突出。
examples.pinyin: tā de biǎoyǎn nénglì shífēn tūchū
examples.english: Her performing ability is outstanding.

examples.hanzi: 报告要突出问题的主要方面。
examples.pinyin: bàogào yào tūchū wèntí de zhǔyào fāngmiàn
examples.english: The report should highlight the main aspects of the problem.

土地.meaning: land; soil (土地改革 land reform; 肥沃的土地 fertile land)

examples.hanzi: 农民在这片土地上种了一辈子粮食。
examples.pinyin: nóngmín zài zhè piàn tǔdì shàng zhòng le yī bèizi liángshi
examples.english: The farmers grew grain on this land their whole lives.

土豆.meaning: potato (土豆丝 shredded potatoes; 炸土豆条 french fries)

examples.hanzi: 酸辣土豆丝是我最爱吃的菜。
examples.pinyin: suān là tǔdòusī shì wǒ zuì ài chī de cài
examples.english: Hot-and-sour shredded potatoes are my favorite dish.

图画.meaning: picture; drawing (一幅图画 a picture; 图画书 a picture book)

examples.hanzi: 墙上贴着一张孩子画的图画。
examples.pinyin: qiáng shàng tiē zhe yī zhāng háizi huà de túhuà
examples.english: A picture drawn by a child is stuck on the wall.

退.meaning: to retreat; to return; to decline (退出 withdraw; 退货 return goods; 退休 retire; 后退 step back; 退步 regress; 退还 refund)

examples.hanzi: 敌人被迫退出了城市。
examples.pinyin: dírén bèipò tuì chū le chéngshì
examples.english: The enemy was forced to retreat from the city.

examples.hanzi: 这件衣服不合身，我想退掉。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn yīfu bù héshēn, wǒ xiǎng tuì diào
examples.english: These clothes don't fit; I want to return them.

退出.meaning: to withdraw from; to exit (退出比赛 withdraw from the competition; 退出登录 log out)

examples.hanzi: 他因伤退出了比赛。
examples.pinyin: tā yīn shāng tuìchū le bǐsài
examples.english: He withdrew from the competition because of injury.

examples.hanzi: 请先退出账号再关机。
examples.pinyin: qǐng xiān tuìchū zhànghào zài guānjī
examples.english: Please log out of your account before shutting down.

推动.meaning: to push forward; to promote; to drive (推动改革 push reform forward; 推动经济发展 drive economic development)

推广.meaning: to popularize; to promote (推广新产品 promote a new product; 推广普通话 popularize Mandarin)

examples.english: The company is promoting this new product nationwide.

退还.meaning: to return; to refund (退还押金 refund the deposit; 如有损坏，照价退还 if damaged, compensation will be refunded)

examples.english: When you check out, the hotel will refund the deposit.

推荐.meaning: to recommend (推荐一本好书 recommend a good book; 向朋友推荐 recommend to friends)

examples.english: A friend recommended a new movie to me.

推进.meaning: to push forward; to advance (推进合作 advance cooperation; 稳步推进 push steadily forward)

examples.hanzi: 双方正在稳步推进谈判。
examples.pinyin: shuāngfāng zhèngzài wěnbù tuījìn tánpàn
examples.english: The two sides are steadily advancing the negotiations.

退休.meaning: to retire (他去年退休了 he retired last year; 退休金 a pension)

examples.pinyin: tā bàba qùnián tuìxiū le, xiànzài měitiān qù diàoyú
examples.english: His father retired last year and now goes fishing every day.

拖鞋.meaning: slippers (一双拖鞋 a pair of slippers; 换拖鞋 change into slippers)

examples.pinyin: jìn wū qǐng huàn tuōxié
examples.english: Please change into slippers when entering.

图书.meaning: books (collectively) (图书馆 a library; 图书管理系统 a library management system)

examples.hanzi: 学校新购进了两千册图书。
examples.pinyin: xuéxiào xīn gòujìn le liǎng qiān cè túshū
examples.english: The school recently purchased two thousand books.

兔子.meaning: rabbit; hare (小白兔 a little white rabbit; 兔子跑得快 rabbits run fast)

examples.hanzi: 兔子跑得很快，一转眼就不见了。
examples.pinyin: tùzi pǎo de hěn kuài, yī zhuǎnyǎn jiù bù jiàn le
examples.english: The rabbit ran so fast it disappeared in a blink.

外部.meaning: external; outside (外部环境 the external environment; 外部压力 external pressure)

examples.pinyin: wàibù huánjìng de biànhuà huì yǐngxiǎng gōngsī de fāzhǎn

外公.meaning: maternal grandfather (去看外公 visit grandpa)

examples.pinyin: xiǎoshíhou, wàigōng cháng dài wǒ qù hébiān diàoyú
examples.english: When I was little, grandpa often took me fishing by the river.

near_synonyms.difference: 外形 is the shape or outline of an object (手机的外形 the phone's shape); 外观 is overall outward appearance including how it looks aesthetically (外观漂亮 looks attractive).

外观.meaning: appearance; exterior (建筑的外观 the building's facade; 外观漂亮 looks attractive)

examples.pinyin: zhè zuò jiànzhù de wàiguān fēicháng dútè
examples.english: The building's exterior is very distinctive.

外婆.meaning: maternal grandmother (外婆做的菜 grandma's cooking)

examples.pinyin: shǔjià wǒ yào huí lǎojiā kàn wàipó
examples.english: I'm going back to my hometown this summer to see grandma.

外形.meaning: shape; outline; external form (手机的外形 the phone's shape; 外形美观 pleasing in form)

examples.hanzi: 这款手机的外形很时尚。
examples.pinyin: zhè kuǎn shǒujī de wàixíng hěn shíshàng
examples.english: This phone has a stylish shape.

弯.meaning: crooked; curved (弯弯曲曲 winding; 弯腰 bend down); to bend (把铁丝弯过来 bend the wire); a bend; curve (拐个弯 turn a corner; 这条路有很多弯 this road has many bends)

examples.hanzi: 这条小路弯弯曲曲地通向山顶。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo xiǎolù wān wān qūqū de tōng xiàng shāndǐng
examples.english: This path winds its way up to the mountaintop.

examples.hanzi: 他弯腰捡起了地上的钥匙。
examples.pinyin: tā wānyāo jiǎn qǐ le dì shàng de yàoshi
examples.english: He bent down and picked up the keys from the ground.

往返.meaning: to go there and back; round trip (往返机票 a round-trip ticket; 每天往返于家和公司之间 commute between home and office daily)

examples.hanzi: 我买了往返机票，下周回来。
examples.pinyin: wǒ mǎi le wǎngfǎn jīpiào, xiàzhōu huílái
examples.english: I bought a round-trip ticket and will be back next week.

网络.meaning: network (互联网 the internet; 网络购物 online shopping; 网络信号 network signal; 人际关系网 the web of relationships)

examples.hanzi: 宿舍里的网络信号不太好。
examples.pinyin: sùshè lǐ de wǎngluò xìnhào bù tài hǎo
examples.english: The network signal in the dorm isn't great.

玩具.meaning: toy (儿童玩具 children's toys; 一堆玩具 a pile of toys)

examples.hanzi: 孩子的房间里堆满了玩具。
examples.pinyin: háizi de fángjiān lǐ duī mǎn le wánjù
examples.english: The child's room is piled with toys.

near_synonyms.difference: 完美 means flawless with no room for improvement; 完善 means well-developed and complete, typically of systems or facilities (完善的制度 a sound system), and also works as a verb (完善制度).

完美.meaning: perfect; flawless (完美的表现 a flawless performance; 追求完美 strive for perfection)

examples.pinyin: wǎnhuì de zǔzhī kānchēng wánměi
examples.english: The organization of the evening party was nothing short of perfect.

完善.meaning: perfect; complete; to improve; to perfect (完善的制度 a well-developed system; 不断完善 keep improving; 完善基础设施 improve infrastructure)

examples.hanzi: 学校正在完善安全管理制度。
examples.pinyin: xuéxiào zhèngzài wánshàn ānquán guǎnlǐ zhìdù

examples.pinyin: zhège xiǎoqū de shèshī hěn wánshàn
examples.english: The facilities in this neighborhood are very complete.

examples.pinyin: duō dài jiàn yīfu ba, wànyī tiānqì biàn lěng

examples.hanzi: 万一他不同意，我们再想别的办法。
examples.pinyin: wànyī tā bù tóngyì, wǒmen zài xiǎng biéde bànfǎ
examples.english: If by any chance he doesn't agree, we'll think of another way.

完整.meaning: complete; intact; whole (完整的故事 a complete story; 保持完整 remain intact; 完整版 the full version)

examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ zhège gùshi wánzhěng de jiǎng yī biàn

围.meaning: to surround; to enclose; to wrap around (围着操场 run around the track; 围巾 a scarf; 包围 surround; 围观 gather around to watch)

examples.pinyin: tā yòng wéijīn bǎ bózi wéi de jǐnjǐn de
examples.english: She wrapped her neck tightly with the scarf.

examples.pinyin: tā wèile jiārén nǔlì gōngzuò

尾巴.meaning: tail (狗的尾巴 a dog's tail; 兔子的短尾巴 a rabbit's short tail)

伟大.meaning: great; great and important (伟大的科学家 a great scientist; 伟大的事业 a great cause)

违法.meaning: to break the law; illegal (违法建筑 an illegal structure; 违法行为 illegal acts)

围巾.meaning: scarf (一条围巾 a scarf; 戴围巾 wear a scarf)

问卷.meaning: questionnaire (填写问卷 fill in a questionnaire; 问卷调查 a questionnaire survey)

文学.meaning: literature (文学作品 works of literature; 文学史 the history of literature)

物理.meaning: physics (物理学家 a physicist; 物理实验 a physics experiment)

五颜六色.meaning: multicolored; of all colors (五颜六色的花 flowers of every color)

examples.english: The property management is responsible for cleaning the hallways and the greenery.

物质.meaning: matter; substance; material (物质生活 material life; 物质奖励 a material reward; 化学物质 a chemical substance)

戏.meaning: play; show; drama (看戏 see a play; 戏曲 traditional opera; 游戏 game; 拍戏 film a drama)

县.meaning: county (县城 the county seat; 县长 the county head)

现场.meaning: scene; site; live (on-the-spot) (事故现场 the scene of the accident; 现场直播 a live broadcast; 会议现场 the meeting venue)

examples.pinyin: zhè chǎng yīnyuè huì shì xiànchǎng yǎnchū de, bù shì lùyīn

现代.meaning: modern (现代文学 modern literature; 现代化 modernization; 现代化的交通 a modern transport system)

examples.english: The architecture of this museum is very modern.

现代化.meaning: modernization; to modernize (实现农业现代化 realize agricultural modernization; 现代化建设 modernization drive)

examples.pinyin: zhège cūnzi yòng shàng le xiàndàihuà de nóngyè shèbèi
examples.english: This village has started using modernized farming equipment.

near_synonyms.difference: 看起来 is the speaker's judgment from outward appearance (看起来很好吃 looks delicious); 显得 describes the impression something gives off, often contrasting with reality (显得年轻 looks younger than one actually is).

显得.meaning: to appear; to seem; to look (显得很紧张 looks nervous; 显得年轻 looks young)

相册.meaning: photo album (翻看相册 leaf through the album; 电子相册 a digital album)

examples.english: He gets along well with his roommates.

乡村.meaning: village; countryside (乡村生活 rural life; 乡村小学 a village school)
