相当.meaning: quite; considerably (相当好 quite good; 相当大的差距 a considerable gap); equivalent (相当于 be equivalent to)

项目.meaning: project; item; event (sports) (开展新项目 launch a new project; 奥运会比赛项目 Olympic events)

near_synonyms.difference: 上传 is the opposite operation, sending from your device to a server; 下载 is receiving from a server.

下载.meaning: to download (下载文件 download a file; 下载速度 download speed)

西餐.meaning: Western food (吃西餐 eat Western food; 西餐厅 a Western restaurant)

near_synonyms.difference: 严格 demands high standards of others (a strict teacher); 严肃 is a serious, no-nonsense manner.
严重 describes how bad a situation or illness is; 严肃 describes a manner or atmosphere.

严肃.meaning: serious; solemn; stern (表情严肃 a serious expression; 严肃处理 deal with seriously; 严肃的问题 a serious question)

examples.hanzi: 父亲的表情突然变得很严肃。
examples.pinyin: fùqīn de biǎoqíng tūrán biàn de hěn yánsù.
examples.english: Father's expression suddenly turned very serious.

near_synonyms.difference: 研发 is broader product development; 研制 emphasizes producing a concrete artifact like a medicine or device.

研制.meaning: to develop (a product or medicine) (研制新药 develop a new drug; 研制成功 successfully developed)

examples.hanzi: 科学家们正在研制治疗这种病的新药。
examples.pinyin: kēxuéjiā men zhèngzài yánzhì zhìliáo zhè zhǒng bìng de xīnyào.
examples.english: Scientists are developing a new drug to treat this disease.

摇.meaning: to shake; to sway; to rock (摇头 shake one's head; 摇晃 sway; 摇篮 a cradle; 摇树 shake the tree)

examples.hanzi: 他摇头表示不同意。
examples.pinyin: tā yáo tóu biǎoshì bù tóngyì.
examples.english: He shook his head to show disagreement.

咬.meaning: to bite; to snap at (咬了一口 took a bite; 被狗咬了 bitten by a dog; 咬牙 grit one's teeth)

examples.hanzi: 蚊子咬了我一口。
examples.pinyin: wénzi yǎo le wǒ yī kǒu.
examples.english: A mosquito bit me.

腰.meaning: waist; lower back (弯腰 bend at the waist; 腰疼 lower-back pain; 腰带 a belt)

examples.hanzi: 坐太久了对腰不好。
examples.pinyin: zuò tài jiǔ le duì yāo bù hǎo.
examples.english: Sitting too long is bad for your back.

near_synonyms.difference: 不然 means the same 'otherwise'; 要不 can also make suggestions (要不你来吧), which 不然 cannot.
否则 is the formal 'otherwise'; 要不（然）is neutral to colloquial and also offers alternatives.

要不（然）.meaning: otherwise; or else; or (要不你先走？ how about you go first?; 快走吧，要不然迟到了 hurry, or else we'll be late)

examples.hanzi: 快点儿走，要不我们就赶不上火车了。
examples.pinyin: kuài diǎnr zǒu, yàobù wǒmen jiù gǎn bù shang huǒchē le.
examples.english: Walk faster, or else we'll miss the train.

要不是.meaning: if not for; but for (要不是你帮忙，我就完了 if you hadn't helped me, I'd have had it)

examples.hanzi: 要不是你提醒我，我早就忘了。
examples.pinyin: yàobushì nǐ tíxǐng wǒ, wǒ zǎo jiù wàng le.
examples.english: If you hadn't reminded me, I would have long forgotten.

near_synonyms.difference: 药物 is the formal/medical term for drugs in general; 药品 emphasizes commercially packaged medicinal products.

药品.meaning: medicines; drugs (管理药品 manage medicines; 药品安全 drug safety)

examples.hanzi: 药品必须放在孩子拿不到的地方。
examples.pinyin: yàopǐn bìxū fàng zài háizi ná bù dào de dìfang.
examples.english: Medicines must be kept where children can't reach them.

药物.meaning: medicine; medication (药物治疗 drug therapy; 按时服用药物 take medication on time)

examples.hanzi: 医生建议他用药物治疗。
examples.pinyin: yīshēng jiànyì tā yòng yàowù zhìliáo.
examples.english: The doctor recommended drug therapy for him.

压岁钱.meaning: New Year's money (given to children) (给孩子压岁钱 give children New Year's money)

examples.hanzi: 孩子们过年时都能收到压岁钱。
examples.pinyin: háizi men guò nián shí dōu néng shōu dào yāsuìqián.
examples.english: Children all receive New Year's money during Spring Festival.

鸭子.meaning: duck (烤鸭 roast duck — usually 北京烤鸭; 一只鸭子 a duck)

examples.hanzi: 湖里游着几只鸭子。
examples.pinyin: hú lǐ yóu zhe jǐ zhī yāzi.
examples.english: Several ducks are swimming in the lake.

near_synonyms.difference: 晚上 is the everyday word for evening/night; 夜间 is formal, referring to the nighttime hours.

夜间.meaning: at night; nighttime (夜间工作 night work; 夜间行车 driving at night)

examples.hanzi: 这条路夜间禁止通行。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo lù yèjiān jìnzhǐ tōngxíng.
examples.english: This road is closed to traffic at night.

夜市.meaning: night market (逛夜市 stroll around the night market; 夜市小吃 night-market snacks)

examples.hanzi: 台北的夜市非常有名。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi de yèshì fēicháng yǒumíng.
examples.english: Taipei's night markets are very famous.

业务.meaning: business; professional work (业务能力 professional competence; 业务范围 the scope of business; 拓展业务 expand the business)

examples.hanzi: 他对银行的业务很熟悉。
examples.pinyin: tā duì yínháng de yèwù hěn shúxī.
examples.english: He is very familiar with banking operations.

near_synonyms.difference: 专业 is the opposite: professional or one's specialization of study; 业余 means done in spare time, not professionally.

业余.meaning: amateur; spare-time (业余爱好者 an amateur; 业余时间 one's spare time; 业余生活 life outside work)

examples.hanzi: 他是一个业余摄影爱好者。
examples.pinyin: tā shì yī gè yèyú shèyǐng àihàozhě.
examples.english: He is an amateur photography enthusiast.

移.meaning: to move; to shift (移动 move; 移民 emigrate; 转移 transfer; 移动电话 a mobile phone — dated term)

examples.hanzi: 请把桌子往右移一点儿。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ zhuōzi wǎng yòu yí yī diǎnr.
examples.english: Please move the table a little to the right.

亿.meaning: hundred million (一亿人 a hundred million people; 亿万富翁 a multi-millionaire)

examples.hanzi: 中国有十四亿人口。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó yǒu shísì yì rénkǒu.
examples.english: China has a population of 1.4 billion.

乙.meaning: second (in a list); B (甲、乙、丙 A, B, C; 乙方 Party B in a contract); of the second quality (乙醇 ethanol)

examples.hanzi: 合同上写着甲方和乙方的名字。
examples.pinyin: hétong shang xiězhe jiǎfāng hé yǐfāng de míngzi.
examples.english: The contract states the names of both party A and party B.

near_synonyms.difference: 用 is the everyday 'using a tool'; 以 is its formal counterpart in set patterns like 以…为…

以.meaning: by means of; with (以学生为中心 center on the student; 以…为 take … as); according to (以他的性格 given his character); because of (不以物喜 not pleased by things — literary); in order that (以免 so as to avoid; 以便 so that) — formal function word living mostly in compounds

examples.hanzi: 我们要以事实为根据。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen yào yǐ shìshí wéi gēnjù.
examples.english: We must base ourselves on facts.

一次性.meaning: one-time; disposable (一次性筷子 disposable chopsticks; 一次性付款 a one-time payment)

examples.hanzi: 医院里很多用品都是一次性的。
examples.pinyin: yīyuàn lǐ hěn duō yòngpǐn dōu shì yīcìxìng de.
examples.english: Many supplies in hospitals are disposable.

一代.meaning: a generation (年轻的一代 the younger generation; 一代更比一代强 each generation surpasses the last; 二十世纪八十年代 the 1980s — the 年代 decade sense)

examples.hanzi: 电脑每几年就更新一代。
examples.pinyin: diànnǎo měi jǐ nián jiù gēngxīn yī dài.
examples.english: Computers get a new generation every few years.

一旦.meaning: once; in case (一旦发生火灾，立即撤离 once a fire breaks out, evacuate at once; 一旦做出决定 once a decision is made)

examples.hanzi: 一旦做出决定，就不要轻易改变。
examples.pinyin: yīdàn zuò chū juédìng, jiù bù yào qīngyì gǎibiàn.
examples.english: Once you've made a decision, don't change it lightly.

移动.meaning: to move; to shift (移动家具 move the furniture; 移动支付 mobile payment; 移动互联网 the mobile internet)

examples.hanzi: 请不要随意移动教室里的桌椅。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bù yào suíyì yídòng jiàoshì lǐ de zhuōyǐ.
examples.english: Please don't move the desks and chairs in the classroom at will.

near_synonyms.difference: 可惜 expresses regret about an external missed opportunity; 遗憾 is more formal and also personal regret about one's own situation.

遗憾.meaning: regret; pity; a matter of regret (终身遗憾 a lifelong regret; 令人遗憾 regrettable; 没能去成，很遗憾 couldn't go — a real pity)

examples.hanzi: 没能参加你们的婚礼，我很遗憾。
examples.pinyin: méi néng cānjiā nǐmen de hūnlǐ, wǒ hěn yíhàn.
examples.english: I'm really sorry I couldn't attend your wedding.

near_synonyms.difference: 和 joins nouns casually; 以及 is more formal, joins phrases and clauses, and ranks items in order.

以及.meaning: and; as well as (formal, joining phrases) (老师以及学生 teachers and students alike)

examples.hanzi: 会议讨论了成本以及时间问题。
examples.pinyin: huìyì tǎolùn le chéngběn yǐjí shíjiān wèntí.
examples.english: The meeting discussed costs as well as time issues.

near_synonyms.difference: 根据 is the everyday word for 'according to'; 依据 is more formal and stresses a documented basis.

依据.meaning: basis; to base on; according to (法律依据 legal basis; 依据事实 based on the facts)

examples.hanzi: 法院将依据法律做出判决。
examples.pinyin: fǎyuàn jiāng yījù fǎlǜ zuò chū pànjué.
examples.english: The court will make its ruling based on the law.

near_synonyms.difference: 依赖 is dependence, often with a negative sense of over-reliance; 依靠 is neutral support or backing.

依靠.meaning: to rely on; to depend on; something to rely on (依靠父母 depend on one's parents; 可以依靠 a reliable support)

examples.hanzi: 老人家主要依靠退休金生活。
examples.pinyin: lǎorénjiā zhǔyào yīkào tuìxiūjīn shēnghuó.
examples.english: The elderly live mainly on their pension.

以来.meaning: since (长期以来的努力 the efforts made over a long time; 自改革开放以来 since the reform and opening up)

examples.hanzi: 自从毕业以来，我们就没有见过面。
examples.pinyin: zìcóng bìyè yǐlái, wǒmen jiù méiyǒu jiàn guo miàn.
examples.english: Since graduation, we haven't seen each other.

医疗.meaning: medical (care) (医疗保险 medical insurance; 医疗事故 a medical accident; 医疗设备 medical equipment)

examples.hanzi: 这个村子改善了医疗条件。
examples.pinyin: zhège cūnzi gǎishàn le yīliáo tiáojiàn.
examples.english: This village has improved its medical care conditions.

一路.meaning: all the way; the whole journey (一路顺风 have a good trip; 一路上 along the way; 一路走好 take care on your journey)

examples.hanzi: 从北京到广州，一路都很顺利。
examples.pinyin: cóng Běijīng dào Guǎngzhōu, yīlù dōu hěn shùnlì.
examples.english: From Beijing to Guangzhou, the whole journey went smoothly.

一路顺风.meaning: bon voyage; have a smooth journey — parting wishes (祝你一路顺风 have a good trip)

examples.hanzi: 祝你一路顺风，到了给我打电话。
examples.pinyin: zhù nǐ yīlù shùnfēng, dào le gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: Have a smooth trip — call me when you arrive.

near_synonyms.difference: 因此 is the common 'therefore' in speech and writing; 因而 is more formal/literary.

因而.meaning: thus; consequently (下雨了，因而比赛取消了 it rained, and consequently the game was called off)

examples.hanzi: 下大雨，因而比赛推迟了。
examples.pinyin: xià dà yǔ, yīn'ér bǐsài tuīchí le.
examples.english: It rained heavily, and consequently the match was postponed.

迎.meaning: to meet; to welcome (迎接 greet; 欢迎 welcome; 迎面而来 come straight at one; 迎风 in the teeth of the wind)

examples.hanzi: 奶奶笑着迎了出来。
examples.pinyin: nǎinai xiào zhe yíng le chū lái.
examples.english: Grandma came out smiling to greet us.

硬.meaning: hard; stiff (床太硬 the bed is too hard; 硬币 a coin); stubborn; forced (硬要 insist on; 生硬 stiff and unnatural; 硬撑 hold out stubbornly)

examples.hanzi: 这张床太硬了，睡得不舒服。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng chuáng tài yìng le, shuì de bù shūfu.
examples.english: This bed is too hard; it's not comfortable to sleep on.

near_synonyms.difference: 应该 is the everyday word for obligation and expectation; 应当 is more formal, stressing duty by rule or principle.

应当.meaning: should; ought to (应当遵守规定 should follow the rules)

examples.hanzi: 公民应当遵守法律。
examples.pinyin: gōngmín yīngdāng zūnshǒu fǎlǜ.
examples.english: Citizens should obey the law.

near_synonyms.difference: 处理 is handling a matter or problem in general; 应对 is responding to a challenge, change or attack.

应对.meaning: to deal with; to respond to (应对危机 deal with a crisis; 应对挑战 cope with challenges; 应对措施 response measures)

examples.hanzi: 公司需要应对市场变化。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī xūyào yìngduì shìchǎng biànhuà.
examples.english: The company needs to respond to market changes.

near_synonyms.difference: 软件 is the complementary term for programs; 硬件 is the physical equipment.

硬件.meaning: hardware (computer) (硬件设施 hardware facilities; 硬件和软件 hardware and software)

examples.hanzi: 电脑硬件出了问题。
examples.pinyin: diànnǎo yìngjiàn chū le wèntí.
examples.english: The computer hardware has a problem.

near_synonyms.difference: 欢迎 expresses a welcoming attitude or sign (欢迎光临); 迎接 is physically going out to meet arriving people or things.

迎接.meaning: to meet; to welcome (the arrival of) (迎接客人 welcome guests; 迎接新学期 greet the new term; 迎接挑战 rise to challenges)

examples.hanzi: 全校师生在门口迎接客人。
examples.pinyin: quán xiào shīshēng zài ménkǒu yíngjiē kèrén.
examples.english: All the teachers and students greeted the guests at the gate.

near_synonyms.difference: 电影 is the everyday word for a film; 影片 is a more formal/critical term for a film as a work.

影片.meaning: film; movie (放映影片 show a film; 这部影片获得了大奖 the film won a major prize)

examples.hanzi: 这部影片是根据真实故事改编的。
examples.pinyin: zhè bù yǐngpiàn shì gēnjù zhēnshí gùshi gǎibiān de.
examples.english: This film was adapted from a true story.

影视.meaning: film and television (影视作品 films and TV dramas; 影视明星 a film and TV star)

examples.hanzi: 她梦想进入影视行业。
examples.pinyin: tā mèngxiǎng jìnrù yǐngshì hángyè.
examples.english: She dreams of entering the film and television industry.

营养.meaning: nutrition; nourishment (营养丰富 highly nutritious; 营养不良 malnutrition; 注意营养 pay attention to nutrition)

examples.hanzi: 牛奶的营养很丰富。
examples.pinyin: niúnǎi de yíngyǎng hěn fēngfù.
examples.english: Milk is rich in nutrition.

营业.meaning: to do business; to operate (营业时间 business hours; 开始营业 open for business; 停止营业 close down)

examples.hanzi: 这家超市二十四小时营业。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā chāoshì èrshísì xiǎoshí yíngyè.
examples.english: This supermarket is open twenty-four hours.

near_synonyms.difference: 使用 is operating an existing tool; 应用 is putting knowledge or technology to practical use.

应用.meaning: to apply; application (应用程序 an application program; 应用广泛 widely applied; 理论应用 the application of theory)

examples.hanzi: 这项技术被广泛应用在生产中。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng jìshù bèi guǎngfàn yìngyòng zài shēngchǎn zhōng.
examples.english: This technology is widely applied in production.

引进.meaning: to introduce (from elsewhere); to import (technology, talent) (引进技术 introduce technology; 引进外资 attract foreign investment)

examples.hanzi: 工厂引进了一条新的生产线。
examples.pinyin: gōngchǎng yǐnjìn le yī tiáo xīn de shēngchǎnxiàn.
examples.english: The factory introduced a new production line.

音量.meaning: volume (of sound) (调低音量 turn down the volume; 音量太大 the volume is too loud)

examples.hanzi: 图书馆里请把手机音量调小。
examples.pinyin: túshūguǎn lǐ qǐng bǎ shǒujī yīnliàng tiáo xiǎo.
examples.english: In the library, please turn your phone's volume down.

饮食.meaning: food and drink; diet (饮食习惯 eating habits; 饮食卫生 food hygiene; 注意饮食 watch one's diet)

examples.hanzi: 生病期间要注意饮食。
examples.pinyin: shēngbìng qījiān yào zhùyì yǐnshí.
examples.english: While sick, you must watch your diet.

印刷.meaning: to print; printing (印刷厂 a print shop; 印刷品 printed matter)

examples.hanzi: 这本书是彩色印刷的。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn shū shì cǎisè yìnshuā de.
examples.english: This book is printed in color.

near_synonyms.difference: 原因 explains why something happened (backward-looking); 因素 is an ongoing contributing element (forward-looking analysis).

因素.meaning: factor; element (重要因素 an important factor; 决定性因素 the decisive factor)

examples.hanzi: 成功有很多因素。
examples.pinyin: chénggōng yǒu hěn duō yīnsù.
examples.english: There are many factors in success.

near_synonyms.difference: 仍然 is the neutral 'still'; 依然 is more literary, keeping a former state unchanged.

依然.meaning: still; as before (依然如故 unchanged; 他依然坚持 he persists all the same)

examples.hanzi: 十年过去了，他依然住在这里。
examples.pinyin: shí nián guòqù le, tā yīrán zhù zài zhèlǐ.
examples.english: Ten years have passed, yet he still lives here.

意识.meaning: consciousness; awareness; to be aware of (环保意识 environmental awareness; 潜意识 the subconscious; 意识到危险 become aware of the danger)

examples.hanzi: 我们要增强环保意识。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen yào zēngqiáng huánbǎo yìshí.
examples.english: We should strengthen our environmental awareness.

near_synonyms.difference: 事故 is a concrete damaging incident (traffic accident); 意外 covers anything unexpected, good or bad, and is also an adjective.

意外.meaning: accident; unexpected (意外事故 an accident; 意外的惊喜 an unexpected treat; 出了意外 something went wrong)

examples.hanzi: 他在爬山时发生意外，摔伤了腿。
examples.pinyin: tā zài pá shān shí fāshēng yìwài, shuāi shāng le tuǐ.
examples.english: He had an accident while hiking and injured his leg.

意味着.meaning: to mean; to signify (这意味着什么呢? what does this mean?; 意味着新的开始 means a new beginning)

examples.hanzi: 退休意味着不用再上班了。
examples.pinyin: tuìxiū yìwèizhe bùyòng zài shàngbān le.
examples.english: Retirement means no longer having to go to work.

near_synonyms.difference: 问题 is an everyday question or a problem; 疑问 is a specifically unresolved doubt.

疑问.meaning: doubt; question (毫无疑问 beyond doubt; 提出疑问 raise a question; 有疑问 if in doubt)

examples.hanzi: 大家对这个问题还有疑问吗？
examples.pinyin: dàjiā duì zhège wèntí hái yǒu yíwèn ma?
examples.english: Does anyone still have doubts about this question?

near_synonyms.difference: 责任 is responsibility one bears, including blame; 义务 is a formal obligation, often legal or moral.

义务.meaning: obligation; duty; voluntary (法定义务 a legal obligation; 义务教育 compulsory education; 义务劳动 voluntary labor)

examples.hanzi: 纳税是每个公民的义务。
examples.pinyin: nàshuì shì měi gè gōngmín de yìwù.
examples.english: Paying taxes is every citizen's duty.

医学.meaning: medicine (the field) (医学院 a medical school; 医学研究 medical research; 中医学 traditional Chinese medicine)

examples.hanzi: 他从小就对医学感兴趣。
examples.pinyin: tā cóng xiǎo jiù duì yīxué gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: He has been interested in medicine since childhood.

near_synonyms.difference: 意思 is what a word or remark conveys; 意义 is the significance or value of an action or life.

意义.meaning: meaning; significance (人生的意义 the meaning of life; 有意义 meaningful; 深远的意义 far-reaching significance)

examples.hanzi: 这项研究有很大的科学意义。
examples.pinyin: zhè xiàng yánjiū yǒu hěn dà de kēxué yìyì.
examples.english: This research has great scientific significance.

near_synonyms.difference: 一样 means identical in kind or appearance; 一致 means aligned in opinion, direction or standard.

一致.meaning: unanimous; consistent; identical (意见一致 unanimous; 一致认为 unanimously believe; 一致同意 agree unanimously; 发展不一致 develop unevenly)

examples.hanzi: 双方的意见终于达成一致。
examples.pinyin: shuāngfāng de yìjiàn zhōngyú dáchéng yīzhì.
examples.english: The two sides finally reached agreement.

拥抱.meaning: to hug; to embrace; embrace (紧紧拥抱 hug tightly; 一个热情的拥抱 a warm embrace)

examples.hanzi: 下了火车，他们紧紧拥抱在一起。
examples.pinyin: xià le huǒchē, tāmen jǐnjǐn yōngbào zài yīqǐ.
examples.english: Off the train, they hugged each other tightly.

用法.meaning: usage; way of using (这个词的用法 the usage of this word; 用法说明 directions for use)

examples.hanzi: 老师给我们讲解了这个词的用法。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī gěi wǒmen jiǎngjiě le zhège cí de yòngfǎ.
examples.english: The teacher explained the usage of this word to us.

制定.meaning: to formulate; to enact (制定政策 formulate policy; 制定标准 set standards)

制度.meaning: system; institution; rules (制度改革 reform of the system; 规章制度 rules and regulations; 教育制度 the education system)

examples.english: Every company has its own management system.

职工.meaning: staff and workers (职工食堂 the staff canteen; 职工福利 employee benefits)

near_synonyms.difference: 智力 is measurable cognitive ability (IQ); 智慧 is wisdom — insight and good judgment from knowledge and experience.

智慧.meaning: wisdom; intelligence (人类的智慧 human wisdom; 智慧结晶 the fruit of wisdom; 充满智慧 full of wisdom)

examples.english: Solving problems requires human wisdom.

至今.meaning: up to now; to this day (至今没有消息 no news to this day; 至今难忘 still vivid in memory)

examples.english: He left his hometown ten years ago and has never been back to this day.

near_synonyms.difference: 医治 is more literary and stresses the doctor's act of curing; 治疗 is the standard clinical term for a course of treatment.

治疗.meaning: to treat (medically); treatment (接受治疗 undergo treatment; 治疗效果 the results of treatment)

examples.pinyin: tā zhùyuàn jiēshòu zhìliáo le yī gè yuè.
examples.english: He was hospitalized and received treatment for a month.

near_synonyms.difference: 著名 is stronger fame with wide recognition; 知名 is somewhat milder, known within a circle or field.

知名.meaning: well-known; famous (知名品牌 a famous brand; 知名度 popularity, name recognition; 知名人士 a public figure)

examples.english: He is a well-known architect.

智能.meaning: intelligence (of machines); smart; intelligent (智能手机 a smartphone; 人工智能 artificial intelligence; 智能家居 smart home devices)

examples.hanzi: 智能手机改变了我们的生活方式。
examples.pinyin: zhìnéng shǒujī gǎibiàn le wǒmen de shēnghuó fāngshì.
examples.english: Smartphones have changed the way we live.

near_synonyms.meaning: to implement; to put into practice
near_synonyms.difference: 实行 is putting an idea or system into practice; 执行 is carrying out an order, task, or rule as instructed.

执行.meaning: to carry out; to execute (执行任务 carry out a mission; 执行命令 obey an order; 严格执行 strictly enforce)

examples.hanzi: 我们必须严格执行这项规定。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen bìxū yángé zhíxíng zhè xiàng guīdìng.
examples.english: We must strictly carry out this regulation.

志愿者.meaning: volunteer (招募志愿者 recruit volunteers; 当志愿者 work as a volunteer)

examples.hanzi: 很多大学生当过奥运会的志愿者。
examples.pinyin: hěn duō dàxuéshēng dāng guò Àoyùnhuì de zhìyuànzhě.
examples.english: Many university students have been volunteers at the Olympics.

near_synonyms.difference: 制造 is industrial mass production of goods; 制作 is handcrafting or producing content (videos, meals, models).

制造.meaning: to manufacture (制造汽车 manufacture cars; 中国制造 made in China; 制造麻烦 make trouble)

examples.hanzi: 这家工厂制造各种机器零件。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā gōngchǎng zhìzào gè zhǒng jīqì língjiàn.
examples.english: This factory manufactures all kinds of machine parts.

制作.meaning: to make; to produce (制作视频 produce a video; 手工制作 handmade; 制作过程 the production process)

examples.hanzi: 他业余时间喜欢制作小视频。
examples.pinyin: tā yèyú shíjiān xǐhuan zhìzuò xiǎo shìpín.
examples.english: In his spare time he likes making short videos.

near_synonyms.difference: 重要 is generally important; 重大 is weightier, for decisions, events, or losses with big impact.

重大.meaning: major; significant (重大决定 a major decision; 重大突破 a major breakthrough; 重大意义 great significance)

examples.hanzi: 公司今年做出了几项重大决定。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī jīnnián zuò chū le jǐ xiàng zhòngdà juédìng.
examples.english: The company made several major decisions this year.

众多.meaning: numerous (众多人口 a large population; 众多选项 a host of options)

examples.hanzi: 展览吸引了众多观众前来参观。
examples.pinyin: zhǎnlǎn xīyǐn le zhòngduō guānzhòng qián lái cānguān.

中华.meaning: China; Chinese (civilization) (中华民族 the Chinese nation; 中华文化 Chinese culture)

examples.pinyin: Zhōnghuá wénmíng yǒu wǔ qiān nián de lìshǐ.
examples.english: Chinese civilization has five thousand years of history.

中华民族.meaning: the Chinese nation (all its ethnic groups) (中华民族的传统 the traditions of the Chinese nation)

examples.hanzi: 中华民族是一个勤劳勇敢的民族。
examples.pinyin: Zhōnghuá Mínzú shì yī gè qínláo yǒnggǎn de mínzú.
examples.english: The Chinese nation is a hardworking and brave people.

中级.meaning: intermediate level (中级班 an intermediate class; 中级职称 an intermediate professional title)

examples.hanzi: 我报了中级汉语班。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bào le zhōngjí Hànyǔ bān.
examples.english: I signed up for the intermediate Chinese class.

中介.meaning: intermediary; agent; brokerage (房屋中介 a real-estate agent; 通过中介 through a middleman)

examples.english: Did they find the rental through an agent?

种类.meaning: kind; type; variety (种类繁多 a wide variety; 商品种类 the range of goods)

examples.hanzi: 超市里面包的种类很多。
examples.pinyin: chāoshì lǐ miànbāo de zhǒnglèi hěn duō.
examples.english: There are many kinds of bread in the supermarket.

重量.meaning: weight (测重量 measure the weight; 超重 overweight — over the weight limit)

examples.hanzi: 请先称一下包裹的重量。
examples.pinyin: qǐng xiān chēng yī xià bāoguǒ de zhòngliàng.
examples.english: Please weigh the package first.

中期.meaning: middle period; midterm (中长期规划 medium- and long-term planning; 学期中期 mid-semester)

examples.hanzi: 这个项目中期需要投入更多资金。
examples.pinyin: zhège xiàngmù zhōngqī xūyào tóurù gèng duō zījīn.
examples.english: This project requires more funding in its middle phase.

中外.meaning: China and abroad; Chinese and foreign (中外游客 Chinese and foreign tourists; 中外驰名 famous both at home and abroad)

examples.hanzi: 这次音乐会聚集了中外著名的音乐家。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì yīnyuèhuì jùjí le Zhōngwài zhùmíng de yīnyuèjiā.
examples.english: This concert brought together famous Chinese and foreign musicians.

near_synonyms.difference: 中央 is the exact middle point or the central authorities (党中央); 中心 is a hub or facility serving a purpose (购物中心).

中心.meaning: center; hub (市中心 downtown; 购物中心 a shopping mall; 中心思想 the central idea; 以…为中心 center on)

examples.english: My home is near the city center.

中药.meaning: traditional Chinese medicine (喝中药 drink herbal medicine; 中药店 a TCM pharmacy)

examples.english: When Grandpa gets sick he often drinks herbal medicine to recuperate.

中医.meaning: traditional Chinese medicine; TCM doctor (看中医 see a TCM practitioner; 中医治疗 TCM treatment)

examples.english: Many people like to see a TCM doctor when they're ill.

种植.meaning: to plant; to grow (种植水稻 grow rice; 种植技术 cultivation techniques; 大面积种植 plant on a large scale)

种子.meaning: seed (播种子 sow seeds; 种子选手 a seeded player — sports)

examples.english: I boiled myself an egg this morning.

猪.meaning: pig; hog (养猪 raise pigs; 猪肉 pork)

examples.english: The farm raises a lot of pigs.

逐渐.meaning: gradually (天气逐渐变冷 the weather is gradually turning cold; 逐渐习惯 gradually get used to)

examples.hanzi: 自从学了汉语，他对中国文化产生了兴趣。
examples.pinyin: zìcóng xué le Hànyǔ, tā duì Zhōngguó wénhuà chǎnshēng le xìngqù.
examples.english: Ever since learning Chinese, he has become interested in Chinese culture.

自动.meaning: automatic; automatically; of one's own accord (自动门 an automatic door; 自动回复 auto-reply; 自动放弃 give up of one's own accord)

examples.hanzi: 门是自动的，人一靠近就会打开。
examples.pinyin: mén shì zìdòng de, rén yī kàojìn jiù huì dǎkāi.
examples.english: The door is automatic — it opens as soon as someone comes near.

资格.meaning: qualification (报考资格 eligibility to register; 有资格发言 be qualified to speak; 取消资格 disqualify)

examples.hanzi: 他参加了三次考试，才取得驾照资格。
examples.pinyin: tā cānjiā le sān cì kǎoshì, cái qǔdé jiàzhào zīgé.
examples.english: It took him three tries at the exam to qualify for a driver's license.

资金.meaning: funds; capital (筹集资金 raise funds; 资金紧张 short of funds; 投入资金 inject capital)

examples.hanzi: 这个项目需要大量的资金。
examples.pinyin: zhège xiàngmù xūyào dàliàng de zījīn.
examples.english: This project requires a large amount of capital.

自觉.meaning: conscious (of doing sth.); conscientious; of one's own volition (自觉遵守规则 comply with the rules conscientiously; 自觉排队 queue up without being told; 自觉性 self-discipline)

examples.hanzi: 大家都很自觉，没人插队。
examples.pinyin: dàjiā dōu hěn zìjué, méi rén chāduì.
examples.english: Everyone was conscientious — nobody cut in line.

字母.meaning: letter (of an alphabet) (二十六个字母 the 26 letters; 拼音字母 the letters of pinyin)

examples.hanzi: 英语有二十六个字母。
examples.pinyin: Yīngyǔ yǒu èrshíliù gè zìmǔ.
examples.english: English has twenty-six letters.

子女.meaning: sons and daughters; children (抚养子女 raise one's children; 子女的义务 children's duty)

examples.hanzi: 他们把三个子女都培养成了大学生。
examples.pinyin: tāmen bǎ sān gè zǐnǚ dōu péiyǎng chéng le dàxuéshēng.
examples.english: They raised all three of their children into university graduates.

自身.meaning: oneself; one's own (自身的问题 one's own problems; 提高自身素质 improve oneself)

examples.hanzi: 他首先从自身找原因。
examples.pinyin: tā shǒuxiān cóng zìshēn zhǎo yuányīn.
examples.english: He first looked for the cause in himself.

姿势.meaning: posture; pose (正确的坐姿 the correct sitting posture; 摆姿势 strike a pose)

examples.hanzi: 写字的时候要保持正确的姿势。
examples.pinyin: xiězì de shíhou yào bǎochí zhèngquè de zīshì.
examples.english: You should keep a correct posture when writing.

咨询.meaning: to consult; to seek advice (咨询服务 consulting services; 向律师咨询 consult a lawyer)

examples.hanzi: 关于留学的事，你可以咨询这位顾问。
examples.pinyin: guānyú liúxué de shì, nǐ kěyǐ zīxún zhè wèi gùwèn.
examples.english: About studying abroad, you can consult this adviser.

自由.meaning: freedom; free (言论自由 freedom of speech; 自由职业 freelance work; 自由自在 free and unfettered)

examples.hanzi: 周末是我最自由的时间。
examples.pinyin: zhōumò shì wǒ zuì zìyóu de shíjiān.
examples.english: The weekend is when I'm most free.

资源.meaning: resources (自然资源 natural resources; 人力资源 human resources; 资源共享 resource sharing)

examples.hanzi: 我们要合理利用自然资源。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen yào hélǐ lìyòng zìrán zīyuán.
examples.english: We should make rational use of natural resources.

examples.hanzi: 这家跨国公司的总部设在纽约。
examples.pinyin: zhè jià kuàguó gōngsī de zǒngbù shè zài Niǔyuē.
examples.english: This multinational company's headquarters is in New York.

总共.meaning: in all; altogether (总共花了五百元 spent five hundred yuan in all)

examples.hanzi: 这次活动总共来了五十个人。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì huódòng zǒnggòng lái le wǔshí gè rén.
examples.english: Fifty people came to this event in all.

综合.meaning: comprehensive; to synthesize (综合实力 overall strength; 综合考虑 consider comprehensively; 综合大学 a comprehensive university)

examples.hanzi: 大学录取要看综合成绩。
examples.pinyin: dàxué lùqǔ yào kàn zōnghé chéngjì.
examples.english: University admission looks at overall grades.

总数.meaning: total; total number (达到总数 reach the total; 总数不变 the total stays the same)

examples.hanzi: 请统计一下捐款的总数。
examples.pinyin: qǐng tǒngjì yī xià juānkuǎn de zǒngshù.
examples.english: Please tally up the total of the donations.

总体.meaning: overall; total (总体来说 on the whole; 总体规划 an overall plan; 总体水平 the overall level)

examples.hanzi: 总体来说，今年的收成不错。
examples.pinyin: zǒngtǐ lái shuō, jīnnián de shōuchéng bùcuò.
examples.english: On the whole, this year's harvest is good.

总统.meaning: president (of a republic) (美国总统 the US president; 竞选总统 run for president)

examples.hanzi: 这位总统明天开始对中国进行访问。
examples.pinyin: zhè wèi zǒngtǒng míngtiān kāishǐ duì Zhōngguó jìnxíng fǎngwèn.
examples.english: This president begins a visit to China tomorrow.

总之.meaning: in a word; in short (总之，办法总比困难多 in short, there are always more solutions than difficulties)

examples.hanzi: 总之，这条路是走不通的。
examples.pinyin: zǒngzhī, zhè tiáo lù shì zǒu bu tōng de.
examples.english: In short, this road won't work.

族.meaning: clan; ethnic group (民族 nationality; 家族 family clan; 汉族 the Han); suffix for groups with a shared trait — 上班族 commuters, 月光族 people who spend every paycheck, 追星族 celebrity fans

examples.hanzi: 中国有五十六个民族，每个族都有自己的文化。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó yǒu wǔshíliù gè mínzú, měi gè zú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de wénhuà.
examples.english: China has fifty-six ethnic groups, and each group has its own culture.

near_synonyms.difference: 构成 is more formal/abstract, also 'to constitute' (构成威胁); 组成 is the everyday word for parts making up a whole.

组成.meaning: to compose; to make up; composition (由三个部分组成 consist of three parts; 组成团队 form a team)

examples.hanzi: 水是由氢和氧组成的。
examples.pinyin: shuǐ shì yóu qīng hé yǎng zǔchéng de.
examples.english: Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen.

足够.meaning: enough; sufficient (足够的时间 enough time; 足够勇敢 brave enough; 足以 sufficient to)

examples.hanzi: 我们有足够的时间准备考试。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen yǒu zúgòu de shíjiān zhǔnbèi kǎoshì.
examples.english: We have enough time to prepare for the exam.

组合.meaning: to combine; combination (组合家具 modular furniture; 最佳组合 the best combination; 歌唱组合 a singing group)

examples.hanzi: 这三个字母可以组合成不同的词。
examples.pinyin: zhè sān gè zìmǔ kěyǐ zǔhé chéng bùtóng de cí.
examples.english: These three letters can be combined into different words.

醉.meaning: to be drunk; intoxicated (喝醉了 got drunk; 陶醉 enraptured; 沉醉 immersed; 醉酒驾车 drunk driving)

examples.hanzi: 他喝醉了，走路都不稳了。
examples.pinyin: tā hē zuì le, zǒulù dōu bù wěn le.
examples.english: He got drunk and can barely walk steadily.

嘴巴.meaning: mouth (捂住嘴巴 cover one's mouth; 嘴巴严 can keep a secret)

examples.hanzi: 他惊讶得张大了嘴巴。
examples.pinyin: tā jīngyà de zhāng dà le zuǐba.
examples.english: His mouth fell open in astonishment.

near_synonyms.difference: 开始 is the point when something starts; 最初 stresses the earliest stage of a period, often contrasted with later developments.

最初.meaning: initially; at first (最初的想法 the initial idea; 最初几个月 the first few months)

examples.hanzi: 我最初的想法是当老师。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zuìchū de xiǎngfǎ shì dāng lǎoshī.
examples.english: My initial idea was to become a teacher.

最佳.meaning: optimum; best (最佳时机 the best moment; 最佳人选 the best candidate; 荣获最佳 win the best-actor award)

examples.hanzi: 清晨是锻炼的最佳时间。
examples.pinyin: qīngchén shì duànliàn de zuìjiā shíjiān.
examples.english: Early morning is the best time to exercise.

租金.meaning: rent (支付租金 pay rent; 租金上涨 the rent went up)

examples.hanzi: 这套房子的租金每月三千元。
examples.pinyin: zhè tào fángzi de zūjīn měi yuè sān qiān yuán.
examples.english: The rent for this apartment is three thousand yuan a month.

near_synonyms.difference: 尊重 respects opinions, choices, and persons equally; 尊敬 is deferential esteem for elders, teachers, or people of high standing.

尊敬.meaning: to respect; to honor (受人尊敬 respected by all; 尊敬的老人 a venerable old man)

examples.hanzi: 我们应该尊敬老人。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng lǎorén.
examples.english: We should respect the elderly.

遵守.meaning: to abide by; to observe (rules, promises) (遵守交通规则 obey traffic rules; 遵守诺言 keep a promise)

examples.hanzi: 每个人都应该遵守交通规则。
examples.pinyin: měi gè rén dōu yīnggāi zūnshǒu jiāotōng guīzé.
examples.english: Everyone should obey the traffic rules.

作出.meaning: to make (a decision, contribution, response) (作出决定 make a decision; 作出贡献 make a contribution; 作出反应 respond)

examples.hanzi: 委员会作出了最后的决定。
examples.pinyin: wěiyuánhuì zuò chū le zuìhòu de juédìng.
examples.english: The committee made the final decision.

near_synonyms.difference: 制止 is stopping an ongoing (often verbal) action by force or authority (制止谣言); 阻止 is blocking someone from doing something in advance.

阻止.meaning: to stop; to prevent; to block (阻止事态发展 stop a situation from developing; 加以阻止 intervene to stop it)

examples.hanzi: 警察阻止了那辆超速的汽车。
examples.pinyin: jǐngchá zǔzhǐ le nà liàng chāosù de qìchē.
examples.english: The police stopped the speeding car.

组织.meaning: to organize; organization (组织活动 organize an activity; 国际组织 international organization; 组织能力 organizational ability)

examples.hanzi: 学生会组织了一次义务植树活动。
examples.pinyin: xuéshēnghuì zǔzhī le yī cì yìwù zhíshù huódòng.
examples.english: The student union organized a volunteer tree-planting activity.
